raw.title: Information System Security Officer (ISSO)
raw.excerpt: OverviewLMI is seeking an Information System Security Officer (ISSO) to support the Robotics and Autonomous Systems (RAS) business unit and Department of War mission partners.
raw.description:
Overview

LMI is seeking an Information System Security Officer (ISSO) to support the Robotics and Autonomous Systems (RAS) business unit and Department of War mission partners. The ISSO will maintain system security documentation, coordinate Risk Management Framework (RMF) activities, support Authority to Operate (ATO) packages, and track security controls, vulnerabilities, and remediation actions throughout the system lifecycle.

The ISSO will work with the Information System Security Manager (ISSM), government system owners, assessors, and engineering teams to keep authorization records aligned with deployed systems. The ideal candidate combines hands-on DoD authorization experience with the technical judgment to evaluate evidence, identify security gaps, and coordinate corrective actions.

This remote position requires an active Secret security clearance and the ability to obtain and maintain Top Secret if required by the assignment. Periodic travel may be required for assessments, customer meetings, and access to approved facilities. All classified work must be performed in approved facilities.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors, helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

  • Maintain System Security Plans, control implementation statements, system inventories, authorization boundaries, network and data-flow diagrams, and supporting records in eMASS or another customer-approved system.
  • Support system categorization, control selection, and documentation of inherited and system-specific controls, including shared responsibilities across cloud providers, platform teams, and application owners.
  • Prepare and maintain authorization packages for initial authorization, renewal, and system changes; coordinate evidence collection, reviews, assessment milestones, and responses to findings.
  • Maintain Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms), assign and track remediation actions with responsible teams, and document validation and closure evidence.
  • Review vulnerability scans, Security Technical Implementation Guide (STIG) checklists, and security advisories; coordinate remediation and document unresolved risks for appropriate review.
  • Execute the approved continuous monitoring plan, coordinating control reviews, scan schedules, account reviews, audit-log reviews, configuration checks, and required reporting.
  • Evaluate proposed changes to applications, infrastructure, interfaces, and data flows for security impacts; update documentation and coordinate any additional assessment or authorization requirements.
  • Work with cloud, platform, software, and cybersecurity engineers to collect technical evidence from deployed systems and software delivery pipelines, including configuration and vulnerability results.
  • Support security assessments, inspections, and audits by organizing evidence, responding to assessor questions, and tracking corrective actions through resolution.
  • Maintain security procedures and support access-control reviews, incident reporting, contingency planning, and recovery exercises in coordination with responsible technical and security teams.
  • Provide status reports on authorization milestones, monitoring results, vulnerabilities, and overdue actions; elevate risk recommendations to the ISSM and authorized government decision-makers.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Active Secret security clearance, with the ability to obtain and maintain Top Secret if required by the assignment.
  • Minimum of five years of relevant experience as an ISSO, ISSM, cybersecurity compliance professional, or equivalent practitioner supporting DoD information systems.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience preparing and maintaining DoD RMF authorization packages, including security control documentation, assessment support, POA&M management, and ATO sustainment.
  • Experience using eMASS, Xacta, or a comparable government authorization system to maintain control responses, assessment evidence, findings, and authorization records.
  • Working knowledge of NIST SP 800-53 security controls, DISA STIGs, vulnerability management, continuous monitoring, and DoD system authorization requirements.
  • Ability to interpret vulnerability scan results, technical configurations, system diagrams, and assessment findings, and coordinate evidence-based remediation with engineers and system owners.
  • Working knowledge of operating systems, networking, identity and access management, encryption, configuration management, and logging sufficient to evaluate security-control implementation.
  • Current cybersecurity certification relevant to the assigned duties and ability to meet applicable DoD 8140 work-role and proficiency-level qualification requirements within customer-required timelines.
  • Strong technical writing, documentation, organization, and stakeholder coordination skills; ability to manage concurrent deadlines, protect sensitive information, and work independently within a distributed team.
  • Ability to support periodic travel and perform classified duties at approved facilities. A college degree is not required.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting authorizations for cloud-hosted systems in AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, or another government-authorized cloud environment, including control inheritance and shared-responsibility documentation.
  • Experience supporting systems at DoD Impact Level 4, 5, or 6, including mission applications, data platforms, or environments supporting robotics and autonomous systems.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes, containers, DevSecOps, automated security evidence, software supply-chain controls, or security requirements for onboarding applications to an authorized platform.
  • Experience supporting Special Operations Forces, combatant commands, military service components, or Intelligence Community mission partners.
  • Experience supporting independent security control assessments or implementing continuous monitoring processes across multiple systems.
  • CGRC, CISSP, CISM, or a related advanced cybersecurity certification.
  • Bachelor's or master's degree in cybersecurity, information systems, computer science, or a related discipline.

The target salary range for this position is $92,075 - $158,138.

The salary range displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is not a guarantee of compensation. Individual salaries are determined by various factors including, but not limited to location, internal equity, business considerations, client contract requirements, and candidate qualifications, such as education, experience, skills, and security clearances.  

Applicants must meet eligibility requirements for a U.S. Government security clearance. Only US Citizens are eligible for a security clearance. For this position, LMI will only consider applicants with security clearances or applicants who are eligible for security clearances, due to the nature of the work.

Grow your career at Cedars-Sinai!

The Enterprise Information Services (EIS) team at Cedars-Sinai understands that true clinical transformation and the optimization of a clinical information systems implementation is fueled through the alignment of the right people, processes, and technologies.

Why work here?

Cedars-Sinai placed in the top 20 on Newsweek’s “World's Best Smart Hospitals 2024” list, which highlights hospitals that have excelled in the utilization of electronic functionalities, telemedicine, digital imaging, artificial intelligence and robotics.

The organization’s Healthtech excellence was acknowledged again, this time by the esteemed “CHIME Digital Health Most Wired“ recognition program. Cedars-Sinai was assigned a Level 10—the most prestigious level of certification—among more than 300 surveyed healthcare organizations. Cedars-Sinai netted high scores across multiple verticals and particularly excelled in areas of infrastructure, interoperability, and population health innovation.

What you will be doing:

The Digital Scheduling and Access Program Manager will be responsible for overseeing and providing strategic support to the EIS Cadence and MyChart teams, ensuring successful project oversight, prioritization, resource management, and data analysis. This role will provide leadership, guidance, and direction for the Digital Scheduling project, collaborating with operational stakeholders to optimize scheduling and promote the use of digital tools.

In this role, you will lead the long-term digital scheduling and access program implementation and optimization plans, identifying and mitigating risks with program stakeholders. You will be responsible for developing and maintaining strong relationships with key stakeholders, including clinical and operational leaders, IT teams, and vendors. You will also be responsible for monitoring and reporting on project progress, providing regular updates to senior leadership.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in healthcare operations and project management, with experience in digital scheduling and access tools. You should have a demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams, manage complex projects, and communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels of the organization. Additionally, you should be comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and be able to adapt quickly to changing priorities.

  • Oversee the implementation of the EIS digital scheduling tools across specialties.
  • Assist the Cadence and MyChart teams with design decisions needed.
  • Determine resource allocation and planning needs.
  • Create project documentation tools to support the work.
  • Maintain tasks and milestones according to the project timelines.
  • Ensure the Cadence scheduling tools (decision trees, Fast Pass, scheduling tickets) are implemented as planned.
  • Ensure the MyChart scheduling tools (open, direct, and scheduling tickets) are implemented as planned.
  • Oversee the post-live specialty check-ins required for both MyChart and Cadence.
  • Be the point person for Cadence and MyChart scheduling-related escalations.
  • Identify and mitigate risks that could impact program success
  • Ensure pre-requirements for launching digital tools are addressed with operational access optimization and change management prior to the EIS project kickoff.
  • Assist with driving standardization of scheduling workflows across all clinics.
  • Make data-driven decisions on workflow optimizations, engaging stakeholders as needed.
  • Create project requests and track optimization requests.
  • Participate in all scheduling-related meetings to maintain continuity and support decision-making.
  • Deliver regular status updates at key leadership meetings.
  • Develop and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to evaluate the effectiveness of digital programs and consistently report findings to leadership.
  • Develop a toolkit for managing and tracking the digital scheduling tools implemented.
  • Manage Cadence and MyChart risks and post go-live support.
  • Ensure and/or create lessons learned documentation from EIS and operations and report out to EIS leadership.

About the Role

We are seeking a detail-oriented and empathetic Surgical Coordinator & Patient Scheduler to manage our end-to-end patient scheduling and surgical care workflows. In this position, you will serve as the primary bridge between our patients, surgical teams, and facilities—ensuring seamless care coordination from initial consultation through post-operative recovery.

This role requires strong communication skills, outstanding organizational ability, and a thorough understanding of pre-op and post-op protocols to ensure all clinical requirements, documentation, and authorizations are fully in place prior to every procedure.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

1. Patient Scheduling & Appointment Management

  • Schedule and maintain patient appointments for consultations, follow-up visits, and pre-operative evaluations.
  • Coordinate surgical procedures, securing operating room time and aligning provider, facility, and patient schedules.
  • Manage scheduling systems in real time to ensure optimal clinical flow and minimize gaps or double-bookings.

2. Surgical & Care Coordination

  • Facilitate complete pre-operative and post-operative care coordination across all participating care providers and facilities.
  • Ensure all required medical clearances, diagnostic test results, and prior authorizations are secured well in advance of scheduled surgery dates.
  • Review and verify patient records to confirm all clinical, legal, and insurance documentation is complete.

3. Patient Communication & Education

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for patients preparing for or recovering from surgical procedures.
  • Clearly explain pre-operative requirements (e.g., fasting guidelines, medication holds) and post-operative care plans to patients and family members.
  • Address patient inquiries promptly, offering compassionate support and escalating clinical concerns to providers when necessary.

4. Administrative & EMR Support

  • Maintain up-to-date, accurate patient records within the Electronic Medical Record (EMR) system.
  • Track procedure status, follow-up timelines, and post-op milestone check-ins.

The Coding Auditor works under the general direction of the Coding Supervisor. A Coding Auditor is responsible for reviewing encounters in either a prebill or retrospective workflow to validate a coding profile. This includes applicable code sets to encounter type, abstracted data elements, missed query opportunities, and other related encounter data collection points. Auditors evaluate compliance with all coding guidelines including but not limited to: Internal Coding policies/procedures/handbook, American Hospital Association (AHA) and American Medical Association (AMA) coding references, local, State, and Federal Coding Guidelines.   • Maintains appropriate open communication with internal and external partners and peer departments such as Coding Operations, Clinical Documentation Integrity (CDI), Payor Revenue Management (PRM), and Compliance Revenue Integrity (CRI).

  • Provide 1:1 and small group education sessions, facilitate round table discussions, contribute content to the coding newsletter, provide basic level trending or data review for opportunities.
  • Evaluate codes through data reports and trended opportunities, audit to validate findings, produce summary reports with recommendations of action plans.
  • Perform additional activities (e.g. Data quality reports, etc.) as assigned by the Coding Supervisor.

  • Soutenir la mise en place d’équipes produit et de mécanismes de gouvernance collaborative;
  • Participer au déploiement et à l’évolution de solutions technologiques;
  • Produire les rapports d’avancement et les redditions de comptes destinés aux parties prenantes;
  • Conseiller les décideurs relativement à la planification et à la priorisation des initiatives;
  • Élaborer et mettre en œuvre des stratégies de communication adaptées aux projets;

Requirements

  • Détenir un diplôme en informatique, gestion des technologies de l’information, ingénierie ou dans une discipline connexe;
  • Posséder un minimum de dix (10) années d’expérience pertinente en gestion de projets TI;
  • Détenir une expérience en gestion de projets dans des environnements complexes;
  • Posséder une expérience en transformation organisationnelle, incluant le virage Agile, la mise en place d’équipes produit et la gouvernance collaborative;
  • Démontrer une expérience en gestion de programmes ou de portefeuilles de projets complexes et interdépendants;
  • Avoir participé au déploiement ou à l’évolution de solutions technologiques telles que Microsoft 365 ou les environnements Windows;
  • Posséder une expérience en gouvernance de projet, gestion budgétaire, analyse de risques et reddition de comptes;
  • Maîtriser les approches de gestion de projet traditionnelles, agiles ou hybrides;
  • Être capable de coordonner des parties prenantes provenant de différents secteurs d’affaires et technologiques;
  • Démontrer d’excellentes habiletés de synthèse, de communication et de rédaction de documents stratégiques;
  • Posséder une bonne compréhension des enjeux liés à la gouvernance des technologies de l’information;
  • Faire preuve de leadership, d’autonomie, de rigueur et d’un excellent esprit de collaboration.

Benefits

  • Du télétravail et de la flexibilité pour s’adapter à vos obligations familiales
  • Une culture entrepreneuriale favorisant la créativité et l’innovation
  • Horaires flexibles (selon le type de contrat de travail)
  • Congés en cas de maladie et à l’occasion d’événements familiaux
  • Outils informatiques adaptés
  • Espace de travail épanouissant et motivant
  • Initiatives sociales et environnementales
  • Programme d’apprentissage en milieu de travail

Le salaire sera calculé sur la base du taux horaire moyen correspondant à votre profil.

Lanaudière - Télétravail avec possibilité de présence occasionnelle

POURQUOI SE JOINDRE À TEHORA ?

TEHORA est une firme québécoise multidisciplinaire reconnue pour l’excellence de ses services professionnels, de nature technique et de gestion de projets à l’échelle nationale et internationale. Notre mission est d’accompagner nos clients dans la concrétisation de leurs projets par l’excellence de notre savoir-faire et de notre créativité.

Depuis sa création en 2017, notre équipe de professionnels connaît une croissance exponentielle en répondant aux besoins importants en gestion de projets multidisciplinaires, dans le domaine des transports, du génie civil, du TI et plus.

Nos collaborateurs travaillent sur des mandats aussi bien à l’interne que chez des clients d’envergure.

TEHORA se distingue par sa culture d’entreprise, axée sur le bonheur de ses employés et la diversité.

Chez TEHORA, chaque collaborateur est un membre important de l’équipe qui contribue à notre succès collectif. Nos membres ont la flexibilité requise pour avoir un équilibre entre le travail et leur vie privée, tout en menant une carrière enrichissante.

Nous offrons un environnement de travail motivant. La diversité des projets, la grande autonomie et l’interaction directe avec les clients sont appréciées. Une telle proximité est possible en raison de notre structure organisationnelle horizontale, qui se traduit par des relations de confiance et une communication efficace entre notre équipe et les clients.

raw.title: Senior Director, Semantic Data Platform
raw.excerpt: About the RoleWEX is reimagining its enterprise data platform with an ambitious goal: make our data understandable not only to people and applications, but also to AI models and autonomous agents.
raw.description:
About the Role

WEX is reimagining its enterprise data platform with an ambitious goal: make our data understandable not only to people and applications, but also to AI models and autonomous agents.

We are looking for a Senior Director to lead the next generation of our Data-as-a-Service (DaaS) platform and build the semantic foundation that connects data with its business meaning.

This leader will define and drive how WEX creates trusted semantic objects for our major business domains—such as customers, accounts, merchants, transactions, vehicles, payments, claims, and risk signals. These objects will bring together data, relationships, business definitions, derived attributes, policies, lineage, and context into reusable assets that can power analytics, data products, decisioning, and AI experiences.

This is a highly visible leadership role. You will lead a team of senior engineers and technical leaders while partnering closely with Product, AI, Analytics, Risk, Finance, and business teams across WEX.

The space is evolving quickly. We are not looking for someone who has already built an exact version of this platform. We are looking for a leader with deep data and platform experience, strong technical judgment, and the ability to help invent what the next generation of enterprise data platforms should become in an AI-native world.

How you'll make an impact

  • Define the technical vision, architecture, and multi-year roadmap for WEX's semantic data platform and next generation of Data as a Service.

  • Build semantic business objects that bring together enterprise data, business context, relationships, metrics, derived attributes, rules, lineage, quality, and governance.

  • Establish a scalable approach for creating semantic objects across WEX's different lines of business while maintaining consistent enterprise standards.

  • Lead development of platform capabilities across semantic modeling, ontology, metadata, knowledge graphs, data quality, lineage, data contracts, and governance.

  • Partner deeply with business and product leaders to capture business meaning that today may live across databases, applications, workflows, documents, spreadsheets, policies, and institutional knowledge.

  • Enable AI and agentic applications to discover, understand, reason over, and safely act on trusted enterprise data.

  • Build reusable platform capabilities and developer experiences that allow teams to create new data products and AI experiences faster.

  • Lead and develop a high-performing organization of engineers, architects, and senior technical leaders.

  • Partner with Principal and Staff engineers to establish architectural standards and solve complex distributed data and platform problems.

  • Drive adoption across engineering and business teams, ensuring the platform delivers measurable customer and business outcomes—not simply new technology.

Experience you'll bring

  • 15+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, distributed systems, data platforms, or related technology areas, including significant technical leadership experience.

  • Experience leading engineering organizations responsible for large-scale data, platform, infrastructure, or developer capabilities.

  • Deep understanding of modern data architecture, including large-scale data processing, streaming, lakehouse architectures, data products, and distributed systems.

  • Deep understanding of semantic data technologies and industry direction is essential. Direct experience building a semantic data layer is strongly recommended.

  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex business concepts into scalable technical abstractions and reusable platform capabilities.

  • Strong understanding of data quality, governance, lineage, security, privacy, and operational reliability.

  • Experience building platforms adopted by multiple engineering teams, business domains, or product organizations.

  • Strong architectural judgment with the ability to evaluate tradeoffs and move comfortably between long-term strategy and detailed technical discussions.

  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior technical, product, and business leaders across organizational boundaries.

  • Experience hiring, mentoring, and developing senior engineering talent and technical leaders.

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to engineering teams, business partners, and executive leadership.

Preferred experience

  • Experience building platforms that support AI/ML, generative AI, RAG, or agentic applications.

  • Experience with knowledge representation, semantic search, context engineering, graph technologies, or AI-ready enterprise data.

  • Experience modernizing large enterprise data ecosystems with multiple business domains and legacy systems.

  • Experience driving a significant platform transformation from concept through enterprise adoption.

The most important qualification is not familiarity with a particular tool or architecture. We are looking for a leader who can combine deep engineering expertise, business understanding, and first-principles thinking to help define how enterprise data should work in an AI-native future.

The base pay range represents the anticipated low and high end of the pay range for this position. Actual pay rates will vary and will be based on various factors, such as your qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. Base pay is one component of WEX's total compensation package. Most sales positions are eligible for commission under the terms of an applicable plan. Non-sales roles are typically eligible for a quarterly or annual bonus based on their role and applicable plan. WEX's comprehensive and market competitive benefits are designed to support your personal and professional well-being. Benefits include health, dental and vision insurances, retirement savings plan, paid time off, health savings account, flexible spending accounts, life insurance, disability insurance, tuition reimbursement, and more. For more information, check out the "About Us" section.Pay Range: $230,800.00 - $283,600.00

About the Team/Role

WEX is a global leader in intelligent payment solutions — powering the B2B payment infrastructure behind the world's largest travel platforms, financial institutions, fintechs, and mid-market enterprises. Our goal is to simplify the business of running a business for our customers and free them to spend more time, with less worry, on the things they love. We are on a journey to build a unified, world class user experience across our products and services and leverage customer driven innovation to power our growth and strategic initiatives.

As we lean into our mission to "simplify the business of running a business", WEX is looking to simplify and reimagine experiences, starting from the customer perspective. We are looking for a Sr. Product Manager with strong technical fluency and payments expertise to own the execution and delivery of our embedded payments product roadmap — collaborating across the business with an emphasis on creating a simple, proactive and personalized experience. In this role, you'll learn the end-to-end customer experience by assisting and supporting the Product Management team on their strategic roadmap, working closely with engineering on payments APIs and infrastructure. You will do this through performing and developing the following competencies:

  • Strategic Mindset: Seek to understand WEX’s corporate strategy, the competitive environment and market trends and how our products can create value
  • Customer Obsessed: Deeply understand our customers’ needs through customer empathy, data and prioritize work
  • Results Focused: Leverage data to understand how the product is performing and prioritize work
  • Insights Driven: Use qualitative and quantitative insights to drive decisions, define experiments and prioritize roadmap
  • Trusted Partner: Appreciate and comprehend different points of view and share information clearly and transparently with strong collaboration while knowing when to escalate
  • Relevant Expertise: Brings a deep understanding of the market, applied technologies and domain expertise, with a curiosity and learning mindset

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the strategy, roadmap, discovery, and end-to-end delivery for an embedded payments product or core payment platform capability, translating customer and business problems into clear product priorities.
  • Build a deep understanding of embedded payments customers, partners, market dynamics, and competitive offerings to identify opportunities and guide product decisions.
  • Lead customer-centric discovery and translate insights into actionable product requirements, hypotheses, and prioritized roadmaps in partnership with engineering and cross-functional teams.
  • Partner closely with engineering on payment APIs, platform capabilities, and architecture trade-offs to deliver scalable, technically sound product experiences.
  • Lead product delivery with 1-2 Scrum teams, aligning teams around the problem to solve, sequencing work, and delivering value iteratively. The organization is working toward more stable, dedicated team assignments.
  • Use qualitative and quantitative data to assess product performance, define success measures, inform prioritization, and evaluate customer adoption and business outcomes.
  • Collaborate across product, engineering, analytics, UX, and relevant business partners to create a cohesive end-to-end customer experience across products and platforms.
  • Identify opportunities to modernize payment infrastructure and close capability gaps, including opportunities that enable broader Corporate Payments and Mobility use cases.
  • Use AI tools thoughtfully to improve productivity and explore product opportunities, applying critical judgment to validate outputs and avoid introducing unsupported or inappropriate solutions.
  • Apply a risk-aware mindset to product decisions, including due diligence, compliance review processes, and protection of confidential or proprietary information.

What You Bring:

  • 5+ years of experience in product management, with 2+ years of experience in payments, fintech, or embedded finance
  • Undergraduate degree required, advanced degree is a plus
  • Understand how features (micro) interface with overall product vision (macro)
  • Has a learning mindset to start developing hypothesis that are tested and iterated
  • 2+ years of experience building payments products, ideally embedded payments/payments APIs (e.g. payment processing, disbursements, card issuing, or money movement platforms). Experience building self-service products from scratch, including data definition, SDKs, and APIs consumed by software developers
  • Deep understanding of payments infrastructure — authorization/settlement flows, card networks, ACH/wire rails, or embedded finance patterns
  • Experience partnering with engineering on API design (REST/webhooks), including tradeoffs around latency, idempotency, and compliance/PCI considerations
  • Familiarity with payments-adjacent regulatory or risk considerations (KYC/KYB, fraud, chargebacks) is a plus
  • Strong ability to think through unifying elements and common denominators; dream up user workflows and interfaces;
  • Familiarity with big data frameworks
  • Data driven approach for everything you do, understanding your customers, roadmap prioritization and measuring success.
  • Ability to work in an agile fashion with your teams; go broad to go narrow; build, test, iterate
  • Ability to nurture various projects in parallel, in different stages of maturity and velocity

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in embedded payments, fintech, or developer-first platform products.
  • Experience with payment APIs, developer portals, sandbox environments, partner integrations, or data and event streams.
  • Experience modernizing payment infrastructure or closing gaps between existing platform capabilities and market expectations.
  • Familiarity with payments-related risk, regulatory, or compliance considerations.

Why this role Matters:

Embedded payments is a growth area for WEX, with investment focused on strengthening core payment platform capabilities and making it easier for partners to integrate WEX payments into their own experiences. In this role, you will have the opportunity to shape product direction in an evolving space, help modernize platform capabilities, and contribute to solutions that support Corporate Payments customers. The team combines the scale of an established company with a startup-like environment, meaningful white space, and opportunities to make a visible impact.

raw.description:
We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer who thrives on turning ambitious ideas into production systems that delight developers and deliver real business impact.

You’ll work across the stack, from backend APIs and orchestration to SDKs, dashboards, and developer tools. You’ll take ownership from start to finish, understanding user needs, designing elegant solutions, and delivering outcomes that make building with AI faster, simpler, and more creative.

You’ll collaborate across the company to build systems that are robust, performant, and a joy to work on. This role combines technical depth, product intuition, and leadership, making it ideal for engineers who want to shape both how things are built and why they matter.

Is this role a fit for you?

You are motivated by impact. You thrive on transforming complex AI systems into products that developers love to use. You think holistically about architecture, user experience, and business outcomes, and you take pride in delivering systems that are both elegant and dependable.

You are equally comfortable designing APIs, building scalable backend services, and improving developer-facing experiences. You set a high bar for quality, mentor others to reach it, and drive alignment between product ambition and technical reality.

What this role could entail

  • Lead the design and implementation of core systems powering Runware’s AI platform
  • Build and evolve backend APIs, SDKs, and developer tools that make AI integration seamless
  • Integrate and optimise image and video models while supporting new modalities such as audio and custom LLMs
  • Architect scalable, reliable systems for inference orchestration and workload optimisation
  • Partner with platform and infrastructure teams to drive performance, reliability, and observability improvements
  • Shape technical direction through architectural discussions and long-term planning
  • Mentor engineers through code and design reviews, fostering technical excellence and growth
  • Contribute to documentation, tooling, and SDKs that enhance the overall developer experience
  • Drive initiatives that improve how we build, deploy, and maintain our platform

Requirements

  • Deep experience building distributed and high-performance systems
  • Strong programming skills in PHP or Go
  • Proven track record of designing and delivering scalable backend systems and APIs
  • Understanding of asynchronous workloads, queues, and streaming data
  • Experience working with cloud and bare-metal infrastructure
  • Excellent grasp of system design, performance optimisation, and scalability principles
  • Clear communicator who leads technical projects and collaborates effectively across teams
  • Passionate about mentoring others and raising engineering standards
  • Proactive problem-solver who balances short-term progress with long-term vision
  • European time zone

Benefits

We’re a remote-first collective, meeting in person twice a year to plan, brainstorm, celebrate wins, and enjoy some face-to-face time. We have core hours for cooperative working and calls, but outside of that your calendar is yours. Work the hours that let you perform at your peak while also building a healthy life.

Our release cycles are fast and intense, but they’re followed by real downtime. After big pushes we expect the team to unplug, recharge, and come back ready & stronger than ever for the next leap.

  • Generous paid time off – vacation, sick days, public holidays
  • Meaningful stock options – share in the upside you create
  • Remote-first setup – work from home anywhere we can employ you
  • Flexible hours – own your schedule outside core collaboration blocks
  • Family leave – paid maternity, paternity, and caregiver time
  • Company retreats – twice-yearly gatherings in inspiring locations

raw.title: Senior Zoho Developer
raw.excerpt: We Are DulcedoWhat sets Dulcedo apart is that, for us, this business is not a numbers game.
raw.description:
We Are Dulcedo

What sets Dulcedo apart is that, for us, this business is not a numbers game. We are a full-service talent management agency dedicated to building lasting brands around our creators. We promote process, structure, and sustainable growth, all within an extremely collaborative setup where everyone shares the same goal: delivering white-glove service to the talents we represent and the brands who want to partner with them.

Our focus goes beyond short-term wins. It's about fostering meaningful careers, elevating creative voices, and creating long-term value for both talents and partners alike.

As the largest multidisciplinary talent management group in Canada and a leading force across North America, Dulcedo represents and manages the international careers of creators across the influencer, entertainment, sports, and gaming industries.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Senior Zoho Developer to help us accelerate the development, customization, and optimization of our internal business systems.

This isn't a traditional Zoho Administrator role. We're looking for someone who can understand a business challenge, architect a solution, and independently bring it to life.

You'll play a key role in building scalable systems, automating complex workflows, and improving how our teams operate across Finance, Accounting, Talent Management, and Operations.

We're also looking for someone who embraces AI-assisted development, using modern tools to accelerate delivery, solve complex problems, and build smarter solutions without compromising quality or security.

What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, and optimize advanced solutions across the Zoho ecosystem, including Zoho CRM, Zoho Creator, Zoho Flow, and Deluge scripting.

  • Independently architect and deliver complex technical solutions, from understanding business requirements through development, testing, and deployment.

  • Build and maintain integrations between Zoho and external platforms using APIs, webhooks, and other integration technologies.

  • Develop automations and workflows that improve operational efficiency and reduce manual processes.

  • Troubleshoot existing applications, identify root causes, and implement reliable, long-term solutions.

  • Leverage AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent technologies to accelerate development and improve productivity.

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to translate operational challenges into practical, scalable technical solutions.

  • Ensure solutions are secure, maintainable, well-documented, and built to support long-term business growth.

What We're Looking For

  • 6+ years of professional software development experience, including at least 4 years of hands-on Zoho development.

  • Advanced expertise across the Zoho ecosystem, particularly Zoho CRM, Zoho Creator, Deluge scripting, and workflow automation.

  • Proven experience independently architecting, developing, and delivering complex Zoho solutions in a production environment.

  • Strong knowledge of APIs, webhooks, system integrations, and technical troubleshooting.

  • Demonstrated experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent technologies in real development workflows.

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, including solution architecture, code quality, security, testing, and maintainability.

  • Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and take ownership of projects from beginning to end.

  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

  • A proactive, resourceful mindset and the ability to work independently with minimal oversight.

While these experience benchmarks reflect the seniority we're targeting, demonstrated ability to independently architect and deliver sophisticated Zoho solutions matters more to us than years of experience alone.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Python and/or JavaScript.

  • Experience integrating Zoho with NetSuite, ERP systems, or other enterprise applications.

  • Experience developing AI agents, AI-powered workflows, or advanced business automations.

  • Experience building technical solutions for cross-functional business operations.

Life at Dulcedo!

At Dulcedo, we believe that great work happens when people feel supported, valued, and empowered to grow.

As part of our team, you'll have access to a collaborative environment where your ideas matter, your expertise is valued, and your contributions have a direct impact on how we operate and evolve.

We also offer a range of employee benefits and initiatives designed to support your well-being, professional development, and work-life balance.

Ready to Build With Us?

If you're a technically strong, resourceful developer who enjoys solving complex challenges, taking ownership, and using AI to build smarter solutions, we'd love to hear from you.

We're especially interested in learning about the complex Zoho solutions you've personally designed and delivered and how you've incorporated AI-assisted development into your work.

Apply now and help us build the next generation of Dulcedo's internal systems!

Remote, Philippines
Salary: 45k - 72k
Experience: 3-7 Yrs
Degree: Minimum Bachelor/Preferred Masters

Shift:

  • EST: 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM

  • PH Time: 8:00 PM – 6:00 AM

Looking for Builders, Not Passengers

Most engineers are given maps.

We are looking for someone who creates the roadmap.

We are building an AI company at speed. The kind where the architecture decisions made in the next 12–18 months will define our company for the next decade.

This role is not for someone who wants a comfortable sprint cycle.

It’s for someone who wants to build systems that matter, someone who is comfortable assembling parts of an airplane while the airplane is in the air.

We are looking for a Driven and Talented Software Engineer who can operate with the ownership, speed, and sound judgment of a leader.

Someone who doesn’t wait to be pointed at problems.
Someone who hunts them and solves them graciously.

The Work

You won’t be maintaining legacy systems.

You’ll be building the core systems that drive change and impact a significant number of extremely reputable and large businesses.

That means:

  • Designing architecture that scales before the scale exists

  • Turning ambiguous ideas into production systems quickly

  • Shipping fast while protecting the parts that cannot break

  • Making technical decisions with long half-lives

You will have real ownership of critical infrastructure, product, and platform decisions.

When something blocks progress, you remove the blocker.

No drama. Just velocity.

The Kind of Engineer Who Thrives Here

This role is intentionally polarizing.

You’ll probably thrive here if:

  • You build things because you can’t help yourself

  • You care deeply about craft, performance, and elegant systems

  • You move faster than most teams while maintaining high standards

  • You learn new domains faster than most people can Google them

  • You default to ownership instead of permission

You likely have at least one project where:

  • you built something that was technically extremely difficult from scratch

  • people now depend on it

  • and you did it mostly because you wanted to see if it was possible

You have very high standards.

For your code.

For your thinking.

And especially for yourself.

 

What This Is Not

This is not:

  • a maintenance role

  • a Jira-ticket factory

  • a place to hide behind processes

  • an environment tolerant of mediocre engineering

We are building with controlled velocity:

Fast without being sloppy.

Ambitious without being reckless.

 

The Upside

If you are the right person, this will be one of the most leveraged periods of your career.

You’ll get:

  • Ownership over systems that matter

  • A small team of other high-agency builders

  • Real influence on product and architecture

  • Equity that actually means something if we win

  • A front-row seat to building an AI company’s new products from the ground up

 

The Filter

This role is not for everyone.

Most engineers prefer clear maps and tickets, predictable scope, and stable systems.

If reading this made you feel slightly uncomfortable and excited at the same time, you are probably the kind of builder we are looking for.

raw.excerpt: Founded in 2012, Bugcrowd is the preemptive security platform that unifies exposure discovery and assessment, offensive testing, and intelligence shaped by AI and human insight to help organizations avoid, discover, and validate real-world risk.
raw.description:
Founded in 2012, Bugcrowd is the preemptive security platform that unifies exposure discovery and assessment, offensive testing, and intelligence shaped by AI and human insight to help organizations avoid, discover, and validate real-world risk. Bugcrowd helps security teams move faster by identifying the exposures that matter most so they can act first and stay ahead of attackers. By combining the power of humans and AI, teams can preempt attack paths and prevent breaches. Based in San Francisco and New Hampshire, Bugcrowd is supported by General Catalyst, Rally Ventures, Costanoa Ventures, and others. Visit .

Job Summary

The Bugcrowd RL and Reasoning Team focuses on pushing the boundaries of autonomous cybersecurity by building authentic, verifiable reinforcement learning environments for world-leading foundational AI companies. As a Reinforcement Learning Engineer specializing in Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), you will design and scale automated verification pipelines that transform real-world software vulnerabilities into deterministic reward functions. In this role, you will bridge the gap between low-level security analysis and modern LLM reasoning models, engineering environments where AI agents learn to discover, exploit, and remediate software vulnerabilities with mathematical certainty. Instead of relying on subjective human feedback, your work directly powers the rigorous, verifiable reward signals that teach next-generation frontier AI models how to master complex cybersecurity domain logic. You will work at the intersection of fuzzing, dynamic program analysis, system exploitation, and scalable ML infrastructure to shape the safety and offensive/defensive capabilities of future artificial intelligence.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and deploy high-throughput RLVR (Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards) environments that evaluate LLM action sequences against deterministic execution outcomes.
  • Develop automated test harnesses, sandboxes, and verification engines that convert complex vulnerability research (e.g., memory corruption, web security, logic bugs) into binary pass/fail reward signals.
  • Integrate Bugcrowd’s Mayhem automated analysis platform and real-world vulnerability feeds into continuous, scalable RL environment generation pipelines.
  • Architect safe, isolated, and highly reproducible execution environments (using Docker, BuildKit, or Nix) capable of running thousands of simultaneous agent-driven exploitation and patching trajectories.
  • Collaborate directly with researchers at frontier AI labs including Anthropic, OpenAI, and Cohere to define standard benchmark formats, observation spaces, and verifiable evaluation metrics for cybersecurity tasks.
  • Implement precise telemetry, ground-truth verification algorithms, and trajectory logging to analyze agent reasoning paths and prevent reward hacking or false positives.
  • Build low-level instrumentation and debugging tools to monitor memory states, process executions, and network behaviors during agent interaction cycles.
  • Optimize infrastructure performance and environment reset latency to support massive-scale parallel sampling and distributed RL training workflows.
  • Benchmark and evaluate frontier AI model performance across diverse offensive and defensive security challenges, such as automated fuzzing, exploit payload generation, and patch validation.

Education, Experience, Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Understanding of RL training workflows used by modern LLM systems, specifically execution-based feedback or Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR).
  • Proficiency developing applications in Python and low-level systems programming in C, with Rust experience being a strong plus.
  • Solid understanding of software vulnerabilities, binary exploitation, fuzzing methodologies, or program analysis.
  • Experience with DevOps pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions), reproducible builds (Docker, BuildKit, Nix), and comfort working with Linux systems and low-level debugging.
  • Experience working with or building benchmark environments (e.g., CTFs, SWE-bench, security challenges, or execution sandboxes).

Preferred Experience

  • Experience designing custom reward functions, ground-truth verifiers, or automated grading engines for AI safety and reasoning models.
  • Background in low-level program analysis tools, sanitizers (e.g., ASan/MSan), compiler instrumentation, or automated exploit generation tools.
  • Proven track record of participating in or developing competitive cybersecurity benchmarks, CTFs, or open-source AI evaluation frameworks.

Working Conditions and Physical Requirements

The ideal candidate must be able to complete all physical requirements of the job with or without reasonable accommodation.

Sitting and / or standing - Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50% of the time

Carrying and / or lifting - Must be able to carry / move laptop as needed throughout the work day.

Environment - remote, work-from-home 100% of the time.

Pay Range Disclosure

At Bugcrowd, we strive for fairness, equality and to create an environment that allows our people to perform at their very best. Our compensation philosophy is to foster a collaborative community that rewards, attracts and retains the best possible talent. The provided salary details are based on US national averages and we retain the flexibility to tailor to the needs of the business.

The national estimate for the current base range for the position of $176,400 - $242,550.

This position may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary bonus program or commission plan, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Culture

  • At Bugcrowd, we understand that diversity in the workplace is vital to a company’s success and growth. We strive to make sure that people are included and have a sense of being part of making Bugcrowd not only a great product but a great place to work.
  • We regularly hear from both customers and researchers that Bugcrowd feels like a family, and we strive to maintain that internally as well.
  • Our team consists of a broad range of people: musicians, adventure sports junkies, nature lovers, parents, cereal enthusiasts, night owls, cyclists, artists—you get the point.

At Bugcrowd, we are solving security threats and vulnerabilities that are relevant to everyone, therefore we believe solving these problems takes all kinds of backgrounds. We value the perspectives and experiences people from underrepresented backgrounds bring.

Disclaimer

This position has access to highly confidential, sensitive information relating to the technologies of Bugcrowd. It is essential that the applicant possess the requisite integrity to maintain the information in the strictest confidence.

The company is authorized to obtain background checks for employment purposes under state and federal law. Background checks will be conducted for positions that involve access to confidential or proprietary information (including trade secrets).

Background checks may include Social Security verification, prior employment verification, personal and professional references, educational verification, and criminal history. Applicants with conviction histories will not be excluded from consideration to the extent required bylaw.

Any personal data you submit in connection with your application will be processed in compliance with Bugcrowd's Privacy Policy, which you may review here: .

Equal Employment Opportunity:

Bugcrowd is EOE, Disability/Age Employer.

Individuals seeking employment at Bugcrowd are considered without regards to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, or sexual orientation.

Bugcrowd is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. In keeping with our commitment, Bugcrowd will take the steps to assure that people with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations. Accordingly, if reasonable accommodation is required to fully participate in the job application or interview process, to perform the essential functions of the position, and/or to receive all other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact HR at ADA at bugcrowd.com.

raw.description:
The Program Director, Hospital Coding & Billing provides strategic and operational leadership for HURC's hospital coding and billing programs. This role serves as a senior subject matter expert and client-facing leader, evaluating revenue cycle operations, identifying performance opportunities, and implementing solutions that improve coding accuracy, reimbursement, compliance, quality, and financial outcomes.

The Program Director partners with clients and internal teams across coding, clinical documentation, billing, denials, revenue integrity, and utilization management to develop scalable solutions and optimize hospital revenue cycle performance.

Key Responsibilities

Program Leadership

  • Provide strategic and operational leadership for hospital coding and billing programs.
  • Develop program strategies, workflows, performance standards, KPIs, and implementation plans.
  • Monitor performance, identify improvement opportunities, and implement corrective action plans.
  • Develop scalable processes and best practices across multiple clients.
  • Drive improvements in coding accuracy, reimbursement, productivity, quality, and financial performance.

Hospital Coding & Billing Operations

  • Serve as a subject matter expert in inpatient and outpatient hospital coding and billing.
  • Evaluate workflows, identify operational gaps, and recommend process improvements.
  • Analyze coding accuracy, productivity, quality, reimbursement, and compliance trends.
  • Assess the impact of clinical documentation, coding, billing, and denials on financial performance.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce denials, prevent revenue leakage, and improve charge capture and claim submission.
  • Partner with CDI, coding, utilization review, denials, and revenue cycle teams to optimize outcomes.
  • Maintain current knowledge of ICD-10-CM/PCS, CPT, HCPCS, MS-DRGs, APCs, modifiers, NCCI edits, medical necessity, and payer requirements.

Client Leadership

  • Serve as a trusted advisor and senior client-facing leader.
  • Lead operational assessments, client meetings, executive presentations, and performance reviews.
  • Translate complex revenue cycle challenges into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Build relationships with hospital executives, HIM and coding leaders, revenue cycle executives, finance teams, physicians, and other stakeholders.
  • Manage client escalations and ensure timely resolution.
  • Identify opportunities to expand client relationships through additional HURC solutions.

Revenue Cycle Optimization

  • Evaluate hospital revenue cycle operations to identify performance and reimbursement opportunities.
  • Analyze the impact of coding, CDI, billing, denials, utilization, and payer behavior on financial outcomes.
  • Support initiatives to improve clean claim rates, reduce denials, accelerate reimbursement, and prevent revenue leakage.
  • Establish performance benchmarks and improvement targets with clients.
  • Monitor financial and operational results following implementation.

Analytics & Reporting

  • Analyze coding, billing, operational, and financial data to identify trends and opportunities.
  • Develop and interpret dashboards, KPIs, and performance reports.
  • Establish baselines and measurable improvement targets.
  • Evaluate productivity, quality, denial, reimbursement, and financial metrics.
  • Translate data into actionable recommendations for clients and executive leadership.
  • Partner with HURC analytics resources to develop client reporting.

Implementation & Project Management

  • Lead implementation of coding, billing, and revenue cycle programs.
  • Develop project plans, timelines, milestones, and deliverables.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams and manage implementation risks.
  • Ensure projects remain on schedule and achieve defined outcomes.
  • Communicate project status, risks, and recommendations to clients and executive leadership.

Quality, Compliance & Audit

  • Ensure programs align with applicable federal and state regulations, payer requirements, and client policies.
  • Monitor coding quality and compliance.
  • Support internal and external audits.
  • Identify compliance risks and recommend corrective action.
  • Develop quality assurance and monitoring processes.
  • Maintain appropriate documentation and audit trails.

Leadership & Team Development

  • Provide functional leadership and mentorship to coding, billing, and revenue cycle professionals.
  • Establish performance expectations and accountability.
  • Support coding and billing education and training initiatives.
  • Identify development needs and promote continuous improvement, quality, and client service.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Health Information Management, Healthcare Administration, Business, Finance, or a related field. Equivalent experience may be considered.
  • 7+ years of progressive experience in hospital coding, billing, HIM, revenue cycle, or healthcare financial operations.
  • 3+ years of leadership or program management experience.
  • Strong knowledge of inpatient and outpatient hospital coding, billing, and revenue cycle operations.
  • Experience working with healthcare clients, hospitals, health systems, or physician organizations.
  • Demonstrated experience analyzing operational and financial performance.
  • Experience leading process improvement or revenue cycle initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of payer requirements and reimbursement methodologies.
  • Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and executive communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex projects and cross-functional teams.

Preferred

  • RHIA, RHIT, CCS, CPC, COC, or other relevant HIM/coding certification.
  • Experience with EPIC or other major EHR platforms.
  • Experience with encoder, CAC, CDI, billing, or revenue cycle technology.
  • Experience with Power BI or other healthcare analytics platforms.
  • Experience with hospital denials and appeals.
  • Experience in revenue integrity.
  • Experience working with outsourced coding or revenue cycle organizations.
  • Experience managing multi-client or national healthcare programs.

Why Fresche? We don’t just keep legacy systems running — we transform them. For over a decade, Fresche Solutions has been the partner organizations trust for IBM i modernization. You’ll work from anywhere in North America, with genuine flexibility and a culture where our values actually shape the technical decisions we make every day.

The ImpactYou’llMake

This isn’t a code-and-ship role. As a Senior RPG Programmer/Analyst, you’ll lead the analysis, design, development, and maintenance of business-critical IBM i applications — architecting solutions that help clients bridge legacy reliability with modern efficiency. You’ll work independently and alongside a collaborative team, guiding clients through real challenges in their business application systems and seeing your decisions make a measurable difference.

WhatYou’llDo

  • Consult and collaborate. Partner with clients to resolve application issues, uncover business needs, and deliver solutions across the full project lifecycle.
  • Architect and develop. Analyze, design, code, and test applications using all versions of RPG and SQL.
  • Ensure quality. Safeguard application integrity through unit, integration, smoke, and other testing phases.
  • Document and communicate. Translate system architecture into clear documentation that works for technical and non-technical audiences alike.
  • Lead. Guide a small technical team when needed and run code reviews for database and logic changes.
  • Modernize. Help clients transform legacy applications into scalable, modern ILE solutions.

What You Bring

  • Proven IBM i depth — extensive, demonstrated experience on the IBM i (iSeries / AS/400) platform, with the judgment that comes from years of solving real business problems on it.
  • Business acumen — you understand the operations behind the code (distribution, manufacturing, finance, or insurance) and can spot when a technical solution actually serves the business need.
  • Advanced RPG — mastery across RPG forms, especially RPGLE, including free-form syntax and embedded SQL.
  • Database depth — expert-level DB2 application programming and database design.
  • Modern ILE fluency — strong command of modules, service programs, and binding directories.
  • Change management — comfort with structured deployment and version control processes.
  • Communication that bridges worlds — you can explain the “why” to business stakeholders and the “how” to developers with equal ease.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with major IBM i ERP systems (Infor LX, BPCS, Infor XA, MAPICS, PRMS, JDE, Frontier, HFA, and others)
  • Background in distribution, manufacturing, finance, or insurance applications
  • Familiarity with RDi or other Eclipse-based IDEs
  • Git or SVN experience in an IBM i environment
  • Impact analysis tools

raw.description:
About Hello Heart:

Hello Heart is on a mission to make heart attacks a thing of the past.

We’re an AI company focused exclusively on heart health, building a platform that predicts and prevents cardiac events before they happen—identifying risk up to 10 days in advance versus 10 years in traditional clinical models.

This is already working at scale. Hello Heart has been shown to reduce inpatient hospital days by 47% and deliver ~$1,800 in annual savings per member. Hello Heart is the cardiac prevention partner to over 80% of large U.S. health plans and serves hundreds of public and private employers.

We’re defining how the #1 cause of death—heart disease—is managed in the AI era. Join us.

About the Role

Hello Heart is hiring a Head of Investor Relations to help shape and amplify our investment story, build relationships across the capital markets, and partner with leadership on fundraising and our path toward becoming a public company.

Reporting to the CFO, this person will bring an investor’s perspective into the business and translate our strategy, performance, and momentum into a compelling story for the market. Hello Heart is a leading digital AI health business with a strong track record of growth and a mission-driven platform that is transforming how people manage cardiovascular health. This is an exciting opportunity to join a business that is executing at a high level and use this role to supercharge how we communicate our momentum and opportunity externally. Near-term priorities include an anticipated Series E financing and building the investor relationships and capabilities to support a potential IPO over the next several years

Responsibilities

  • Shape our investment story. Partner with Finance and leaders across the business to refine our positioning, connect operating performance to long-term value, and develop consistent financial and operating metrics.
  • Build capital markets relationships. Develop relationships with existing and prospective private investors, institutional investors, sell-side analysts, and investment banks. Represent Hello Heart at investor and industry conferences and in investor meetings.
  • Help lead fundraising. Work closely with the CEO and CFO on investor targeting, presentations, diligence, and follow-up. Prepare leadership for investor discussions and challenging questions.
  • Develop Board and investor communications. Partner with Finance to prepare Board materials, investor decks, and regular updates that clearly explain performance, priorities, and progress against plan.
  • Bring the market perspective inside. Analyze peers, valuations, industry trends, and investor feedback. Share insights with leadership and employees to deepen understanding of how our execution translates into company value.
  • Build public-company readiness. Partner with Finance, Legal, and Communications to establish the processes, disclosure practices, and executive preparation needed for a future IPO and ongoing public-company investor relations.

Qualifications

  • Significant experience in buy-side investing, portfolio management, equity research, investor relations, or a related capital markets role, with a strong understanding of how institutional investors evaluate companies.
  • Strong financial analysis and valuation skills, including the ability to assess growth, recurring revenue, unit economics, and the drivers of long-term value.
  • Ability to turn complex financial and business information into clear, persuasive presentations and conversations with investors, Board members, and employees.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting complex fundraising or capital markets transactions, including developing investor materials, managing diligence, and preparing senior executives for investor discussions.
  • Credibility with senior executives and investors, sound judgment with confidential information, and a collaborative approach to working across the business.
  • Willingness to be hands-on with analysis, presentations, and relationship development, including travel for meetings and conferences.
  • Technology or healthcare investment experience is valuable.
  • Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, economics, or a related field. MBA or CFA preferred.
  • Comfort using approved AI tools to improve analysis and drafting, with careful review of accuracy and protection of confidential information.

Compensation

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $235,000 to $255,000. Salary ranges are determined by role and level. Compensation is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. The compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the salary only and do not include bonus, equity, or benefits.

Hello Heart has a positive, diverse, and supportive culture - we look for people who are collaborative, creative, and courageous. Oh, and if you want to see some recent evidence of the fun things we do at Hello Heart, check out our Instagram page.

Background

The African Climate Foundation (ACF) is the first and only African-led climate change re-granting organisation on the continent. Through a combination of grant making, fellowships, transformational research, technical assistance, coalition building and advocacy the ACF seeks to support interventions at the nexus of climate change, and development that have the greatest potential to deliver long-term socio-economic transformation and inclusive development. ACF also provides Fiscal Hosting (also called Fiscal Sponsorship) services to support emerging and mission aligned organisations and initiatives.

The African Climate Foundation is seeking a highly organized and proactive Grants Coordinator to support the Head of Grants (HoG) and provide administrative assistance to the broader Grants Team. This role is critical in ensuring the efficient coordination of activities, diary management, and general administrative support to facilitate the smooth running of grants-related work.

Reporting to the Head of Grants, the Grants Coordinator provides high-level executive, administrative and coordination support. The Grants Coordinator must be exceptionally organised, proactive, analytically strong, and able to interact confidently with stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.

This is a practical support role requiring sound judgement, attention to detail and the ability to take ownership of agreed tasks. The successful candidate will work closely with colleagues across ACF to support efficient grants administration and maintain accurate, accessible records.

Meeting Administration

  • Prepare agendas, collate meeting materials and take detailed and accurate notes.
  • Record decisions and agreed actions, and follow up on progress, ensuring timely execution and reporting.

General Administrative Support

  • Assist with correspondence, reports, presentations and maintaining grants records.

Requirements include but are not limited to:

Your privacy and data security are of paramount importance to us. The ACF is committed to safeguarding your privacy and maintaining the trust you place in us.
