raw.excerpt: Job Summary: The Technical Advisor II – Malaria provides senior-level technical guidance to the AFGHS–FHI 360 core team, country programs, and national partners across the full scope of malaria programming.
raw.description:
Job Summary:


The Technical Advisor II – Malaria provides senior-level technical guidance to the AFGHS–FHI 360 core team, country programs, and national partners across the full scope of malaria programming. The role provides technical leadership from project start-up and workplan development through implementation, ensuring technical quality across existing projects and new buy-ins. Reporting to the Senior Technical Advisor, Malaria, the Advisor provides technical support to country teams, ensures budgetary and regulatory compliance, and supporting the team in the country to engage donors and stakeholders on malaria-related matters. The Advisor supports country teams to implement evidence-based interventions at health facility and community levels, in alignment with national policies, covering malaria supply chain management, diagnosis, treatment, surveillance, and quality of care. This includes supporting countries in modernizing commodity planning and gap analysis tools to reflect MOU guidelines, new malaria commodities, Global Fund GC8 data, and available supply chain information. The Advisor provides oversight to an assigned portfolio, sets strategic priorities to guide resource investments in malaria and related technical areas, establishes and monitors best practices, and leads business development efforts. The role is accountable for contributing to the development and implementation of technical, strategic, and operational plans, goals, and policies to advance malaria programming.


Key Responsibilities

As part of the Technical Advisor II – Malaria's broader support to the malaria portfolio, the Advisor works with country teams to support the Ministries of Health, national malaria control/elimination programs (NMCPs/NMEPs), laboratories, and research partners to translate supply chain, clinical, prevention, and surveillance evidence into improved policies and services, particularly for underserved populations. Specific functions include:

1. Malaria Commodities, Supply Chain Coordination, and risk analysis:

  • Lead development of supply plans, including dashboards, risk summaries, and visual products that highlight current and projected stockouts, procurement delays, funding gaps, overstock, and expiry risks for internal and donor reporting.
  • Data Analysis & Risk Monitoring including collecting, validating, analyzing, and synthesizing forecasting, inventory, procurement, shipment, and consumption data; develop and maintain methodologies to track stock-out/overstock risks, expiries, pipeline gaps, and funding shortfalls; and monitor supply chain performance indicators to enable proactive mitigation.
  • Cross-Country Coordination: Produce country-level and cross-country commodity availability analyses and collaborate with technical, program, and country teams to ensure data consistency and timely reporting.

2. Malaria Case Management

  • Provide technical leadership for malaria case management strategies, guidelines, training, and implementation at health facility and community levels.
  • Advise national programs on accurate diagnosis and appropriate management of uncomplicated and severe malaria, malaria in pregnancy, and malaria in vulnerable populations.
  • Support evidence-informed introduction and monitoring of multiple first-line therapies (MFT), where appropriate, to help preserve antimalarial efficacy and manage resistance risks.

3. Malaria Prevention

  • Advise on ITN product selection, campaign and routine distribution strategies, coverage and use, and durability and bioefficacy monitoring, in collaboration with supply chain teams.
  • Support residual efficacy assessments, including cone bioassays, and timely corrective or mop-up actions where performance falls below agreed standards.
  • Lead technical support for context-appropriate introduction, implementation, evaluation, and potential scale-up of spatial emanators and other promising vector control tools.
  • Assess scientific evidence, PMI guidance, national regulatory requirements, product safety, acceptability, cost, and operational feasibility before recommending deployment.
  • Develop implementation protocols, monitoring indicators, learning agendas, and practical guidance with national programs, product developers, and research partners.

4. Country Technical Assistance and Quality Improvement

  • Provide remote and in-country support to country teams; review workplans, technical approaches, curricula, budgets, and monitoring plans.
  • Assess clinical and operational performance through field visits, supportive supervision, and mentorship; work with national partners to implement corrective actions.
  • Strengthen adherence to malaria diagnosis and treatment standards through clinical audits, job aids, quality indicators, and continuous quality improvement.
  • Facilitate cross-country learning and adaptation of effective practices.

5. Community Case Management and Integrated Service Delivery

  • Strengthen iCCM and referral pathways for malaria and common childhood illnesses, with emphasis on remote, mobile, displaced, and underserved populations.
  • Build community health worker capacity in fever assessment, authorized diagnostic testing, appropriate treatment, danger-sign recognition, pre-referral care, and referral follow-up.
  • Improve linkages between communities and facilities for supervision, reporting, commodities, and continuity of care; coordinate with maternal, newborn, child health, and nutrition teams.

6. Malaria Surveillance, Data Use, and Performance Monitoring

  • Work with surveillance, monitoring and evaluation, and health information teams to improve completeness, quality, interpretation, and use of case management data.
  • Support DHIS2 and other national reporting systems, dashboards, performance reviews, and routine use of diagnostic, treatment, referral, and outcome indicators.
  • Use epidemiological and program data to inform risk stratification, subnational tailoring, resource prioritization, and corrective actions.
  • Contribute to technical reports, evaluations, policy briefs, and learning products.

7. Partnerships, Innovation, and Program Development

  • Represent FHI 360, as requested, in malaria case management, surveillance, diagnostics, and therapeutic efficacy technical forums.
  • Build collaboration with Ministries of Health, NMCPs/NMEPs, WHO, donors, academic institutions, laboratories, and implementing partners.
  • Provide technical input to proposals, country strategies, new program designs, and operational research opportunities.
  • Assess emerging diagnostics, medicines, digital tools, and delivery approaches for safe, effective, and context-appropriate adoption; identify opportunities for integration with primary health care and global health security.

8. Technical and Professional Competencies

  • Sound knowledge of PMI malaria guidance, malaria supply chain system, prevention and case management, and iCCM.
  • Strong analytical, technical writing, facilitation, and presentation skills; ability to communicate scientific findings to policymakers and implementers.
  • Demonstrated ability to support multidisciplinary teams, manage competing priorities, build partnerships, and work effectively across diverse country contexts.
  • Commitment to scientific integrity, national ownership, safeguarding, and sustainable capacity strengthening.

Desired Professional Profile

  • The ideal candidate combines rigorous clinical and public health expertise with practical malaria program implementation experience, works effectively with senior government counterparts and frontline teams, and can translate emerging evidence into feasible improvements in service quality and treatment outcomes.

Required Qualifications

Education

  • Minimum master's degree in public health, infectious diseases, epidemiology, clinical medicine, or a closely related discipline. Clinical degree preferred.
  • Additional training in malaria surveillance, malaria in pregnancy, malaria vaccines, supply chain, or vector control is desirable; project management certification is an advantage.
  • Project Management (PM) Certification preferred.

Professional Experience

  • At least 12 years of progressively responsible experience providing technical leadership in malaria.
  • Demonstrated experience advising Ministries of Health and national malaria programs and developing case management policies, clinical guidelines, training materials, or quality improvement approaches.
  • Strong experience in malaria prevention, diagnosis and treatment, including facility- and community-based services, with experience integrating malaria services into maternal, newborn, and child health platforms.
  • Ability to analyze surveillance and program data and translate evidence into practical recommendations for policy and implementation.
  • Professional fluency in written and spoken English is required.
  • Proficiency in additional languages such as French an advantage.
  • Experience with major international donor-funded malaria programs and regional or multicountry technical assistance is an advantage.

Typical Physical Demands:

  • Typical office environment.
  • Ability to spend long hours looking at a computer screen and doing repetitive work on a keyboard.
  • Ability to sit and stand for extended periods of time. Ability to lift/move up to 5 lbs.

Technology to be Used:

  • Laptop, Microsoft applications (i.e., Office 365, SharePoint, Skype/Zoom/Teams), cell phone/mobile technology, and standard office equipment.

Travel:

  • 10 – 25% periodic international travel to malaria-endemic countries is required for technical assistance, program reviews, supervision, research collaboration, and partner engagement; frequency will depend on program needs.

You will be the first line of the bank's overnight fraud defence: monitoring the real-time alert queue, triaging and dispositioning alerts within SLA, and escalating anything complex or high-risk to the L2 analyst and senior investigator. Benefits

  • Competitive monthly consultancy fee for the fixed term, inclusive of shift premium.

We are fully remote and would welcome applicants from South America, North America and Canada. We work in English, so excellent written and spoken English is essential.

Freelancing at Human Made

Join Human Made as a freelancer and you’ll feel like part of the team. You’ll be working on interesting and complex projects, alongside some of the industry's top talent. We’re fully remote, and have been for over 10 years, so you can expect well established ways of working, and a vibrant online culture.

Once you are qualified, you'll be added to our freelance talent pool and be invited to projects that suit your availability and expertise as soon as they become available, which might not be immediately. Once you are booked on a project, you will integrate as part of the team, so you are expected to join team meetings and activities (although we have a strong emphasis on asynchronous communication).

The Scrum Master Role at Human Made

As a Scrum Master you will create self-organising teams that are flexible and fully productive during sprints, with the goal of creating high performing teams. To do this you should be able to plan deliverables and help teams monitor their performance. You should have a thorough understanding of scrum/agile concepts, and can apply them through coaching and mentoring. You understand value, as it applies to the companies we work with and its alignment with our own priorities, and you are consistent in pursuing it.

Responsibilities:

These are the main areas of focus for a Scrum Master:

Applying Scrum To Produce High Quality Work

  • Manage each projects scope and timeline
  • Create and maintain a team culture that facilitates a shared responsibility for successful delivery
  • Guide team on principles and practice of the agile framework being used in the project
  • Work with team to help define and refine project scope, estimates, and resource requirements for projects
  • Prepare and facilitate workshops (either virtual or in-person) to establish project needs and relationships
  • Facilitate meetings to monitor project progress and resolve any issues the team may be experiencing
  • Remove impediments or guide the team to remove impediments
  • Assess the time and financial impact of scope change and communicate to stakeholders as appropriate
  • Identifies when to use experiments for learning and solutioning

Accountability To The Business

  • Be commercially aware: Understand the status of the budget of your projects and be able to report on them back to the company
  • Allocation management of project needs in conjunction with your squad composition

Building And Safeguarding Relationships

  • Facilitate wider engagement with internal and external stakeholders, and partners engaged in delivery
  • Build a partnership relationship with clients, understanding their business imperatives as context for helping align the team on those goals
  • Understand the workings and needs of the account you are partnered with
  • Communicate regularly; be proactive in facing difficult conversations
  • Manage your interactions with clients and internal team professionally, and personably
  • Using data to allow the team and wider business to make critical decisions

Striving For Great Work

  • Develop creative and technical judgement and strive for high quality output
  • Share progress and communicate to internal and external stakeholders
  • Conduct team reviews and retrospectives to promote continuous improvement
  • Endorse and present appropriate metrics to sustain continuous improvement to get the best out of each team. Report progress, team status, and issues across the board.

Requirements

  • Scrum Master certification or qualification, or equivalent work experience
  • Experience applying scrum, a wider awareness of agile principles, and a data driven mindset
  • Enterprise agency environment experience
  • Highly developed skills in servant leadership, facilitation, situational awareness, conflict resolution, continual improvement, empowerment, and increasing transparency
  • Experience in using a wide range of project management tools such as, budget/time tracking tools and issue tracking software with the depth of knowledge to recommend the right tools for a project
  • Proficiency in written and oral communication in English, and ability to utilise and parse through technical terminology comfortably
  • Broad understanding of web technologies such as HTML/HTML5, CSS, CMS, Javascript, and version control

Benefits

Whether you are a freelancer, or a permanent member of the team, we want all Humans to have a fantastic experience, and benefit from Human Made’s people focused approach to work.

  • Gain experience working in an agency, without a long term commitment
  • Work alongside some of the WordPress industry’s top engineers

Role Overview

As a Product Manager, you will be responsible for the entire product lifecycle, from initial concept to launch and beyond. You'll act as the central hub, working with stakeholders and clients to define product roadmaps and success metrics.

A key part of your role will be to deeply understand customer and business needs and translate them into clear, actionable requirements for the development team. You will own the product backlog, analyze performance data to identify opportunities, and partner closely with design and engineering to ensure successful execution

Key Responsibilities

  • Product Strategy & Execution: You will define and document product requirements, create and maintain a prioritized backlog, and ensure business needs are met throughout the design, development, and delivery phases.
  • Data-Driven Decision Making: You will use your strong analytical and problem-solving skills to gather, analyze, and interpret data to prove or disprove hypotheses and guide product evolution. Expertise in Excel and SQL is essential for this.
  • Stakeholder & Client Management: You will communicate with internal and external teams, including clients, to manage expectations, present product status, and gather feedback. Strong consultative, listening, and presentation skills are crucial.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: You will coordinate with various teams—including design, engineering, sales, and support—to build, manage, and evolve the product. A solid understanding of software engineering concepts will help you drive product strategy effectively

Requirements

What We're Looking For
  • Product Mindset: You'll be a central figure, coordinating with various teams to build and support the product
  • Agile Experience: You must have experience working within Agile and Extreme Programming methodologies in a continuous deployment environment
  • Technical Acumen: You should have a solid understanding of software engineering concepts to help drive product strategy
  • Exceptional Communication: You should have strong consultative, listening, and presentation skills to effectively communicate with clients and stakeholders
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills: We need someone with a strong ability to understand complex business environments and to dive into data using Excel and SQL to derive meaningful insights.

Benefits

What We Offer

Work Environment
  • Remote-First Culture: At Incubyte, we thrive on a culture of structured flexibility — while you have control over where and how you work, everyone commits to a consistent rhythm that supports their team during core working hours for smooth collaboration and timely project delivery. By striking the perfect balance between freedom and responsibility, we enable ourselves to deliver high-quality standards our customers recognize us by. With asynchronous tools and push for active participation, we foster a vibrant, hands-on environment where each team member’s engagement and contributions drive impactful results.

raw.excerpt: About EpicEpic is a digital reading platform for kids, giving children instant access to thousands of high-quality books, audiobooks, and learning videos.
raw.description:
About Epic

Epic is a digital reading platform for kids, giving children instant access to thousands of high-quality books, audiobooks, and learning videos. Teachers and librarians across the country use Epic School Plus to build reading habits in their classrooms. Our mission is to spark curiosity and a lifelong love of reading in every child.

Position Overview

The Integration Specialist is responsible for the successful implementation, configuration, monitoring, troubleshooting, and ongoing maintenance of Epic School Plus integrations with third-party platforms, including Clever, ClassLink, and SchoolDay.

The Integration Specialist works directly with school and district technology administrators and collaborates with Partner Success, Customer Experience, Product, Engineering, Sales, and external integration partners to resolve technical issues and improve the overall customer experience.

The ideal candidate combines technical troubleshooting skills with strong communication, organization, and customer service abilities. They can investigate complex data and access issues, explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences, and take ownership of issues through resolution.

What you'll do

  • Set up, configure, and launch Clever and ClassLink integrations (rostering and SSO) for new and renewing school and district customers.

  • Serve as the technical point of contact for district IT admins during onboarding, from data-sharing approval to first successful sync.

  • Troubleshoot sync and login issues: missing students, duplicate accounts, incorrect class or teacher associations, and SSO errors.

  • Monitor integration health across accounts and proactively fix sync failures before they affect classrooms.

  • Manage the Epic apps in the Clever and ClassLink partner portals, including app settings, data-sharing scopes, and district requests.

  • Partner with Engineering to reproduce bugs, write clear tickets, and test fixes and new integration features.

  • Coach Customer Success, Support, and Sales on how integrations work and how to set expectations with customers.

  • Build and maintain help-center articles, internal runbooks, and setup guides for admins and teachers.

  • Track integration metrics (time to launch, sync error rates, ticket volume) and recommend process improvements.

  • Support back-to-school peaks, when rostering volume is highest.

What you bring

  • 2+ years in a technical support, implementation, or integration role, ideally in K–12 edtech.

  • Hands-on experience administering or supporting Clever and/or ClassLink (rostering, SSO, or both).

  • Solid understanding of K–12 rostering data: students, teachers, sections, schools, and how a student information system (SIS) feeds them.

  • Working knowledge of SSO concepts (OAuth, SAML) and identity providers like Google Workspace and Microsoft Entra ID.

  • Comfort working with CSVs, spreadsheets, and API responses to diagnose data issues.

  • Clear, patient communication with both non-technical teachers and district IT staff.

  • Strong organization: you can run many district setups in parallel and keep each one moving.

  • Familiarity with student data privacy requirements (FERPA, COPPA, state privacy agreements).

Nice to have

  • Clever or ClassLink certification, or prior work at either company or a district using them.

  • Experience with other rostering standards and tools: OneRoster, Google Classroom, Microsoft Teams for Education, or SIS platforms like PowerSchool and Infinite Campus.

  • Basic SQL or scripting (Python, JavaScript) for data checks.

  • Experience with Zendesk, Salesforce, Jira, or similar tools.

  • Background as a teacher, school technology coordinator, or district IT admin.

Compensation:$35–$40perhour,upto30hoursperweek.

raw.excerpt: Pets deserve the best care.  At Vetsource, we build the foundation for success, enabling those in the pet healthcare profession and industry to thrive.
raw.description:
Pets deserve the best care. At Vetsource, we build the foundation for success, enabling those in the pet healthcare profession and industry to thrive. Our data-powered platform simplifies processes and streamlines systems, helping those we serve create tighter bonds with their customers. From prescription management and pet owner engagement to veterinary business performance data and insights, Vetsource provides comprehensive solutions that give our customers more time and flexibility, and help them foster strong relationships and positive experiences. In a rapidly evolving world, we’re constantly seeking new ways to help our customers chart a course for a better, brighter future for pets and those who care for them.

If you love pets, want to have an impact and join a fantastic organization, Vetsource could be the place for you.

At Vetsource, our teams, much like our customers, are represented through diverse perspectives, life experiences, unique strengths (and love for animals). We are an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace.

We are a team of real people looking for great people to join us, which is why applications are carefully and thoughtfully reviewed by our team. We know that when considering a new opportunity, it's common to weigh your qualifications against the listed job criteria. That said, even if you don’t meet 100% of the job requirements but feel you would be a good fit for the role, we still encourage you to apply!

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

P&O Generalist, Leave of Absence

As a member of the P&O Total Rewards team, the P&O Generalist, Leave of Absence supports our associate leave and ADA accommodation programs to drive attraction and retention of our diverse workforce. This role is responsible for managing and overseeing all aspects of associate leave and accommodation programs for US and Canada, including but not limited to Paid Time Off, sick leave, Paid Parental Leave, family and medical leave, and other types of leave and ADA requests. This role ensures compliance with relevant laws and regulations, provides support to associates and managers, and maintains accurate records related to leave management and accommodations.


This is a full-time, remote position. This is a temporary position expected to end in December 2027.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Manage the leave of absence program in accordance with company policies and applicable laws, partnering with the manager and P&O BP and working closely with the leave provider and associates to ensure seamless leave experiences.
  • Coordinate with our leave vendor to track various types of leave, including FMLA, short-term disability, long-term disability, and other statutory and non-statutory leave programs.
  • Provide guidance on leave-related regulations and policies to associates and management; work with managers to ensure proper coverage and workflow during associate absences.
  • Subject matter expert in our time off plans in both policy interpretation and HRIS set up.
  • Serve as the point of contact for ADA-related inquiries and issues from associates and managers, offering guidance on reasonable accommodations and assisting in the accommodation process.
  • Maintain accurate records of ADA compliance efforts, accommodations provided, and any issues addressed.
  • Prepare reports on ADA compliance status and provide recommendations for improvements to management.
  • Evaluate and recommend improvements to leave policies and processes to enhance efficiency and associate satisfaction.
  • Partner with payroll to ensure leaves are paid correctly in coordination with state paid leave programs.
  • Manage the Knowledge Base with all policies and leave-related information and instructions.
  • Prepare and maintain documentation to support compliance audits and legal inquiries.
  • Generate and review reports related to leave trends, usage, and compliance as needed.
  • Develop and update leave-related materials and resources, staying up-to-date with federal, state, and local leave regulations to ensure company policies are compliant with legal requirements.
  • Conduct training sessions for associates and managers on leave policies and procedures.
  • Ensure compliance with local, national, and state regulations and applicable employment laws, and update policies and procedures when necessary.
  • Aid in reviewing and updating personnel procedures and policies, including upkeep of the associate handbook, providing guidance and interpretation for business operations.
  • Serve as primary backup support for Benefits and support other P&O team members as needed, including special projects, people initiatives, and other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 5+ years experience in Human Resources with emphasis in leave administration and policy design.
  • Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in human resources, business administration, or related field.
  • Knowledge of associate benefits and applicable laws.
  • Results oriented with the ability to collaborate and work with stakeholders and HR Centers of Excellence to achieve desired outcomes.
  • Knowledge and understanding of applicable federal, state, and local laws pertaining to benefits administration, including ERISA, COBRA, FMLA, ADA, and SECTION 125.

Preferred Experience and Qualifications:

  • Knowledge of Workday software.
  • Experience with Canadian leave of absence.

WORKING CONDITIONS

  • Reliable internet access is required.
  • Sitting/standing at a desk working on a computer for long periods of time.

WHAT CAN YOU EXPECT FROM VETSOURCE

In addition to an inclusive and welcoming culture, Vetsource also offers:

  • Competitive pay and benefits including medical, vision*, dental, and life insurance

  • Employee Assistance Program

  • Pet insurance* and Virtual vet care

  • PTO, Holidays, Floating Holidays, and Volunteer Day

  • Retirement Savings Plan (401k/ RRSP) with employer matching program

  • Paid parental leave

  • Flexible scheduling and remote work where possible

  • The opportunity to join one of our Associate Resource Groups, and fun company events!

For Canadian based associates these specific benefits are not included*

OUR VALUES

Vetsource is proud to be part of Mars Science & Diagnostics, a division of Mars Petcare—a family-owned organization rooted in the belief that pets make the world a better place. Our unified culture is built on a foundation of veterinary excellence and guided by a shared vision, inspiring everyone to create A Better World for Pets™ — a world where pets are healthy, happy, and welcome.

Today, Vetsource drives the future of pet health centered on our guiding philosophy, The Five Principles: Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency, and Freedom. These principles define how we work, how we treat one another, and how we serve the veterinary community, ensuring a culture where every associate has the opportunity to thrive.

Pay range (US based applicants): $81,606 - $90,000 (annualized)

Actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to job-related skills, experience, certifications, relevant education and training, while also considering internal equity.

The background check will only be initiated after a conditional offer of employment has been made and will be subject to an individualized assessment, as required by law. raw.title: Senior Manager, Finance Transformation
raw.excerpt: Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential.
raw.description:
Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

ŌURA is scaling fast, and Accounting's transformation work is racing to keep up — that's where you come in. As Senior Manager, Finance Transformation, you'll turn a fragmented set of systems requests, close and control needs, and process-improvement work into one prioritized, governed roadmap, with real, visible impact on how a newly public company operates.You'll be the connective tissue between Accounting, Business Systems/IT, and external partners — building the operating cadence, prioritization framework, and governance that let Accounting make clear trade-offs and move the highest-value work forward, with direct exposure to senior leadership. ŌURA is a hyper-growth environment — this role calls for agility and a practical, disciplined approach.Reporting to the Finance Transformation Lead, this role partners closely with Accounting leadership and Business Systems, with strong ties to external advisors supporting SOX readiness and close acceleration.

This is a remote role based in the US.

What You Will Do:

Stakeholder Partnership & Communication

  • Act as a trusted, collaborative partner across Accounting, Business Systems/IT, FP&A, and external advisors — flexing communication style and depth by audience, from technical detail with operators to decision-ready framing for leadership.
  • Facilitate cross-functional meetings and build alignment behind the scenes, keeping discussions on track and surfacing decisions before they hit leadership forums — especially when priorities conflict.
  • Serve as the primary Accounting partner for IT triage — translating incidents, enhancement requests, and defects into well-scoped tickets, severity assessments, and business impact statements — and partner with Business Systems on requirements, prioritization, testing, and release readiness for NetSuite and connected finance tools (e.g., Zip, FloQast, Workiva).
  • Establish a clear triage/escalation process so urgent close, reporting, and control-impacting issues are tracked to resolution across both Accounting and IT.
  • Coordinate external consultants and implementation partners toward sustainable, internally-owned outcomes.

Portfolio Management & Governance

  • Own the project-management discipline for the Finance Transformation portfolio: integrated plans, milestones, dependencies, RAID tracking, decision logs, and escalation.
  • Build and maintain the dashboards and tracking tools that give leadership and stakeholders self-serve visibility into status.
  • Consolidate active transformation, systems, and process-improvement work into one prioritized, tiered portfolio with clear owners and expected outcomes.
  • Prepare concise, decision-oriented updates for leadership that surface trade-offs, blockers, and decisions needed.
  • Establish and track key operating metrics (e.g., cycle times, remediation progress, portfolio health) to give leadership ongoing visibility into transformation impact.

SOX Readiness & Controls

  • Convert control gaps, substantive errors, and audit observations into prioritized remediation plans with clear owners, due dates, and evidence requirements — and drive root-cause analysis so recurring errors get durable fixes.
  • Partner with control owners across close, reporting, and systems to sequence remediation based on risk, supporting SOX Year 1 readiness and broader public company reporting requirements.
  • Close Acceleration & Process Improvement
  • Drive cross-functional initiatives that improve close cadence, reconciliation quality, and visibility into period-end risk across multiple entities.
  • Build repeatable mechanisms for tracking close blockers, root causes, and remediation progress.

First-Year Success Measures

  • One prioritized portfolio, built on a shared People-Process-Technology framework: transformation work lives in a single view, with each item tied to a clear problem, priority tier, owner, and expected outcome.
  • SOX and control readiness: high-risk control gaps and remediation plans have clear ownership, evidence expectations, and escalation paths supporting SOX Year 1 and public company reporting readiness.
  • Sustainable operating improvements: priority initiatives produce measurable gains in close execution, control quality, or cycle time — backed by a track record as a trusted, collaborative partner across Accounting, IT, and external advisors.

What you'll bring

  • You have 9+ years of progressive experience in finance transformation, accounting operations, internal audit, finance systems, or process improvement, including leading cross-functional projects.
  • You bring strong project/program management skills — integrated planning, dependency management, risk/issue escalation, and executive reporting. PMP or equivalent a plus.
  • You have solid accounting fluency (close, reconciliations, journal entries, controls) and can translate business needs into system and process requirements.
  • You've partnered with IT/Business Systems on intake, incident triage, prioritization, and release management.
  • You've worked with SOX, internal controls, or financial reporting risk remediation in a public-company or late-stage pre-IPO environment.
  • You're comfortable in a dynamic, hyper-growth environment — practical and feasible-first rather than rigid, and quick to adjust as priorities shift.
  • You're a trusted, collaborative partner across finance, IT, and external stakeholders, with excellent written and verbal communication — able to flex style and depth by audience and facilitate meetings productively when priorities conflict. Experience building or rebuilding a team or function is a plus.
  • You have hands-on NetSuite experience; exposure to multi-entity, international operations (intercompany, FX, consolidation) is a plus.
  • You hold a bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or Information Systems; CPA preferred.

Benefits

At ŌURA, we care about you and your well-being. Everyone here at ŌURA has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health.

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary and equity packages
  • Health, dental, vision insurance, and mental health resources
  • An Ōura Ring of your own plus employee discounts for friends & family
  • 20 days of paid time off plus 13 paid holidays plus 8 days of flexible wellness time off
  • Paid sick leave and parental leave

ŌURA takes a market-based approach to pay, which may vary depending on your location. US locations are categorized into tiers based on a cost of labor index for that geographic area. While most offers will be closer to the starting range, successful candidates' pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, internal peer equity, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future.

  • Region 1: $170,000 - $200,000
    Region 2: $154,000 - $182,000
  • Region 3: $139,000 - $164,000

A recruiter can determine your Region based on your US location.

We are not considering candidates residing in the following states: Alaska (AK), Delaware (DE), Iowa (IA), Mississippi (MS), Nebraska (NE), South Dakota (SD), West Virginia (WV), and Wisconsin (WI).

Oura is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Individuals seeking employment at Oura are considered without regard to age, ancestry, color, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, protected family care or medical leave status, race, religion (including beliefs and practices or the absence thereof), sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. We will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics.

We will work to ensure individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

We’ve been alerted to scammers posing as ŌURA recruiters, especially for remote roles. Please note:

Stay cautious and protect your personal details.

POSITION SUMMARY:

Are you ready to make a real impact on people's lives and be a part of a rapidly-growing team? Natera is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to help design, develop, and maintain our web portal application serving providers. As a member of our engineering team, you will play a key role in improving the user experience and functionality, ultimately helping to positively impact patient outcomes. Join us in our mission to change the way cancer is managed, and be a part of a team of dedicated professionals who are passionate about making a difference.

Senior Software Engineer - Portal Application is responsible for the design, development, and maintenance of microservices for our provider-facing web portal. The role requires working with a mix of modern and legacy technologies in a rapidly changing environment and the ability to adapt quickly to new technologies and systems. Together with the talented Engineering Team, Product Managers and Designers, you will work on new and exciting experiences for our customers.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Participate in design and technical implementation decisions and help guide key stakeholders on the team, such as product managers, UI/UX designers, to ensure that design and technical decisions meet a high standard of excellence.
  • Work closely with Product Managers to gather requirements, walk through the design with stakeholders, and support software all the way from initial ideation to release, operation, and maintenance.
  • Participate in designing, building, and maintaining highly available systems to support our business applications, users, providers, and patients.
  • Perform code reviews and mentor the development team with best practices.
  • Continue improving process and procedure and evangelizing best practices.
  • Support QA activities in conjunction with our QA engineering teams.
  • Be a contributing team member to the end-to-end execution of compliance initiatives.
  • This role works with PHI on a regular basis both in paper and electronic form and have access to various technologies to access PHI (paper and electronic) in order to perform the job.
  • Must complete training relating to HIPAA/PHI privacy, General Policies and Procedure Compliance training and security training as soon as possible but not later than the first 30 days of hire.
  • Must maintain a current status on Natera training requirements.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • BS degree in computer science, comparable program, or equivalent.
  • 6+ years of overall software development experience, preferably secure, scalable web applications with NodeJS, TypeScript, React, and other web technologies.
  • Experience with front-end development.
  • Experience with software development lifecycle process from build, software configuration, change control, release and deployment activities.
  • Extensive knowledge and experience with Test-Driven Development and/or Domain-Driven Development Experience with service-oriented and microservice architecture.
  • Experience building, maintaining, troubleshooting, and expanding software within the AWS ecosystem: EC2, ECS, Lambda, Step Functions, SQS, SNS, S3, etc.
  • Experience with GraphQL and REST API design and event-driven architecture using distributed event stores (such as Kafka).
  • Experience with micro-service enterprise architecture, cross-platform integration, and building scalable applications in heterogeneous environments.
  • Strong relational database skills including database design and optimization.
  • Demonstrated teamwork skills with a solid analytical background.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, presentation, and facilitation skills.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

  • Linux Fundamentals
  • Object Oriented Programming
  • Relational Database and SQL Programming, prefer MySQL or PostgreSQL
  • JavaScript Programming
  • Java Programming is nice to have
  • SQL and NoSQL database experience including MySQL, ElasticSearch, and DynamoDB
  • AWS Services, such as EC2, Lambdas, Step Functions, SQS, S3, and SNS
  • Build infrastructure as code with Terraform and Cloud Formation
  • Docker or container-oriented technologies
  • GraphQL and REST APIS
  • Event-Driven Microservice Architecture
  • Experience with front-end technologies such as NextJS, React, Sass, Material, HTML, CSS, Javascript, NodeJS.
  • CI / CD (Gitlab)
  • Quality Assurance Mindset
The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations.
Remote USA
$125,600—$157,000 USD

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

Position Overview

The Business Manager is a role within Kimball Electronics (KE) Shared Services. It is a global position that will be responsible for managing and growing our engagement with a several Medical customers by developing long-term relationships and exceeding growth expectations.

Quick Summary

The person in this role will spend much of their time identifying and landing new business from their assigned customers through engagement with their globally dispersed sourcing, engineering and divisional teams. Activities will include a combination of effective marketing activities, successful communication of the KE package of value (POV), identifying influencers and decision makers while building strong relationships. To be successful the candidate must be self-motivated, possess excellent communication skills, a positive attitude, and be able to land new opportunities. The person in this role must also enjoy learning about and working with different cultures (US, Mexico, China, Thailand, Romania, and Poland) and build followership with customers as well as within the Kimball Electronics organization.

Basic Background Requirements

This position will require:

  • Working independently and remote from Kimball Electronics facilities.
    • This is a remote position, ideally based in the Mid-west or east coast. Other locations may also be considered
  • The ability to identify influencers and decision makers to build connections and identify new opportunities.
  • Experience with medical customers and understanding of medical quality and regulatory requirements and what it takes to grow revenue at pace.
  • The ability to lead specific project or account teams (without direct reports) in support of assigned customer needs.
  • Detailed orientated and responsive to customer needs. The ability to maintain salesforce.com customer, opportunity and quote data.
  • Experienced in the development of cost models and proposals that surpass customer expectations
  • Good appreciation of strategy development and build out of an execution plan
  • Leading teams (without direct reports) through quote activity, new product introduction and product sustaining activities
  • The ability to work with all levels of the organization (Customers and internal to KEI)
  • A willingness to travel extensively; both in the USA and internationally.
  • The candidate should have an entrepreneurial spirit with the ability to resolve issues and provide creative solutions
  • Technically astute with Electronics Manufacturing Service (EMS) experience and knowledge of associated manufacturing processes
  • A bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience. Masters or MBA studies would be an additional asset.
  • Very helpful, but not required is an engineering degree or other technical training.

Key Performance Objectives

  • Short Term: (0 to 3 months)
  • Learn and understand key capabilities of each Kimball Electronics facility
  • Develop a thorough understanding of use of salesforce.com
  • Understand the Kimball Business management process.
  • Develop a deep understanding of the Kimball quote development process
  • Begin the prospecting process of identifying opportunities with assigned customer
  • Assume responsibility for assigned customer and growth strategy
  • Midterm: (3 to 18 months)
  • Identify a minimum of 1 new opportunity per month
  • Update Strategy Statement and review with internal stakeholders quarterly
  • Be clearly seen as leader driving growth of assigned account
  • Complete approximately 1 new RFQ per month.
  • Longer Term: (>18 months)
  • Consistently exceed revenue growth targets
  • Be seen as the KE go to person within KE by your assigned customer
  • Complete at least two new RFQ’s per quarter
  • Deliver win rate in excess of 75%
  • Other (ad hoc priorities):
  • Identify and lead improvement processes within the business management processes.

At Kimball Electronics we are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive work environment. If you think you might be a good fit for a role but don't necessarily meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. You may be the right candidate for this role or other roles!

raw.description:
Primary Duties and Responsibilities

  • Provide technical medical expertise and support to the Benefit Claims analysts through thorough review of claims to include evaluation and analysis of provider medical records, test results and course of treatment. Provide timely consultations with the analysts and identify when additional medical information is needed.
  • Clearly communicate the disability claim assessment, rationale and recommendation with medical directors, outside consulting physicians and analysts regarding insured’s medical condition, clinical medical findings, significance of and support for claimed limitations, appropriateness of treatment and alternatives, expected duration of claim, and potential for rehabilitation or return to work.
  • Through triaging of disability claim referrals, identify the need for and coordinate the handling of claim referrals with medical directors and outside consulting physicians. Acts as a liaison for the division with all medical resources to ensure that medical reviews are thorough and complete and adhere to the claim philosophy of the Benefits Division.
  • Effective medical education and training for new disability benefits analysts. Prepare periodic presentations to the division to help ensure efficiency and consistency in administering medical claim protocols and processes.
  • Participate and at times lead inter and intra departmental projects and committees
  • Train new DI Benefit Medical Consultants when required and participate in peer auditing
  • Occasionally partner with law department to help resolve claim medical disputes via negotiation and/or participation in litigation.

Qualifications

  • Ability to consistently assess claims independently with consistent high quality audit results in all categories
  • Strong interest in self-development with demonstrated leadership, engagement, and ability to work independently as well as with a team
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and proven ability to work effectively with others at all experience levels
  • Superior written and verbal communication skills.
  • Flexibility and willingness to change as job duties change

Utilizes understanding of medical needs and disease progression and applies contract provisions to various situations.

  • Decision Making (Expert): Makes timely, data-driven decisions by understanding the probability of success, identifying risks, gathering business requirements, and developing value statements.
  • Claims Acumen (Advanced): Applies the knowledge of claims philosophy, contracts, and policies and procedures for filing claims, assessing claims for accuracy and completeness, verifying eligibility, and adjudicating claims based on established criteria to handle complex, contestable, sensitive, and large benefit amount claims. Evaluates medical, financial, and occupational information and reviews to determine if insured meets contractual provisions while taking the state regulations or other relevant contractual information into consideration to make informed decisions. Analyzes insurance claims to determine the validity/risk of the claim, and the extent of coverage.

raw.description:
About Private Health Management

Private Health Management guides patients and families through the chaos and complexity of serious medical care, for cancer and beyond. As an independent advocate and trusted partner during healthcare's most challenging moments, our team of experts works alongside physicians to orchestrate the best treatment, advocacy, and support to deliver measurably better outcomes.

Everyone deserves great care. We make sure they get it.

About the role

As a Provider Network Specialist at PHM, you will play a critical role in expanding and strengthening the network of healthcare providers that enable our clients to access exceptional medical care. Sitting at the intersection of healthcare research, provider relationships, and technology, this role directly supports PHM’s mission to bring clarity and confidence to complex medical decisions.

You will research, evaluate, and recommend top-tier providers while helping evolve the systems and processes that support PHM’s proprietary provider intelligence. As PHM continues to scale and invest in technology-enabled workflows, you’ll contribute ideas and execution that improve efficiency, accuracy, and access across the organization.

This role is ideal for someone who is intellectually curious, highly organized, comfortable navigating complexity, and excited to use technology to improve how healthcare access works at scale.

What You’ll Accomplish

  • Build and maintain PHM’s proprietary database of elite healthcare providers, ensuring depth, accuracy, and clinical relevance
  • Expand PHM’s provider network through thoughtful research, evaluation, and relationship development
  • Support the implementation of technology-enabled processes that streamline provider management, insurance verification, and patient access
  • Conduct thorough reviews of provider credentials and healthcare programs using PHM’s gold-standard evaluation criteria
  • Partner closely with clinical, research, and operations teams to translate provider insights into actionable recommendations that impact client outcomes

How You’ll Spend Your Days

  • Proactively researching and identifying high-quality providers across a range of medical specialties
  • Evaluating providers and programs in collaboration with clinical and research partners
  • Using and improving internal tools and workflows to enhance provider data quality and operational efficiency
  • Supporting cross-functional teams by ensuring provider intelligence is accessible, accurate, and actionable
  • Contributing ideas and process improvements as PHM continues to evolve and scale

What you bring to the table

  • Availability to work Pacific Time Zone (PST) or Mountain Time Zone (MST) business hours required
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across clinical, research, and operations teams
  • A solutions-oriented mindset with the ability to navigate ambiguity, solve complex problems, and continuously improve how work gets done
  • A strong affinity for technology and process optimization; you’re an early adopter who looks for smarter, more scalable ways to work
  • A self-starter approach with strong research and analytical skills, and the ability to synthesize information across medical specialties
  • Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
  • Prior provider-facing healthcare experience and/or a degree in a healthcare-related field strongly preferred
  • Experience conducting or administering academic and/or clinical research strongly preferred
  • Prior customer service, concierge, or client-relations experience is a plus

Compensation

The target hourly rate for this non-exempt position is $26.00–$28.85 per hour.

This hourly rate is only one part of a total compensation package that also includes health, dental, and vision benefits; 401(k) with match; paid time off; PHM for PHM (our services for you and your dependents); and other benefits. Individual pay may vary from the target range based on factors including market conditions, experience, location, and other relevant business considerations.

Location

This is a remote role requiring that you live in and physically perform all work in the United States.

Next steps

Private Health Management is a remote company with employees across the United States. We’re committed to providing a thoughtful, transparent interview experience and meaningful opportunities to get to know our company, mission, and teammates through fully remote interviews. If your application is selected for interviews, you’ll hear from a member of our recruiting team to schedule next steps. Interviews will include the hiring manager, peers, and often an executive from the department.

PHM uses AI-enabled tools at certain points in the recruiting process to help identify and evaluate top talent; however, all hiring decisions are made by human reviewers.

Have a quick question about the role? Email or simply apply here.

$55,000—$60,000 USD

Cloud Platform Automation Engineer

3M Health Care is now Solventum

At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.

We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.

The Impact You’ll Make in this Role

The HIS Cloud Engineering team is seeking a Cloud Platform Developer to design, build, and enhance enterprise cloud platform capabilities that enable secure, scalable, and compliant cloud operations across commercial, government, and highly regulated cloud environments. This role focuses on developing automation, self-service infrastructure products, Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions, and platform services that accelerate application team onboarding while maintaining strong security, governance, and compliance controls. The position plays a key role in advancing cloud platform capabilities that support FedRAMP, GovRAMP, and other regulatory frameworks through automated landing zones, secure access management, and cloud-native infrastructure services. The role aligns closely with the team's ownership of cloud landing zone automation, IAM and access management services, cloud governance, infrastructure orchestration, and compliance-focused platform engineering.

As a(n) Cloud Platform Automation Engineer you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative and diverse people around the world. Here, you will make an impact by:

  • Design, develop, and maintain cloud platform automation solutions that support enterprise cloud landing zones, account provisioning, networking, governance, and infrastructure lifecycle management.
  • Develop and enhance cloud platform services and landing zone automation that support FedRAMP, GovRAMP, and other regulated environments through secure, compliant, and scalable infrastructure capabilities.
  • Develop and augment IAM and access management capabilities that enable application teams to provision and manage access through automated guardrails, policy controls, and self-service workflows.
  • Build and improve secure access management services that support just-in-time access provisioning, role-based access controls, approval workflows, and integration with enterprise identity platforms.
  • Partner with Architecture, Security, Compliance, Networking, and Application teams to evolve cloud platform products while ensuring adherence to regulatory, security, and governance requirements.
  • Develop APIs, automation workflows, and self-service capabilities that reduce manual operational effort and accelerate cloud adoption.
  • Contribute to platform reliability, monitoring, observability, and operational excellence initiatives.
  • Participate in platform roadmap planning, feature development, technical design reviews, and continuous improvement efforts across cloud engineering products.

Your Skills and Expertise

  • Bachelor or higher (completed and verified prior to start) from an accredited institution AND four (4) years of experience in software development.

OR

  • High School Diploma/GED from AND ten (10) years of experience in software development.

AND

In addition to the above requirements, the following are also required:


  • 4+ years of hands-on experience developing and supporting AWS cloud automation solutions.
  • 3+ years’ Experience with at least one scripting language (Python preferred).
  • 3+ years developing Infrastructure-as-Code technologies such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or equivalent.

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:


  • AWS Cloud Practitioner, Solutions Architect Associate, Developer Associate, or similar certification.
  • Knowledge of AWS Organizations, Control Tower, Identity Center, and enterprise governance frameworks..
  • Exposure to building or deploying solutions using serverless technologies (e.g. AWS Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge).
  • Working knowledge of core AWS services such as EC2, S3, EBS, RDS, DynamoDB, CloudWatch, Secrets Manager, and Organizations.
  • Experience using CloudFormation and/or other infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform or CDK.
  • Working knowledge of AWS security features, IAM (Identity and Access Management), and security best practices.
  • Foundational understanding of networking concepts and virtual network implementation in cloud environments, including VPC, Transit Gateway, and PrivateLink.
  • Exposure to containerization technologies such as Elastic Container Service (ECS) and Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS).
  • Awareness of healthcare regulations and external compliance standards such as HIPAA, GDPR, and NIST.

raw.description:
Company Overview

At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents. We support their journey back to health and wellness through our industry-leading solutions and services. Whether you're supporting a Fortune 500 client or a local business, developing cutting-edge technology, or providing clinical services you'll work alongside dedicated professionals who share your commitment to excellence and make a meaningful impact. Join us in fueling our mission to protect dreams and restore lives, while building your career in an environment that values collaboration, innovation, and personal growth.

Be part of a team that makes a real difference.

Job Description

This is a full-time, fully remote position with a Tuesday through Saturday schedule, 1:30 PM to 10:00 PM CT.

As a 24/7 call center operation, our Triage Clinician department offers various FT shift options including mornings, mid-days, evenings, and overnights; most schedules include one weekend day.

Qualified candidates must be located in a Compact state and hold a Compact RN License in the state in which you reside.

Bilingual Spanish/English language skills are preferred.

The Worker’s Compensation Telephone Triage Clinician position provides inbound telephone triage services remotely to injured workers while following the individual state Worker Compensation rules and regulations. Uses clinical expertise and communication skills to triage, consult, and provide recommendations for emergent and non-emergent situations. Focuses on conveying compassion and ensuring service excellence is centered on the injured worker.

Position Responsibilities:

• Make safe decisions for appropriate care using critical thinking skills
• Use departmental evidence-based protocols to triage patients
• Build and maintain solid interdependent relationships within the team
• Maintain up-to-date knowledge and skill in professional, clinical, and system areas
• Demonstrate effective written and verbal communication skills

Qualifications

  • Unencumbered RN License in state of residence required, compact state strongly preferred
  • Minimum of three years’ recent RN experience in one of the following adult clinical areas: Telephone Triage, ER, Urgent Care, Medical Surgical Unit, Occupational Medicine
  • Bilingual in Spanish Preferred
  • Ability to obtain other state licenses as required with fees reimbursed
  • Ability to function independently and learn in a virtual work environment
  • Experience using Microsoft Office Suite

This is a remote position and the successful candidate must have a safe and HIPAA compliant home office with high speed internet connection, verified by speed test.


Benefits

We’re committed to supporting your ultimate well-being through our total compensation package offerings that support your health, wealth and self. These offerings include Medical, Dental, Vision, Health Savings Accounts / Flexible Spending Accounts, Life and AD&D Insurance, 401(k), Tuition Reimbursement, and an array of resources that encourage a lifetime of healthier living. Benefits eligibility may differ depending on full-time or part-time status. Compensation depends on the applicable US geographic market. The expected base pay for this position ranges from $35.00 - $38.00 hourly, and will be based on a number of additional factors including skills, experience, and education.

The Company is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability.

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and underrepresented minorities are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Who We Are:

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

***Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

A day in the life:

The Digital Marketing Project Manager will play an integral part in the overall success of our account team’s delivery and service to our clients, serving as the communications and coordinating hub between team members and the client. This role will report directly into the Client Experience team,, and will be supported by Power’s Project Management Office (PMO).

This role will be an exceptional client-facing project manager, skilled at managing and delivering digital marketing deliverables and solutions from inception to completion. They will become part of a high-performing team that gets client deliverables completed on time, on budget and with the highest standards of quality while working in a dynamic, fast-paced and forward thinking agency environment. Working closely with clients and account teams, this role will manage multiple concurrent accounts, service lines and multi-disciplinary teams to meet our client’s strategic and tactical marketing objectives. As a key member of the account team, this role will be proactive, have excellent communication and problem-solving skills, and be confident in your ability to meticulously organize and keep your deliverables moving forward on-time without compromising quality. They will keep all stakeholders up to date with progress and overcoming all of the inevitable challenges along the way.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage multiple concurrent accounts, service lines, deliverables and cross-functional team members via web-based project management software (Asana) and various communication channels
  • Create and execute deliverable plans, and revise as appropriate to meet continuously changing needs and requirements
  • Oversee all aspects of deliverable management: scope, risk, schedule, quality, and communication to stakeholders’ fullest satisfaction
  • Support account calls through detailed recaps, captured action items, Asana task assignments and diligent follow-up on action items
  • Evaluate new work requests, identify resources needed, assign individual responsibilities, and schedule action items
  • Provide regular updates and progress reports to internal teams and/or client stakeholders
  • Conduct risk management and escalate internally within the account team to proactively mitigate issues
  • Identify areas for improvement with internal and external processes along with possible solutions

Role Requirements:

  • Minimum of three (3) years of experience leading projects and supporting client deliverables in a digital marketing agency environment
  • Strong proficiency with Asana as a work management platform
  • CAPM, CSM, PMP, PRINCE2, PMI-ACP, or equivalent preferred
  • Bachelor’s degree required
  • Subject matter familiarity in digital marketing (e.g.: SEO, SEM, Content Marketing, Display, Feeds, Paid Social, Analytics, etc.)
  • Able to thrive in fast-paced environments and embrace change
  • Professional approach and comfort with conflict management and mediation
  • Ability to direct teams effectively in task prioritization and execution as well as facilitation of multiple projects simultaneously within a high-pressure environment
  • Excellent diplomatic, interpersonal, negotiation and communications skills with tenacity to solve internal and client problems quickly
  • Process driven, highly organized and methodical with excellent time management skills, strong business ethics, and political awareness
  • An enthusiastic and committed attitude, flexible problem-solver, open to participate and promote change within the organization
  • Self-starter with ability to think independently and work autonomously

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Consistent adoption of PMO templates and processes
  • Documented time savings achieved through PM task/work ownership
  • Projects/deliverables completed and delivered on-time

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Ensuring on-time delivery of all supported digital marketing deliverables
  • Establishing operational and project management best practices on supported accounts
  • Maintaining ongoing communication between the client and account team regarding the status of all projects and deliverables

Benefits & Perks:

  • Base salary + commission opportunities
  • Medical Bonus
  • 15 paid vacation days (PTO) per year
  • Up to 4 hours per quarter for paid Volunteer Time Off (VTO) towards philanthropic endeavors
  • Fully flex work environment: full-remote, in-office, or hybrid
  • A one time 400.000 COP Work From Home (WFH) stipend automatically added to your first paycheck
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • 17 observed Colombian national holidays + 2 mental health recharge days per year
  • Legal benefits like Prima, Cesantias
  • Paid Social Security
  • Unlimited opportunities for growth & leadership within a rapidly growing firm
  • Ongoing employee development programs for personal and professional growth (Hedgehog and Vital 5s)
  • Quarterly awards including prize money and recognition for outstanding performance
  • Opportunities to be involved in company DEI initiatives

Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who strive to make an impact inside and outside of the workplace. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees' points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.
