raw.description:
Job Description Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior HR Compliance Manager to implement and sustain a robust HR compliance program across the EMENAT region (Europe, Middle East, North Africa and Turkey). Reporting into the wider HR leadership team, you will ensure adherence to applicable employment laws, regulations and internal policies, while enabling safe, high-quality and timely business operations through compliant and efficient HR practices.

In this role, you will lead risk assessments and audits, drive corrective actions through to completion, and partner with HR, Legal and business leaders to proactively manage compliance risk. As a trusted advisor and subject-matter expert, you will provide guidance that supports sound decision-making at all levels of the organisation. You will also manage and support employee investigations, including those that are complex in nature, ensuring they are handled fairly, consistently and in line with legal requirements.

Beyond regional responsibilities, you will contribute to global projects and initiatives, with the opportunity to lead cross-functional and cross-regional programmes. You will also be expected to support work outside your assigned region as business needs require.

Job Description

Core Responsibilities


Compliance Strategy and Governance

  • Drive a global-first HR compliance approach by standardizing policies, controls, and tools, and customizing locally to ensure full compliance with country-specific laws and practices.
  • Translate new regulations into actionable requirements, controls, and standard work
  • Chair or participate in regional compliance councils/working groups
  • Lead and support global initiatives and standards deployment; collaborate across regions to harmonize processes and share best practices
  • Support annual and ongoing HR compliance initiatives and projects as needed

Policy Management and Training

  • Draft, update, and harmonize HR policies, handbooks, and SOPs in partnership with Legal and Labor/Employee Relations
  • Develop and deliver training programs for HR, managers, and employees on critical topics (e.g., anti-discrimination, harassment prevention, pay, working time, leave, immigration and right to work, data privacy, and whistleblowing/speaking up)
  • Contribute to global policy alignment and change adoption across regions
  • Support HR Compliance programs related to pay transparency and equal pay requirements (including the EU Pay Transparency Directive and UK gender pay gap reporting) in partnership with Total Rewards and Legal

Investigations and Case Management

  • Manage and support regional employee investigations, including case assignment and investigation reviews
  • Conduct investigations that are complex in nature (e.g., multi-jurisdictional, senior leaders, potential regulatory exposure, or sensitive allegations)Partner with Legal, Employee Relations, and Security on investigatory strategy, privileged matters, and remediation
  • Ensure investigations comply with local requirements, including data protection (e.g., GDPR and UK GDPR), whistleblower protection and anti-retaliation rules, and any employee representative involvement
  • Drive investigation standards and reporting of metrics to stakeholders, including time to close, case volume, and trends
  • Support global cases as needed

Advisory and Regulatory Response

  • Provide expert guidance on complex employee relations, regulatory issues, and HR compliance requirements
  • Partner with Legal on labor inspectorate and other regulatory authority inquiries, employment tribunal or court claims, complaints, and remediation plans
  • Support due diligence and integration for M&A or site transitions, including cross-border regulatory considerations
  • Support Labor/Employee Relations and Legal relative to HR compliance aspects of works council, trade union, and employee representative information and consultation obligations, in partnership with Labor/Employee Relations and Legal

Regulatory Intelligence and Reporting

  • Monitor evolving laws and regulations across the region; maintain a regulatory calendar
  • Ensure timely filings, certifications, and statutory reports
  • Prepare executive updates, dashboards, and compliance metrics; contribute to global reporting where required

Global Projects and Cross-Regional Support

  • Lead or support global HR compliance projects, tool deployments, and change initiatives
  • Provide subject-matter support outside the assigned region as needed; coordinate with global and regional leaders to ensure consistent implementation
  • Share best practices and lessons learned across regions to improve efficiency and effectiveness
  • Serve as sub-risk focal for one or more Labor risk areas.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business or Law, or equivalent professional experience
  • Significant experience in HR compliance advisory and management across the EMENAT region (Europe, Middle East, North Africa, and Turkey), including employee relations, investigations case management, and policy management in a global or multi-jurisdictional environment
  • Demonstrated ability to lead compliance programs, interpret and operationalize regulations, manage complex investigations, advise on regulatory and employee relations matters, develop policies and training, support audits/reporting, and drive cross-regional HR compliance initiatives
  • Experience with HRIS, case management, and compliance monitoring tools; proficiency with data analysis and reporting
  • Experience in managing global HR Compliance initiatives
  • Deep knowledge of regional employment law and HR compliance frameworks, including data protection (GDPR/UK GDPR) as applied to employment; experience interpreting and operationalizing complex regulations
  • Fluency in written and spoken English

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bi-lingual English-Italian or English-Polish preferred
  • Advanced degree or compliance/HR certification (e.g., CCEP, CIPD, SHRM-SCP, SPHR) preferred
  • Experience with FLIGHT DECK or other LEAN /Six Sigma Process
  • Experience supporting global or regional HR compliance programs in a complex, matrixed, and multi-jurisdictional organization
  • Experience drafting and implementing HR policies, handbooks, SOPs, controls, and governance frameworks in partnership with Legal and Employee Relations
  • Proven ability to translate regulatory changes into practical operational requirements, training, and standard work
  • Experience developing and delivering compliance training for HR, managers, and employees
  • Experience using AI to streamline work and create solutions
  • Strong analytical and project leadership skills, including experience with compliance metrics, dashboards, reporting, and risk tracking
  • Experience partnering with cross-functional stakeholders such as Legal, Labor/Employee Relations, Security, HR leaders, and regional business teams
  • Experience supporting M&A, integrations, site transitions, or other organizational change initiatives involving HR compliance considerations
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, influence at multiple levels of the organization, and drive consistent global standards with appropriate local customization

Key Competencies

  • Regulatory expertise
  • Strong stakeholder management, influencing, and change leadership across matrixed and cross-border organizations
  • Excellent analytical, communication, and presentation skills; ability to translate regulatory concepts into practical guidance
  • Policy development and training
  • Analytical problem-solving
  • Program management and execution
  • Cross-cultural communication and collaboration
  • Continuous improvement mindset

Flexible Working
We supports and encourages flexible working arrangements, where possible, and recognises the benefits to employees of having a positive work-life balance.


Security Clearance
Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) clearance is required and must be maintained for this role. Please note that in the event that BPSS clearance cannot be obtained, you may not be eligible for the role and/or any offer of employment may be withdrawn on grounds of national security. Please see the link below for further details regarding the requirements for BPSS clearance: BPSS

Right to Work
Applications from job seekers who require sponsorship to work in the UK are welcome and will be considered alongside all other applications. However, under the applicable UK immigration rules as may be in place from time to time, it may be that candidates who do not currently have the right to work in the UK may not be appointed to a post if a suitably qualified, experienced and skilled candidate who does not require sponsorship is available to take up the post. For further information please visit the UK Visas and Immigration website.

Job Description

CLEAResult is seeking an experienced and highly analytical Finance Manager to lead financial planning, reporting, forecasting, and controllership activities across the organization. This role will serve as a key business partner to operational and regional leaders, providing actionable financial insights that support strategic decision-making and operational excellence.


The Finance Manager will own critical financial processes including budgeting, forecasting, monthly reporting, variance analysis, and financial performance reviews. Additionally, this leader will oversee a small team, develop finance talent, and ensure the accuracy and integrity of financial data used by executive leadership.


Key Responsibilities


Financial Reporting & Analysis

  • Prepare and distribute monthly consolidated financial performance reports, summarizing results by region and business line.
  • Develop monthly management reporting packages that clearly communicate business performance, key trends, and variances to budget, forecast, and prior year results.
  • Analyze revenue, operating expenses, and capital expenditures, identifying financial risks, opportunities, and recommended corrective actions.
  • Perform detailed variance analysis and reconciliations against forecasts and annual operating plans.

Forecasting, Budgeting & Planning

  • Lead the consolidated forecasting and annual budgeting processes across multiple regions and business lines.
  • Partner with operational and business leaders to develop accurate financial projections and support strategic decision-making.
  • Monitor financial performance throughout the year and provide recommendations to achieve financial objectives.
  • Ensure consistency and accuracy of financial submissions from regional and business line finance teams.

Controllership & Close Process

  • Manage the monthly close process, including preparation and review of accruals, reclassification entries, and other adjustments necessary to ensure financial accuracy.
  • Maintain ownership of below-the-line bookings and associated forecasts, ensuring completeness and compliance with financial reporting requirements.
  • Prepare Income Statement (IS) and Balance Sheet (BS) reporting used in the calculation and reporting of Credit EBITDA.
  • Partner with accounting and finance teams to ensure strong financial controls and reporting integrity.

Business Development & Contract Reporting

  • Produce and maintain new business reporting, including bookings, pipeline conversion metrics, and related performance indicators.
  • Manage and report on the contract database, including tracking won contract values and business growth metrics.
  • Provide analysis of sales performance and business development trends to support growth initiatives.

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Lead, coach, and develop finance professionals, fostering a high-performance and collaborative team environment.
  • Build strong partnerships with operational, commercial, and executive leadership teams to support strategic and financial objectives.
  • Drive continuous improvement in financial processes, reporting methodologies, and planning tools.

Qualifications


Required Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 7-10 years of progressive finance, FP&A, accounting, or corporate finance experience.
  • 1-2 years of experience leading and developing teams.
  • Demonstrated experience owning the budget, forecast, and financial reporting cycle for a business unit, function, or organization.
  • Strong experience preparing executive-level financial reporting and performance analysis.
  • Proven ability to partner effectively with operational leaders and influence business decisions through data-driven insights.
  • Experience managing monthly close processes and financial reporting requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • MBA, CPA, CMA, or other relevant financial certification.
  • Experience in professional services, energy, sustainability, consulting, or project-based organizations.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel, financial modeling, and enterprise financial systems.
  • Experience working with large datasets and business intelligence/reporting tools.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a Core AE, you will be helping our largest and most strategic enterprise sized customers consolidate outdated technologies, digitize workflows, and unlock game-changing data insights that will transform their businesses. We are helping the companies that literally keep our lights on, put food on our tables, and build our communities to become safer, more efficient, and more sustainable. Typical sales will be $100k to $500k, and typically involve POCs, multiple stakeholders, managing trials, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to executives and CXOs.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US and requires working in EST and CST timezone.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will:

  • Develop Executive-Level relationships within strategic, named accounts
  • Own customer engagements end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification to close
  • Demonstrate excellent solution-based sales process in complex sales campaigns
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years experience in a full-cycle, closing sales role
  • Proven track record of consistent quota over-achievement in complex accounts and $100k+ ARR transactions
  • Experience handling and owning enterprise deal sizes and C-Level relationships
  • Willing and comfortable with strategic outbound prospecting
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and demonstrated ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast paced environment
  • Willing and comfortable traveling to meet customers on a monthly basis

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience working with line of business stakeholders (Operations, Finance, IT)
  • Awards for top achievement (President’s club, Winner’s circle, Top 10%)
  • Passion for the world of operations!

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

Annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position is below and depends on your city of residence. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual OTE Salary
$222,400—$278,000 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

raw.title: Finance Manager
raw.excerpt: At CLEAResult, we lead the transition to a sustainable, equitable, and carbon-neutral energy-efficient future for our communities and our planet.
raw.description:
At CLEAResult, we lead the transition to a sustainable, equitable, and carbon-neutral energy-efficient future for our communities and our planet. We do that by creating a people-first culture built on trust, accountability, and transparency; where every employee – regardless of position, role, or identity is treated with respect and given an equal chance to thrive.

Additionally, you will enjoy:

• Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance; we also offer a company-paid health care concierge service to help navigate our health plan to make the best decisions for you and yours
• 401(k) with company match
• Paid vacation, sick, personal and parental leave time
• Paid Volunteer Time: giving back to our communities is important to us
• Employee Recognition Program – convert your recognition points into gift cards
• Employee Assistance Program – offers benefits to help you manage daily responsibilities
• Access to on-demand training courses to advance further in your career

Job Description

CLEAResult is seeking an experienced and highly analytical Finance Manager to lead financial planning, reporting, forecasting, and controllership activities across the organization. This role will serve as a key business partner to operational and regional leaders, providing actionable financial insights that support strategic decision-making and operational excellence.


The Finance Manager will own critical financial processes including budgeting, forecasting, monthly reporting, variance analysis, and financial performance reviews. Additionally, this leader will oversee a small team, develop finance talent, and ensure the accuracy and integrity of financial data used by executive leadership.


Key Responsibilities


Financial Reporting & Analysis

  • Prepare and distribute monthly consolidated financial performance reports, summarizing results by region and business line.
  • Develop monthly management reporting packages that clearly communicate business performance, key trends, and variances to budget, forecast, and prior year results.
  • Analyze revenue, operating expenses, and capital expenditures, identifying financial risks, opportunities, and recommended corrective actions.
  • Perform detailed variance analysis and reconciliations against forecasts and annual operating plans.

Forecasting, Budgeting & Planning

  • Lead the consolidated forecasting and annual budgeting processes across multiple regions and business lines.
  • Partner with operational and business leaders to develop accurate financial projections and support strategic decision-making.
  • Monitor financial performance throughout the year and provide recommendations to achieve financial objectives.
  • Ensure consistency and accuracy of financial submissions from regional and business line finance teams.

Controllership & Close Process

  • Manage the monthly close process, including preparation and review of accruals, reclassification entries, and other adjustments necessary to ensure financial accuracy.
  • Maintain ownership of below-the-line bookings and associated forecasts, ensuring completeness and compliance with financial reporting requirements.
  • Prepare Income Statement (IS) and Balance Sheet (BS) reporting used in the calculation and reporting of Credit EBITDA.
  • Partner with accounting and finance teams to ensure strong financial controls and reporting integrity.

Business Development & Contract Reporting

  • Produce and maintain new business reporting, including bookings, pipeline conversion metrics, and related performance indicators.
  • Manage and report on the contract database, including tracking won contract values and business growth metrics.
  • Provide analysis of sales performance and business development trends to support growth initiatives.

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Lead, coach, and develop finance professionals, fostering a high-performance and collaborative team environment.
  • Build strong partnerships with operational, commercial, and executive leadership teams to support strategic and financial objectives.
  • Drive continuous improvement in financial processes, reporting methodologies, and planning tools.

Qualifications


Required Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 7-10 years of progressive finance, FP&A, accounting, or corporate finance experience.
  • 1-2 years of experience leading and developing teams.
  • Demonstrated experience owning the budget, forecast, and financial reporting cycle for a business unit, function, or organization.
  • Strong experience preparing executive-level financial reporting and performance analysis.
  • Proven ability to partner effectively with operational leaders and influence business decisions through data-driven insights.
  • Experience managing monthly close processes and financial reporting requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • MBA, CPA, CMA, or other relevant financial certification.
  • Experience in professional services, energy, sustainability, consulting, or project-based organizations.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel, financial modeling, and enterprise financial systems.
  • Experience working with large datasets and business intelligence/reporting tools.

DOT Requirements

If applicable, meet all DOT qualification requirements and comply with all applicable federal, state, and local transportation regulations.

Compensation Range

$86,300.00 - $129,400.00

Currency

USD

Type

Salary

Any offered salary is determined based on internal equity, internal salary ranges, market data/ranges, applicant’s skills and prior relevant experience, certain degrees and certifications (e.g. JD/technology), for example.

CLEAResult will not provide sponsorship or support for immigration status or work authorization including for international students. Applicants must be authorized to work in the country where the position is located without the need for employer sponsorship or support. Successful hires must pass pre-employment checks.

Equal Opportunity Employer

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for all job applicants and employees. Employment decisions are based upon job-related reasons regardless of an applicant’s race, color, religion, national origin, marital status, age, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, status as a qualified individual with a disability or protected veteran, or any other protected status.

The above job description and job requirements are not intended to be all inclusive. CLEAResult retains the right to make changes or adjustments to job descriptions and/or requirements at any time without notice.

raw.excerpt: Overview At SCA Health, we believe health care is about people – the patients we serve, the physicians we support and the teammates who push us forward.
raw.description:
Overview

At SCA Health, we believe health care is about people – the patients we serve, the physicians we support and the teammates who push us forward. Behind every successful facility, procedure or innovation is a team of 15,000+ professionals working together, learning from each other and living out the mission, vision and values that define our organization.

As part of Optum, SCA Health is redefining specialty care by developing more accessible, patient-centered practice solutions for a network of more than 370 ambulatory surgical centers, over 400 specialty physician practice clinics and numerous labs and surgical hospitals. Our work spans a broad spectrum of services, all designed to support physicians, health systems and employers in delivering efficient, value-based care to patients without compromising quality or autonomy.

What sets SCA Health apart isn’t just what we do, it’s how we do it. Each decision we make is rooted in seven core values:

  • Clinical quality
  • Integrity
  • Service excellence
  • Teamwork
  • Accountability
  • Continuous improvement
  • Inclusion

Our values aren’t empty words – they inform our attitudes, actions and culture. At SCA Health, your work directly impacts patients, physicians and communities. Here, you’ll find opportunities to build your career alongside a team that values your expertise, invests in your success, and shares a common mission to care for patients, serve physicians and improve health care in America.

At SCA Health, we offer a comprehensive benefits package to support your health, well-being, and financial future. Our offerings include medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401k plan with company match, paid time off, life and disability insurance, and more. Please visit, to learn more about our benefits.

Your ideas should inspire change. If you join our team, they will.


Responsibilities

This is a remote role, residing within the United States.

The Associate Director, HR Business Partner is a strategic advisor and thought partner to senior and executive leaders within corporate functions, responsible for translating enterprise and functional strategies into people strategies that enhance talent, culture, and organizational effectiveness. This role is corporate‑facing and enterprise‑focused and does not support field, site, or facility‑based operations.

The role requires strong business acumen, executive‑level consulting capability, critical thinking, and the ability to influence without authority in a matrixed environment. The Associate Director collaborates closely with HR Centers of Excellence, and applies data, systems thinking, and enterprise‑wide perspectives to anticipate risk and drive measurable business results.

The Associate Director serves as a cultural ambassador, modeling emotional intelligence, communication excellence, and change leadership to support a diverse, inclusive, and change‑ready corporate workforce.

Responsibilities:

Attract, Recruit, Retain & Advance Key Talent

  • Partner with executive and senior leaders in corporate functions to define critical roles, future skill requirements, and organizational design needs using enterprise thinking and business insight.
  • Collaborate with Talent Acquisition to build diverse executive and leadership pipelines, strengthen selection rigor, and reduce time to fill for critical corporate roles.
  • Use EXI insights, turnover trends, and predictive analytics to develop targeted retention strategies, applying consulting skills and influence without authority to drive executive adoption and accountability.

Champion Culture & Build an Inclusive, Change‑Ready Workforce

  • Embed SCA Health’s values—Clinical Quality, Integrity, Service Excellence, Teamwork, Accountability, Continuous Improvement, and Inclusion—into leadership behaviors and corporate people processes.
  • Leverage emotional intelligence and change management capability to coach executives through complexity, transformation, and organizational change.
  • Partner with the Inclusion team to strengthen representation, ensure equity in corporate talent processes, and increase psychological safety.
  • Apply systems thinking to understand how culture, policies, and processes intersect across corporate functions and the enterprise.

Enhance Service Delivery & the Teammate Experience

  • Lead and enhance the People Planning (P3) process for corporate functions, ensuring rigorous calibration, meaningful development planning, and progress tracking.
  • Guide executives and senior leaders through performance management and compensation cycles using strong judgment, critical thinking, and influence without authority to drive fair and differentiated outcomes.
  • Partner with Total Rewards to improve the corporate teammate experience through compensation, wellbeing, and open enrollment initiatives.
  • Translate EXI results into actionable, leader‑owned plans using data storytelling and executive consulting skills to influence sustained follow‑through.

Build Organizational Capability for the Future

  • Advise executive leaders on skills taxonomies, role architecture, and internal mobility frameworks to support a skills‑based, future‑ready organization.
  • Coach senior leaders on organizational effectiveness, leadership capability, change leadership, and navigating complex teammate relations with empathy and sound judgment.
  • Lead culture integration and change adoption for newly acquired or restructured corporate teams.
  • Demonstrate learning agility by adopting new tools, frameworks, and approaches as enterprise needs evolve.

Enterprise HR Leadership & Governance

  • Serve as an integrator across HR Centers of Excellence, ensuring cohesive delivery of solutions aligned to enterprise standards and priorities.
  • Leverage HR dashboards and integrated datasets to identify trends in performance, engagement, turnover, and talent flow; synthesize and present insights to executive audiences.
  • Lead complex employee relations matters for corporate leaders while ensuring compliance with federal, state, and local regulations.
  • Lead or support reorganizations and restructurings, applying systems thinking to assess downstream talent, financial, and cultural impacts.

Key Deliverables & Success Measures

  • Reduced regrettable turnover in critical corporate roles
  • Improved internal mobility and succession depth
  • Strong executive satisfaction with HR partnership
  • High‑quality performance differentiation and compensation outcomes
  • Year‑over‑year EXI improvement driven by executive action plan ownership
  • Effective change adoption and cultural integration

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required
  • 5+ years of progressive HR Business Partner experience supporting senior and executive‑level leaders (VP/SVP/EVP or equivalent) within corporate or enterprise functions
  • Demonstrated success advising executives in complex, matrixed organizations
  • Strong capability in executive consulting, analytics, talent management, and organizational change
  • Sound judgment, emotional intelligence, and ability to operate effectively in ambiguity
  • 25% travel expected

Success Profile Core Capabilities:

  • Business Acumen – Connects people strategies to enterprise and functional outcomes
  • Executive Consulting Skills – Uses structured, evidence‑based approaches to advise senior leaders
  • Strong Communication – Simplifies complexity and tailors messages for executive audiences
  • Critical Thinking – Synthesizes data and diagnoses root causes
  • Emotional Intelligence – Demonstrates empathy, self‑awareness, and credibility
  • Influence Without Authority – Drives adoption across SLT/ELT stakeholders
  • Stakeholder Management – Builds trust across HR and corporate leadership
  • Learning Agility – Adapts quickly in changing enterprise environments
  • Change Leadership – Guides leaders through transformation and ambiguity
  • Enterprise Thinking – Evaluates cross‑functional and downstream impact
  • Strategic Thinking – Aligns people strategies to long‑term business needs
  • Systems Thinking – Understands how structure, policies, and decisions interact across the organization

Company Overview

Imagine Everything. Build the Future with Hexion.

At Hexion, we push boundaries, rethink possibilities, and create real impact. We activate science to deliver progress—developing breakthrough solutions that strengthen industries, protect communities, and drive a more sustainable future.

This is where bold thinkers, problem-solvers, and innovators come together to shape what’s next. Whether you're engineering advanced materials, transforming manufacturing technologies, or leading strategic innovation, your ideas and actions leave a lasting mark. We cultivate an inclusive culture of growth, collaboration, and accountability, ensuring every contribution propels us forward.

We don’t follow the status quo—we challenge it, disrupt it, and improve it. Every role at Hexion is part of something bigger.

We invest in innovation, sustainability, and continuous development—equipping you with the tools, training, and opportunities to excel. With an unwavering commitment to safety, partnership, belonging, and impact, we empower you to lead change and strengthen industries worldwide.

Your Future Starts Here.

If you’re ready to push limits, reimagine what’s possible, and create the extraordinary, Hexion is where you belong.

Anything is possible when you imagine everything.

Position Overview

​​The Source to Procure Manager provides strategic and operational leadership for the digital capabilities that enable Global Procurement and the end-to-end Source to Pay process. This role owns the implementation, adoption, sustainment, and continuous improvement of e-sourcing, contract lifecycle management, spend analytics, intake and demand management, and e-procurement capabilities. The position leads a team of 2 associates and partners across Procurement, Finance, IT, Data, Legal, and the business to keep the Source to Procure engine reliable, scalable, compliant, and value-focused. The successful candidate will finalize and enhance the digital roadmap, establish fit-for-purpose governance, define and communicate decision-enabling KPIs, guide users to preferred suppliers and buying channels, and measure whether each capability is delivering the intended adoption and business outcomes. This leader combines procurement process expertise, digital product ownership, data-driven decision-making, change leadership, and practical execution to help sourcing managers set or reset category strategies using trusted data and actionable insights.​

Job Responsibilities

  • Digital Capability Strategy and Roadmap. Own, finalize, communicate, and continuously refresh the Source to Pay (focus on Source to Procure) digital roadmap. Translate procurement priorities into a sequenced portfolio for e-sourcing, contract lifecycle management, spend analytics, intake and demand management, and e-procurement, with clear outcomes, dependencies, investment needs, and change management. 10%

raw.description:
The Wikimedia Foundation is seeking a Community Management Associate to engage online communities, help refine our brand voice, and build a vibrant, Gen Z-focused social media presence for Wikipedia and the Wikimedia Foundation.

Sitting on the Social Team within External Communications, you will bring energy and creativity to how we show up across platforms. From writing engaging comment copy and jumping on real-time cultural moments to surfacing stories from our global volunteer community, you will help connect Wikipedia with next-generation internet audiences.

This is a fast-moving, hands-on role perfect for someone who lives on social media, loves online culture, and is eager to test and learn. Preferred working time zones are UTC -8 to UTC -5 (Mexico, Columbia, Canada and United States)

Ideally You Are:

  • A Digital Culture Native: Plugged into emerging trends and short-form video culture (TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts) with a natural feel for Gen Z engagement.
  • A Strong Communicator: Experienced in writing social comment copy and adapting brand tone across different platforms.
  • An Organized Framework Builder: Eager to help draft clear community playbooks, response protocols, and engagement guidelines.
  • A Community Connector: Excited to interact directly with followers and surface stories from our global volunteer network.
  • A Data-Aware Learner: Comfortable reviewing basic analytics and social listening insights to refine engagement tactics.

Key Responsibilities

Community Engagement & Copywriting

  • Assist in writing daily social copy, managing comment sections, and executing reactive engagement on trending moments.
  • Support the development and documentation of community management playbooks and brand tone-of-voice guidelines.
  • Help identify, surface, and share inspiring stories from Wikipedia’s global volunteer community.

Trends & Growth

  • Track short-form video trends, platform updates, and emerging formats to recommend fresh engagement opportunities.
  • Support testing of social listening and moderation tools to improve community response time.

Tracking & Operations

  • Monitor channel activity, track audience sentiment, and assist with monthly performance reporting.
  • Participate in creative experimentation to see which copy and engagement styles resonate best.

Skills & Experience

  • 1–3 years of hands-on experience in social media execution, community management, or digital storytelling.
  • Short-Form Native: Active familiarity with TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.
  • Writing & Moderation: Experience writing social copy, engaging in comment sections, or moderating online channels.
  • Basic Tool Familiarity: Exposure to social management, analytics, or listening tools.
  • Good Judgment: High emotional intelligence to navigate sensitive comments and know when to escalate risks.
  • Global Mindset: Awareness of cross-cultural nuances and working with diverse global audiences.

Qualities That Matter to Us

  • Passion for the Wikimedia mission and free knowledge.
  • Flexibility working with distributed teams across time zones.
  • A collaborative spirit, curiosity, and a real love for internet culture.

About the Wikimedia Foundation

The Wikimedia Foundation is the nonprofit organization that operates Wikipedia and the other Wikimedia free knowledge projects. Our vision is a world in which every single human can freely share in the sum of all knowledge. We believe that everyone has the potential to contribute something to our shared knowledge, and that everyone should be able to access that knowledge freely. We host Wikipedia and the Wikimedia projects, build software experiences for reading, contributing, and sharing Wikimedia content, support the volunteer communities and partners who make Wikimedia possible, and advocate for policies that enable Wikimedia and free knowledge to thrive.

The Wikimedia Foundation is a charitable, not-for-profit organization that relies on donations. We receive donations from millions of individuals around the world, with an average donation of about $15. We also receive donations through institutional grants and gifts. The Wikimedia Foundation is a United States 501(c)(3) tax-exempt organization with offices in San Francisco, California, USA.

As an equal opportunity employer, the Wikimedia Foundation values having a diverse workforce and continuously strives to maintain an inclusive and equitable workplace. We encourage people with a diverse range of backgrounds to apply. We do not discriminate against any person based upon their race, traits historically associated with race, religion, color, national origin, sex, pregnancy or related medical conditions, parental status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, or any other legally protected characteristics.

The Wikimedia Foundation is a remote-first organization with staff members including contractors based 40+ countries*. Salaries at the Wikimedia Foundation are set in a way that is competitive, equitable, and consistent with our values and culture. The anticipated annual pay range of this position for applicants based within the United States is US$62,074 to US$93,077 with multiple individualized factors, including cost of living in the location, being the determinants of the offered pay. For applicants located outside of the US, the pay range will be adjusted to the country of hire. We neither ask for nor take into consideration the salary history of applicants. The compensation for a successful applicant will be based on their skills, experience and location.

*Please note that we are currently able to hire in the following:
US States: Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, District of Columbia*, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, New Jersey, New Mexico, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Puerto Rico*, Rhode Island, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, West Virginia, Wisconsin and Wyoming (*US Territory or Federal District)

For US-based applicants: this position is part of the Communication Workers of America bargaining unit.

Countries: Brazil, Canada, Colombia, France, Germany, Ghana, India, Indonesia, Italy, Kenya*, Mexico, Morocco, Netherlands, Poland, Singapore*, South Africa, Spain, Switzerland and the United Kingdom. Our non-US employees are hired through a local third party Employer of Record (EOR) and must have current work authorization in their location. (*citizens/permanent residents only)

We periodically review this list to streamline to ensure alignment with our hiring requirements.

All applicants can reach out to their recruiter to understand more about the specific pay range for their location during the interview process.

If you are a qualified applicant requiring assistance or an accommodation to complete any step of the application process due to a disability, you may contact us at or +1 (415) 839-6885.

raw.description:
Sumitomo Pharma Co., Ltd., is a global pharmaceutical company based in Japan with operations in the U.S. (Sumitomo Pharma America, Inc.), focused on addressing patient needs in oncology, urology, women's health, rare diseases, cell & gene therapies and CNS. With several marketed products and a diverse pipeline of early- to late-stage investigational assets, we aim to accelerate discovery, research, and development to bring novel therapies to patients sooner. For more information on SMPA, visit our website or follow us on LinkedIn.

Job Overview:

The Associate Director, Biostatistics reports to the Vice President, Biostatistics and serves as the statistical lead for one or more clinical development programs. This position provides strategic statistical leadership across clinical development, including development planning, study design, quantitative decision-making, data analysis, regulatory submissions, and external collaborations. The Associate Director partners with cross-functional leaders to ensure that statistical strategies and deliverables are scientifically rigorous, operationally feasible, and aligned with program and regulatory objectives.

Essential Functions Required for Job

  • Serve as the biostatistics lead for one or more clinical development programs, providing strategic statistical input into clinical development plans, study designs, operational decisions, decision criteria, and analysis strategies.
  • Represent Biostatistics on cross-functional program and study teams and ensure that statistical considerations are incorporated into key development decisions.
  • Lead statistical interactions with regulatory authorities, including the planning and preparation of briefing documents, responses to regulatory questions, and discussions of statistical methodology.
  • Author or oversee the development and review of statistical sections of protocols, statistical analysis plans, regulatory submissions, publications, and other scientific documents.
  • Provide statistical interpretation of study results, communicate benefit-risk considerations, and support data-driven program decisions.
  • Identify statistical, operational, and regulatory risks and recommend practical mitigation strategies.
  • Oversee CRO and external vendor statistical activities, including scope definition, quality review, timelines, and delivery of statistical outputs.
  • Provide technical leadership, coaching, and mentorship to statisticians and statistical programmers, as appropriate.
  • Evaluate and apply innovative statistical methods, including Bayesian approaches, adaptive or complex trial designs, and quantitative decision-making methods when appropriate.
  • Contribute to departmental standards, process improvements, statistical governance, and capability development.
  • undefined

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities :

  • Broad and current knowledge of statistical principles, clinical-trial methodology, and their application throughout drug development.
  • Strong understanding of applicable regulatory guidance, including ICH guidelines and expectations of FDA, EMA, PMDA, and other health authorities.
  • Knowledge of relevant industry standards, including CDISC standards.
  • Experience with complex trial designs, Bayesian methods, or innovative statistical approaches is preferred.
  • Proficiency in statistical computing using SAS and R.
  • Ability to communicate complex statistical concepts and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to provide strategic leadership, influence cross-functional decisions, and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively across functions and communicate recommendations to senior leadership.

Education & Experience Requirements:

  • PhD in Statistics, Biostatistics, or a related quantitative discipline with at least 5 years of relevant experience, or an MS with at least 8 years of relevant experience, in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.
  • Significant experience providing statistical leadership for clinical development programs and clinical trials.
  • Experience supporting regulatory interactions and marketing applications is strongly preferred.
  • Oncology or hematology clinical development experience is preferred.
  • Experience overseeing CROs, vendors, or external statistical partners is required.

Travel Requirements:

Primarily remote role with periodic on-site meetings in office. Must be able to travel domestically and internationally as needed.



Mental/Physical Requirements:

Fast-paced environment handling multiple demands is involved. Must be able to exercise appropriate judgment as necessary. Requires a high level of initiative and independence. Excellent written and oral communication skills required. Requires ability to use a personal computer for extended periods of time.

The base salary range for this role is

$165,800.00 - $207,200.00

Base salary is part of our total rewards package which also includes the opportunity for merit-based salary increases, short incentive plan participation, eligibility for our 401(k) plan, medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurances and leaves provided in line with your work state. Our robust time-off policy includes flexible paid time off, 11 paid holidays plus additional time off for a shut-down period during the last week of December, 80 hours of paid sick time upon hire and each year thereafter. Total compensation, including base salary to be offered, will depend on elements unique to each candidate, including candidate experience, skills, education and other factors permitted by law.

They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. All personnel may be required to perform duties outside of their normal responsibilities from time to time, as needed.

Confidential Data: All information (written, verbal, electronic, etc.) that an employee encounters is considered confidential, in accordance with applicable law.

Compliance: Achieve and maintain Compliance with all applicable regulatory, legal and operational rules and procedures, by ensuring that all plans and activities for and on behalf of Sumitomo Pharma America (SMPA) and affiliates are carried out with the "best" industry practices and the highest ethical standards.

It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

Overview

We are seeking a Senior Accountant to join our Accounting team with a focus on accounts receivable and revenue accounting. This role will own a range of revenue-cycle close activities, including revenue and deferred revenue entries, reserve and write-off analysis, commission accounting, and balance sheet reconciliations. The ideal candidate has strong technical accounting skills, is comfortable working with large data sets, and thrives in a fast-paced, detail-oriented environment.

Responsibilities

  • Prepare and review monthly commission calculations, including amortization of prepaid/deferred commission balances
  • Record and reconcile revenue and deferred revenue journal entries across multiple business lines
  • Maintain and analyze the Allowance for Doubtful Accounts (AFDA) for multiple business segments
  • Calculate and maintain the accounts receivable reserve, ensuring estimates are well-supported and documented
  • Prepare gross revenue journal entries in accordance with revenue recognition standards (ASC 606)
  • Analyze and process write-off reclassifications, identifying trends and supporting documentation
  • Calculate and record profit share accruals for applicable business lines
  • Prepare monthly balance sheet reconciliations for assigned accounts and resolve reconciling items timely
  • Partner cross-functionally with AR, billing, and FP&A teams to ensure accurate and timely revenue reporting
  • Work closely with the AR Manager to ensure accurate and complete month-end AR reporting
  • Support month-end and year-end close processes, including variance analysis and management reporting
  • Assist with audit requests and provide supporting schedules and documentation as needed
  • Identify opportunities to improve and automate recurring close processes

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance required
  • 3–5 years of progressive accounting experience
  • Public accounting experience is required, Big 4 preferred
  • CPA license or active progress toward CPA is a plus
  • Experience with client billing, revenue recognition (ASC 606), and large/complex data sets
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel (pivot tables, lookups, large workbook management)
  • Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central or similar ERP system preferred
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail and accuracy
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a dynamic, deadline-driven close environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally
  • Comfortable working independently as well as collaboratively within a team

Total CompensationBase pay is one element of the total compensation package. Eligible employees may also have access to a comprehensive benefits offering, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and a 401(k) plan.

Salary Range It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range. Individual pay may be influenced by factors such as skills, qualifications, experience, licensure, certifications, geographic location, and internal equity.

Applicant Privacy Notice

USD $85,000.00 - USD $115,000.00 /Yr.

Job Summary

Purdue IT | Research Computing | Remote for the right person

Join Purdue IT in a leadership role supporting world-class research and discovery. As the Senior Manager, Research Solutions Engineering, you will lead a team of experienced research technology professionals responsible for delivering and supporting advanced high-performance computing, storage, networking, and archival solutions for Purdue's research community.

Working closely with the Director of Integrated Cyberinfrastructure and Research Solutions Engineering Leads, you will help guide strategic initiatives, oversee technology planning and infrastructure investments, support day-to-day operations, and represent the team on advisory, policy, and project committees. This role combines technical leadership, staff development, and operational management. You will foster a collaborative, high-performing team environment while supporting hiring, retention, professional growth, and succession planning efforts.

If you are passionate about enabling cutting-edge research through technology, developing talented teams, and shaping the future of research computing, we invite you to explore this opportunity.

Why Purdue?

  • Lead impactful technology initiatives that advance research and innovation
  • Collaborate with talented professionals across a nationally recognized research institution
  • Influence the direction of enterprise-scale research computing services and infrastructure
  • Support and mentor a team dedicated to delivering exceptional research technology solutions

About Us

Purdue University’s Rosen Center for Advanced Computing is committed to promoting and advancing all forms of opportunities to create an environment where the uniqueness of individuals is celebrated and persons from all backgrounds can thrive.

Purdue’s Rosen Center for Advanced Computing provides access to leading-edge computational and data storage systems as well as expertise in a broad range of high-performance computing activities. To fulfill our mission, we:

  • provide advanced computational resources and services to support Purdue faculty and staff researchers
  • evaluate, deploy, and support hardware and software for large-scale scientific computing
  • promote the effective use of our research computing systems and application software through training and education, consultation, and documentation
  • contribute to the discovery process through algorithm design and development of effective computing techniques

What We're Looking For

Education and Experience Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or related business discipline.
  • At least four (4) years of experience that shows a track record of taking on greater responsibility over time — for example, moving from individual technical work into leading projects, coordinating with other teams, or supervising or mentoring colleagues
    • Experience in developing effective and collaborative partnerships within and across organizations
    • Experience supervising direct reports or strong mentorship experience, including setting expectations, providing guidance, and feedback
  • Consideration will be given to an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Preferred:

  • Experience in using or administering services in relations to large-scale, Linux-based high-performance computing (HPC) clusters or configuring software programs and applications in Linux-based computing environments

Skills Required:

  • Knowledge of advanced computational resources and services to support research, such as HPC, research networks, operations, and data storage systems
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills to communicate with faculty, students, colleagues, and leaders
  • Strong Demonstrated ability to successfully lead and manage complex technical projects
  • Ability to:
    • work effectively both individually and as part of a team
    • consult with and provide support for researchers, make presentations, develop and present training material, and develop reports
    • promote team relationship skills and communication

  • Purdue University will not sponsor employment authorization for this position

Serving the People Who Serve the People

Granicus is driven by the excitement of building, implementing, and maintaining technology that is transforming the Govtech industry by bringing governments and its constituents together. We are on a mission to support our customers with meeting the needs of their communities and implementing our technology in ways that are equitable and inclusive. Granicus has consistently appeared on the GovTech 100 list over the past 5 years and has been recognized as the best companies to work on BuiltIn.

Over the last 25 years, we have served 5,500 federal, state, and local government agencies and more than 300 million citizen subscribers power an unmatched Subscriber Network that use our digital solutions to make the world a better place. With comprehensive cloud-based solutions for communications, government website design, meeting and agenda management software, records management, and digital services, Granicus empowers stronger relationships between government and residents across the U.S., U.K., Australia, New Zealand, and Canada. By simplifying interactions with residents, while disseminating critical information, Granicus brings governments closer to the people they serve—driving meaningful change for communities around the globe.

Want to know more? See more of what we do here.

Job Summary

We are hiring an early-career Automation Engineer to support Granicus Technical Support’s transition to an AI-first operation, where AI handles a growing share of customer interactions end-to-end. This role focuses on helping build, test, and deploy production-ready AI automations across Forethought, Salesforce, and Microsoft Copilot to improve AI resolution rate, reduce manual work, and enhance customer experience through scalable, reliable support workflows.

Essential Function

  • Help build AI-powered automations across Forethought, Salesforce, and Microsoft Copilot.
  • Support the design of workflows for auto-resolution, case enrichment, and routing.
  • Rapidly prototype, test, deploy, and iterate on scoped automation solutions.
  • Contribute to improvements in AI resolution rate and overall automation coverage.
  • Help reduce manual work across support operations through effective automation design.
  • Partner with Support, CX, and AI teams to translate operational needs into practical solutions.
  • Continuously improve automation performance using data, feedback, and iterative learning.

What Your Impact Will Look Like

What Your Impact Will Look Like

  • Deliver multiple scoped, production-ready AI automations within the first 3–6 months, with appropriate guidance and support.
  • Contribute to measurable improvement in AI resolution rate and automation coverage.
  • Help reduce manual case handling and improve operational efficiency across support workflows.
  • Demonstrate growing ability to design, deploy, and improve automation solutions with increasing independence.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities

  • Foundational experience building AI workflows or automations.
  • Exposure to APIs, scripting, or automation tools.
  • Ability to learn new technologies quickly and apply them in practical support scenarios.
  • Strong problem-solving mindset with a sense of ownership and accountability.

Experience/Credentials:

  • Experience with Salesforce or customer support tools is preferred.
  • Exposure to AI platforms such as Forethought, Microsoft Copilot, or equivalent solutions is preferred.
  • Familiarity with automation or low-code platforms is preferred.
  • Background in technical, engineering, or data-related fields is preferred.
  • Candidates must demonstrate at least one working AI automation or project and be prepared to walk through it during interviews.

You Will Love This Job If You Have

You Will Love This Job If You Have

  • You are a builder who turns ideas into working solutions quickly.
  • You are outcome-driven and focused on measurable impact.
  • You are comfortable working in ambiguity and moving fast.
  • You are curious, adaptable, and committed to continuous learning.

raw.description:
Company Overview

More than 35 years ago, SelectQuote was founded on one core promise: to help our customers protect the people they value most. We pioneered the way consumers shopped for term life insurance, and now, we also help people find home insurance, auto insurance, senior health insurance and more. Our quick and easy process saves consumers both time and money, and today, more than 2 million families trust us to help them with their insurance needs.

But what truly sets us apart is our people, and the opportunities to grow your career with SelectQuote are unmatched.

About the Role

Sales Development Advisor

Job Summary:

SelectQuote is seeking experienced, driven, resilient, and results-oriented sales professionals to join our Qualifications Team as a Sales Development Advisor (SDA).

The SDA is an unlicensed, outbound sales position responsible for contacting prospective customers, generating interest in SelectQuote's products, understanding customer needs, overcoming objections, and transferring qualified prospects to a licensed insurance agent.

This is not a customer service role. This is a high-volume, metrics-driven sales position. Successful candidates must be comfortable making hundreds of outbound calls each day, working from established scripts and processes, handling rejection, and consistently working toward performance goals.

This role provides paid training, a base salary plus bonus opportunity, and a potential career path into a licensed sales agent position. After demonstrating success in the role, SelectQuote will provide opportunities to enter a sales training program and assist with obtaining an insurance license.

Candidates who currently hold an insurance license will not be considered for this position.

After applying, qualified candidates will receive a phone call to complete our pre-screening questionnaire.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Make high-volume outbound calls to prospective customers, with activity of up to 800 calls per day.
  • Generate interest and create meaningful engagement with prospective customers.
  • Quickly establish rapport and communicate confidently and professionally over the phone.

  • Identify customer needs and qualify prospects for transfer to a licensed insurance agent.

  • Handle and overcome objections, stalls, hesitation, and rejection throughout the sales conversation.

  • Confidently redirect conversations and move qualified prospects toward the next step.

  • Follow established sales scripts, processes, and instructions while maintaining a natural and engaging conversation.

  • Meet or exceed monthly transfer, contact-to-transfer, and other performance goals.

  • Accept coaching and demonstrate the ability to apply feedback to improve sales performance.

  • Work effectively with multiple monitors, software applications, and phone systems.

  • Maintain consistent attendance, punctuality, productivity, and performance.

Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.

  • At least 1 year of telesales, inside sales, phone sales, or comparable sales experience required.

  • Proven ability to work in a high-volume, metrics-driven or commission-based sales environment preferred.

  • Demonstrated success working toward quotas, KPIs, conversion goals, or other measurable sales objectives.

  • Strong objection-handling and closing skills.

  • Confident, energetic, and conversational phone presence.

  • Strong active listening and communication skills.

  • Ability to follow scripts and established sales processes.

  • Ability to accept coaching and implement feedback.

  • Professional and reliable work habits.

  • Consistent employment history and demonstrated commitment to previous roles preferred.

  • Candidates should be prepared to clearly explain significant employment gaps, frequent job changes, or positions not reflected on their resume.

  • Current insurance licenses are not eligible for this position.

Compensation & Career Growth:

  • Paid training.

  • Base salary plus bonus opportunity.

  • Average first-year earnings of approximately $50,000, with top producers earning $80,000+.

  • Potential opportunity to enter SelectQuote's sales training program after six months of successful performance.

  • SelectQuote will support successful associates in pursuing an insurance license and progressing into a licensed sales role.

This Role Is a Good Fit for You If:

  • You have a genuine sales mindset and enjoy influencing customers toward a next step.
  • You are comfortable making a very high volume of outbound calls every day.
  • You don't get discouraged by rejection.
  • You can confidently handle "I'm not interested," "I need to think about it," and other common objections.
  • You enjoy working toward quotas, KPIs, and measurable sales goals.
  • You are comfortable using a sales script and can make it sound natural rather than robotic.
  • You can follow a structured sales process while still actively listening and responding to the customer.
  • You are competitive and motivated by improving your numbers.
  • You can stay engaged and energetic through repetitive, high-volume work.
  • You take coaching seriously and can demonstrate changes based on feedback.
  • You can provide specific examples of your past sales performance and accomplishments.
  • You are looking for a long-term sales career, with the potential to progress into a licensed sales role.
  • You are dependable and prepared to consistently work your assigned schedule.

This Role May Not Be a Good Fit for You If:

  • You are primarily looking for a customer service position.

  • You are primarily interested in working from home for flexibility rather than pursuing a sales career.

  • You dislike scripted sales environments or are unwilling to follow established sales processes.

  • You prefer conversations without sales goals, quotas, or performance expectations.

  • You become uncomfortable when customers object, hesitate, or say no.

  • You have difficulty redirecting a conversation or moving a prospect toward the next step.

  • You struggle to maintain energy and engagement during repetitive phone interactions.

  • You are uncomfortable making a high volume of outbound calls.

  • You prefer not to be coached or change your approach based on feedback.

  • You cannot provide specific examples of your sales accomplishments or performance.

  • You are unable to commit consistently to a set schedule, attendance expectations, and the demands of a full-time sales position.

Work-From-Home Requirements:

This is a full-time W-2 work-from-home position with an assigned schedule.

Employees must:

  • Be punctual and consistently adhere to their assigned schedule and attendance requirements.

  • Have a quiet, dedicated workspace free from distractions.

  • Have reliable high-speed internet with minimum speeds of 20 Mbps download and 20 Mbps upload through a hardwired connection.

  • Be able to remain fully engaged and available throughout scheduled work hours.

  • Be willing to work overtime, weekends, or schedule variations when business needs require it.

SelectQuote Core Values:

Service — We create positive customer experiences.
Entrepreneurship — We create, innovate, and take risks.
Leadership — We build and invest in high-performing teams.
Empowerment — We embrace a changing environment.
Courage — We challenge the status quo and drive continuous improvement.
Teamwork — We help, support, and celebrate each other.

The above statements describe the general nature and level of work performed in this position and are not intended to be an exhaustive list of responsibilities, qualifications, or requirements.

raw.description:
SAP TM S/4HANA Rollout Consultant, Ireland

Contract: 6 months initially, extensible. Long-term programme. Start: 1 November 2026 Location: Remote, for consultants based in Ireland. Day rate: EUR 350 a day. Language: English.

The programme

A global manufacturing organisation is moving its transportation processes onto SAP Transportation Management (TM) on S/4HANA. The global template is the base, and it is being rolled out to sites in waves. Each wave brings new plants, new carriers and new country requirements into the template.

You will own the TM solution for the waves you are given. You will run fit-to-standard sessions with the business, decide what the template already covers and what is a real local gap, and design the answer without breaking the global standard. You will then carry that design through build, testing, cutover and early support after go-live.

What you will work on

Fit-gap for each rollout wave. Local transport practice, carriers, legal and document needs measured against the global design. TM solution design on S/4HANA. Freight planning, carrier selection and tendering, freight order execution, charge calculation and freight settlement. Integration across the S/4HANA logistics chain. Outbound sales orders and deliveries, inbound purchasing flows, warehouse execution, and freight cost through to finance. Carrier connectivity. EDI or business network onboarding, tracking, and status messages from carriers. Functional specifications for the build team, working closely with integration, development and test leads. Test planning and defect resolution through integration and user acceptance testing. Cutover, hypercare and handover to support for each wave. Feeding what each wave teaches back into the template, so the next wave starts from a better base.

What you bring

8 or more years in SAP logistics, with SAP TM on S/4HANA as a core part of it. At least one TM rollout or global template programme for a manufacturing business, where you did the fit-gap and the solution design yourself, not only the configuration. Working knowledge of how TM connects to SD, MM, EWM and FI/CO, and where those integrations tend to break. Experience running workshops with business users and turning what they say into a design and a specification. Comfort working remotely across countries in a programme team made up of several companies.

Useful but not essential:

SAP Business Network for Logistics, or a carrier visibility platform. Both embedded and side-by-side TM deployments. Automotive, industrial or process manufacturing. Multimodal, international or dangerous goods transport. SAP TM certification.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent TM rollout: the countries or sites in scope, whether TM was embedded or side-by-side, and what you personally designed.

About Yadimen

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced SAP TM people in front of a global manufacturing organisation.

SAP TM S/4HANA Rollout Consultant, Spain

Contract: 6 months initially, extensible. Long-term programme. Start: 1 November 2026 Location: Remote, for consultants based in Spain. Day rate: EUR 350 a day. Language: English.

The programme

A global manufacturing organisation is moving its transportation processes onto SAP Transportation Management (TM) on S/4HANA. The global template is the base, and it is being rolled out to sites in waves. Each wave brings new plants, new carriers and new country requirements into the template.

You will own the TM solution for the waves you are given. You will run fit-to-standard sessions with the business, decide what the template already covers and what is a real local gap, and design the answer without breaking the global standard. You will then carry that design through build, testing, cutover and early support after go-live.

What you will work on

Fit-gap for each rollout wave. Local transport practice, carriers, legal and document needs measured against the global design. TM solution design on S/4HANA. Freight planning, carrier selection and tendering, freight order execution, charge calculation and freight settlement. Integration across the S/4HANA logistics chain. Outbound sales orders and deliveries, inbound purchasing flows, warehouse execution, and freight cost through to finance. Carrier connectivity. EDI or business network onboarding, tracking, and status messages from carriers. Functional specifications for the build team, working closely with integration, development and test leads. Test planning and defect resolution through integration and user acceptance testing. Cutover, hypercare and handover to support for each wave. Feeding what each wave teaches back into the template, so the next wave starts from a better base.

What you bring

8 or more years in SAP logistics, with SAP TM on S/4HANA as a core part of it. At least one TM rollout or global template programme for a manufacturing business, where you did the fit-gap and the solution design yourself, not only the configuration. Working knowledge of how TM connects to SD, MM, EWM and FI/CO, and where those integrations tend to break. Experience running workshops with business users and turning what they say into a design and a specification. Comfort working remotely across countries in a programme team made up of several companies.

Useful but not essential:

SAP Business Network for Logistics, or a carrier visibility platform. Both embedded and side-by-side TM deployments. Automotive, industrial or process manufacturing. Multimodal, international or dangerous goods transport. SAP TM certification.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent TM rollout: the countries or sites in scope, whether TM was embedded or side-by-side, and what you personally designed.

About Yadimen

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced SAP TM people in front of a global manufacturing organisation.
