raw.description:
What We Can Achieve Together:


The Director of Philanthropy Operations is responsible for directing the Florida Business Unit (BU) Development Operations Team in support of the annual Florida Fundraising Strategy as set by the Florida Director of Philanthropy and Florida Executive Director. The Director of Philanthropy Operations is responsible for co-creating a vision for the Philanthropy Operations team with the Florida Director of Philanthropy, directing all aspects of the four key strategic areas within the Florida development program; donor engagement and events, donor communications, major gift management, and philanthropy operations (gift coding/research/administration/project management). They will manage a team that handles gift processing, fundraising and financial reporting, events and trips, research, prospect management activity, donor engagement and stewardship, volunteer management, and pipeline building. During fundraising campaigns, they collaborate with BU leadership and direct the operations of the BU’s comprehensive campaign, ensuring that the campaign operating plan, timeline, deliverables and desired fundraising targets are met.


The Director of Philanthropy Operations will drive effective management and processes for all four areas of philanthropy operations with the overall objective of optimal support to maximize essential fundraiser time “out the door.” They will hold their direct reports accountable to achieve Philanthropy Operations measurable goals and objectives as set by the annual fundraising strategy and plan with the Director of Philanthropy.


We’re Looking for You:


If you’re looking for a career where you can find meaning and purpose, come join our Chapter as the Development Program Director I! Not only will you fulfill philanthropy objectives in the beautiful state ofFlorida, but you’ll contribute to fundraising goals through many networks!


We’re looking for a passionate, dedicated person to lead our Chapter and work within our division. Systems Leadership, creativity, and implementing and developing strategic goals are key in this role. Come join TNC and apply today!


Essential Functions:


The Director of Philanthropy Operations proactively works towards meeting the strategic priorities of the program by designing, developing and coordinating plans and related tactics and overseeing all day-to-day tasks of development operations. They work closely with the Director of Philanthropy to set measurable goals and metrics for programmatic success, building a strong donor/prospect pipeline, increasing accountability and building a fundraising program that can meet and exceed market potential. They manage a team responsible for principal and major gifts fundraising support, direct accurate and timely gift processing, and following processes to ensure maximum fundraising effectiveness. They oversee donor/prospect pipeline development and efforts to build strong principal and major gift portfolios. They manage prospect research, prospect assignments, fundraiser activity accountability and effective portfolio management. The Director of Philanthropy Operations aligns fundraising and program activities to ensure all prospect management and solicitation activities are coordinated, strategic, and donor-centered in approach. They track fundraising progress, managing the production of reports for senior leadership on fundraising results and managing the annual department plan and goal setting processes. They ensure that solicitations meet TNC standards, increase flexibility of funding and that donor designations are honored through the revenue allocation review process.


They oversee all events and event staff, ensuring that events and trips follow TNC protocols, “best in class” standards, and add strategic value/PG & MG pipeline building necessary for increasing fundraising year over year, contributing the highest ROI possible for fundraising success. The Director of Philanthropy Operation’s will oversee the creation of an annual events strategy with the Director of Philanthropy to fulfill the annual fundraising plan which includes coordinating with global, PG, and other BU event strategies. They will help create compelling programmatic content and effective and innovative events to achieve long-term fundraising goals. The Director of Philanthropy Operations works with development and chapter leadership to ensure alignment, teamwork and teambuilding, management and staff empowerment that fosters a positive and inclusive environment. The Director will work with teams to establish and track measures and lead indicators of progress and success, such as BU PPI and PbD Continuum tracking. They will serve as key team member for the enhancement of systems and tools used by the team, including new, innovative tools such as AI, advanced wealth screening, and communication innovation. In times of campaign, they oversee all non-direct fundraising activity of a comprehensive campaign.


The Director will reinforce consistency in the organization's policies and procedures and provide direction related to their relevant field(s). They are responsible for ensuring programmatic work is a collaborative and well-integrated effort within philanthropy, including organizing internal communications for their area. They will lead various activities, develop complex processes, project outcomes, and initiate solutions to improve effectiveness. They will leverage constructive and effective relationships with a wide range of people, including senior management, conservation staff, and financial/legal advisors.

Responsibilities & Scope


  • Broad, proactive management responsibility for four or more administrative or professional staff, including training, professional development, establishing clear expectations, setting “stretch” objectives, and overseeing the execution of day-to-day work.
  • Commit actions and resources in a way that affects public image and binds the organization financially or legally.
  • Develop and administer budget, evaluate results and develop corrective strategies as needed.
  • Ensure that programmatic commitments, TNC policies and procedures, and financial standards are met and managed for ethical compliance.
  • Implement and direct multiple projects, directing work of staff, setting deadlines, and ensuring accountability.
  • Lead new programs/initiatives that will ensure department and organization-wide goals and strategies are achieved.
  • Maintain confidentiality of frequently sensitive and emotionally charged information.
  • Manage strategic initiatives through collaboration with stakeholders in order to enhance performance in accordance with short and long-term objectives.
  • Maximum opportunity to act independently resolves complex issues within program area.
  • May direct or participate in negotiations for complex, high profile or sensitive agreements.
  • Minimize legal risk to the Conservancy and ensure legal compliance with applicable state and local regulations.
  • Responsibility and accountability for meeting strategic goals and objectives.
  • Travel frequently and on short notice, work long hours and weekends.
  • Work environment involves only infrequent exposure to disagreeable elements and minor physical exertion and/or strain.

What You’ll Bring:


  • Bachelor’s degree and 7 years related experience.
  • Experience in planning and delivering budgetary responsibilities.
  • Experience managing and supervising a multidisciplinary team.
  • Experience developing, managing, and implementing multiple projects and strategic goals.
  • Experience working across complex organizations.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams across multiple organizational levels.
  • Experience, coursework, or other training in principles, practices, and procedures of relevant field.

Desired Qualifications:


  • Multi-lingual skills and multi-cultural or cross-cultural experience appreciated.
  • Effective training skills.
  • Effectively communicates via presentations, conversations, and documents.
  • Experience managing a geographically dispersed team.
  • Expert knowledge of current and evolving trends in relevant discipline.
  • Proficiency in synthesizing materials from multiple sources into a coherent and accurate summary.
  • Proficiency in working independently as well as jointly with colleagues on a team.
  • Understanding of best practices in non-profit management.

This position requires a valid driver's license and compliance with TNC’s Auto Safety Program. Employees may not drive Conservancy-owned/leased vehicles, rental cars, or personal vehicles on behalf of the Conservancy if considered "high risk drivers." To learn more about the Auto Safety Program, visit the Auto Safety information page. Employment in this position will be contingent upon completion of a Vehicle Use Agreement, which may include a review of the prospective employee's motor vehicle record.


Salary Information:


The starting pay range for a candidate selected for this position is generally within the range of $108,00.00 – $135,000.00. This range only applies to candidates whose country of employment is the USA. Where a successful candidate’s actual pay will fall within this range will be based on a variety of factors, including, for example, the candidate's location, qualifications, specific skills, and experience. Please note countries outside the USA would have a different pay range in the local currency based on the local labor market, and not tied to USA pay or ranges. Your geographic location will be confirmed during the recruitment.

Who We Are:

The Nature Conservancy’s mission is to protect the lands and waters upon which all life depends. As a science-based organization, we create innovative, on-the-ground solutions to our world’s toughest challenges so that we can create a world in which people and nature thrive. We’re rooted in our mission and guided by our values, which include respect for all people, communities, and cultures. Whether it’s career development, flexible schedules, or a rewarding mission, there’s many reasons to love life inside TNC. Want a better insight to TNC? Check out our TNC Talent playlist on YouTube to hear stories from staff or visit Glassdoor.

One goal is to cultivate an inclusive work environment so that all our colleagues around the globe feel a sense of belonging and that their unique contributions to our mission are valued. In addition to the requirements in our job postings, we recognize that people come with talent and experiences outside of a job and consider each applicant’s unique experience. Please apply – we’d love to hear from you. To quote a popular saying at TNC, “you’ll join for the mission, and stay for the people.”

What We Bring:

Since 1951, TNC has been doing work you can believe in. Through grassroots action, we have grown from a small non-profit into one of the most effective and wide-reaching environmental organizations in the world. Thanks to more than 1 million members, over 400 scientists, and the dedicated efforts of our diverse staff and partners, we impact conservation around the world!

TNC offers a competitive, comprehensive benefits package including health care benefits, flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) plan with an 8% employer match, parental leave, accrued paid time off, life insurance, disability coverage, employee assistance program, other life and work well-being benefits. Learn more about our Benefits and Perks here.

We’re proud to offer a flexible work environment that supports of the health and well-being of the people we employ.

Our recruiting process includes a rolling interview process to ensure we engage applicants in a timely manner. This means we may review applications in the order in which they are received. Once a strong candidate pool is identified, the role will be unposted. The timeline may vary depending on the expressed interest in the role, so we highly encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible.

The Nature Conservancy is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Our commitment to equal employment opportunity includes the recognition that our conservation mission is best advanced by the leadership and contributions of people of all backgrounds, beliefs, and culture. Recruiting and mentoring staff to create an inclusive organization is a priority, and we encourage applicants from all cultures, races, colors, religions, sexes, national or regional origins, ages, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity, military, protected veteran status or other status protected by law.

The successful applicant must meet the requirements of The Nature Conservancy's background screening process.

Do you have military experience? Visit our U.S. Military Skills Translator to match your military experience with our current job openings!

TNC is committed to offering accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please send a note to with Request for Accommodation in the subject line.

Job Posting Title:

Account Manager, OTAs (O-EMEA)

Req ID:

10158149

Job Description:

About the Role & Team

As an Account Manager specialising in OTA Partnerships, you will grow and develop Disney’s Online Travel Agency partnerships across EMEA, excluding the UK. The role focuses on improving the visibility, positioning, and booking performance of Disney Parks and Resorts on key third-party travel platforms.

In this role, you will lead commercially driven account plans and partner marketing initiatives designed to strengthen distribution, optimise channel performance, and deliver measurable revenue growth. You will translate the OTA strategy into actionable partner plans, collaborating closely with local market teams, marketing functions, central stakeholders, and external partners to deliver integrated activity across multiple markets.

Success in this role requires strong commercial acumen, effective stakeholder management, and the ability to operate with pace and agility. You will bring structure, clarity, and momentum to a growing distribution channel, balancing revenue objectives with brand integrity, market requirements, and an exceptional guest experience.

Values

You’ll join a team grounded in our Disney values, acting with Integrity, welcoming everyone through Inclusion, embracing boundless Creativity, working together through Collaboration and caring deeply for our Community. These values shape how we work and how we support one another every day.

What you will do

In this skilled, experienced role, you will lead commercially focused account plans and partner marketing activity that strengthen distribution, improve channel performance, and drive measurable revenue growth across O‑EMEA OTAs, acting as a lead, mentor, and problem‑solver for cross‑functional partners and project teams.

  • Grow Disney’s OTA partnerships across O‑EMEA by expanding distribution, improving visibility, and driving measurable revenue performance through key travel platforms.

  • Develop annual account plans for priority OTA partners, aligned to business priorities, market opportunities, and channel performance goals, acting as a subject matter expert for OTA strategy.

raw.description:
About Us:

Good Business Lab (GBL) is a research-to-action nonprofit that advances access to high-quality jobs for low-income workers. We believe a truly good job is more than wages — it creates conditions for workers to thrive. Yet too few workers have access to sustained wage growth, supportive workplaces, and real opportunities for advancement. GBL works to change this by expanding pathways into better-fit, higher-opportunity work and improving job quality within large employers. We study worker needs, partner with workers and employers to co-design interventions that serve both individual and business goals, and evaluate impact through causal methods. Across manufacturing, retail, and food service, our work shows that improving job quality also improves firm performance. Globally, we have directly improved outcomes for over 500,000 workers, with indirect reach across an ecosystem impacting nearly 2 million more.

The founders of the GBL are Ach Adhvaryu – Professor of Economics, Director of 21st Century India Center, School of Global Policy and Strategy at UC San Diego, Anant Ahuja – Director of ESG and Sustainability at Shahi Exports Pvt. Ltd. (India’s largest Ready Made Garment firm), and Anant Nyshadham – Associate Professor of Business Economics and Public Policy at the University of Michigan.

About the role

The Senior Associate – Digital Marketing & Communications will be the primary operational owner of GBL’s website and digital marketing systems. The role will ensure that GBL’s research, solutions, insights, and organisational story are presented through accurate, accessible, engaging, and measurable digital experiences. You will combine hands-on website management with SEO, analytics, digital campaigns, technical support for events, vendor coordination, and cross-functional project management. You will work closely with colleagues across Marketing & Communications, Growth, Research, Programmes, and Design to convert organisational priorities into effective digital journeys and audience-facing outputs. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of content, technology, design, and strategy and is equally comfortable making website updates, interpreting performance data, and coordinating specialists for more complex work.

We strongly encourage applications from individuals belonging to historically underrepresented and marginalized communities. If comfortable, please share your social location in your application. This information will be limited to the hiring team and will not have any detrimental impact on your candidature.

Location: Delhi/Bangalore/Remote

Compensation: 10-12 LPA

Type of Engagement: Full Time

Roles and Responsibilities:

Website ownership and digital experience

  • Own day-to-day management of GBL’s website and related digital properties.
  • Maintain a website roadmap covering content updates, technical fixes, feature improvements, and strategic development.
  • Manage CMS and no-code updates for blogs, case studies, reports, team profiles, landing pages, forms, and other institutional content.
  • Build and maintain reusable page templates and components using Framer or comparable platforms.
  • Conduct regular quality checks across desktop, tablet, and mobile experiences, including links, forms, responsiveness, interactions, and page consistency.
  • Identify and prioritise bugs or technical debt; resolve issues directly where possible and coordinate developers or vendors where specialist support is required.

SEO, analytics, and digital performance

  • Lead on-page SEO, including metadata, internal linking, page structure, sitemaps, indexing hygiene, and content optimisation.
  • Monitor traffic, acquisition, engagement, conversions, and priority-page performance using Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Microsoft Clarity, Looker Studio, or comparable tools.
  • Develop recurring performance reports with clear insights, recommendations, and experiments.
  • Maintain UTM, attribution, and conversion-tracking practices across social media, email, paid campaigns, and partner links.
  • Use performance data and user feedback to recommend improvements to content, website architecture, and digital campaigns.

Digital campaigns and content operations

  • Support integrated digital campaigns across the website, social media, email, and paid channels.
  • Work with content and design colleagues to adapt research, reports, and organisational updates into effective digital formats.
  • Support the execution of the editorial calendar and coordinate copy, design, review, approval, scheduling, and publishing workflows for digital marketing channels.
  • Build reusable campaign templates, checklists, content banks, and workflows that improve consistency and reduce last-minute production.
  • Support paid-media activity on platforms such as LinkedIn Campaign Manager and Meta Business Manager, including setup, tracking, budget monitoring, and reporting.

Digital and technical support for events

  • Build and maintain event landing pages or microsites, registration and waitlist forms, confirmation flows, and related website components.
  • Set up tracking, integrations, and analytics for event registrations and digital campaigns.
  • Coordinate with vendors or internal teams to troubleshoot forms, embeds, links, livestreams, and other technical requirements.
  • Conduct pre-launch quality assurance and post-event updates or archiving for digital event assets.

Project, vendor, and systems management

  • Convert broad objectives into project plans with milestones, owners, dependencies, review points, and measurable outcomes.
  • Maintain accurate trackers and communicate timelines, blockers, risks, and trade-offs early.
  • Brief and coordinate website, design, development, analytics, or other specialist partners as required.
  • Translate internal requirements into clear scopes, acceptance criteria, and consolidated feedback; conduct final quality assurance before sign-off.
  • Maintain SOPs, templates, checklists, screen-recorded walkthroughs, and onboarding resources for recurring digital tasks.
  • Keep an updated register of digital tools, owners, access routes, use cases, renewal needs, and costs.

Who are you?

Required technical skills and experience

  • 3–5 years of relevant experience in digital marketing, website management, integrated communications, growth marketing, or a related field.
  • Hands-on experience managing a CMS or no-code website platform; experience with Framer, Webflow, WordPress, or comparable tools.
  • Strong working knowledge of SEO, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, UTMs, conversion tracking, and digital-performance reporting.
  • Experience supporting digital campaigns across website, social media, email, and/or paid media.
  • Ability to diagnose common website issues, manage responsive QA, and coordinate specialist technical support when required.

Required behavioural skills

  • Strong project-management and organisational skills, including managing dependencies and competing deadlines.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to translate complex information into practical briefs and audience-facing content.
  • Strong ownership, attention to detail, and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving problems.
  • Ability to collaborate across teams, manage external partners, communicate risks early, and work independently in a remote or hybrid environment.
  • Interest in GBL’s mission and commitment to communicating research and social impact responsibly.

We understand that candidates may not meet every listed requirement exactly. So please avoid the confidence gap, if this role excites you, and go ahead and apply. You don’t have to match all the listed requirements exactly to be considered for this role.

Additional Requirements: (If Any)

Good to have, but not essential:

  • Experience in a non-profit, research, social-impact, consulting, or project-based organisation.
  • Familiarity with paid-media, email-marketing, design, or collaboration tools such as LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Meta Business Manager, Mailchimp, Figma, Miro, or Canva.
  • Basic understanding of domains, hosting, DNS, integrations, and website troubleshooting.
  • Experience with information architecture, digital publications, or data-led storytelling.

Recent projects and blog posts:

To acclimatize yourself with some of our work, you can explore our website where you’ll find project insights, podcasts and reports. You can also read our blog posts on Medium, and follow us on LinkedIn, Facebook, Twitter (X), and Instagram to learn more about our work.

Deadline to Apply: On rolling basis

The process:

We are glad you’re interested in applying for this role! We deeply value your time and effort.

Our interview process for this role includes the following steps:

  1. Introductory Conversation
  2. Assignment
  3. First Round of Interview
  4. Second Round of Interview

Depending on the candidate pool, we may add any additional interviews to make a well thought through decision.

The hiring team will review your application after each round and share a timely update on your application status and keep you updated on your progression through the following stages.

Our commitment to diversity:

GBL is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, age, physical disability, or length of time spent unemployed. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We are a young and growing company making us the ideal ground for team members to experiment, take on dynamic roles, and grow with us. We focus on happiness, output, and quality of work.

If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.

Background Verification:

Employment with GBL is contingent upon satisfactory background verification. GBL reserves the right to withdraw the offer in the event of any adverse or unsatisfactory findings.

Salary: INR 10-12 LPA

Job Description:

Shape the Future of AI in Capital Markets and Legal Disclosure


At Toppan Merrill, we're building Quinn, a cloud-based platform that helps law firms, investment banks, and public companies draft, review, and file SEC documents, including IPO registration statements, prospectuses, proxy statements, and annual and quarterly reports.


We're applying AI to one of the most consequential document workflows in the world, where precision, trust, and accountability matter the most. This is a unique opportunity to join a small, highly visible team and help define the future of AI-assisted financial disclosure. You'll work directly with senior engineering leadership, engage with some of the world's largest law firms, and help shape a product already supported by a working prototype and strong market interest.

Most importantly, you'll be the first AI-dedicated Product Owner for Quinn. Your leadership will ensure we're building the right solutions for customers and bringing clarity, prioritization, and rigor to every product decision.


Learn more at . About Toppan Merrill

What You'll Do


As Principal Product Owner, you will lead product discovery and product execution for Quinn’s AI capabilities, translating Quinn’s broader product strategy into validated AI solutions and prioritized delivery.

You'll partner closely with engineering, legal, security, sales, and customers to translate market needs into innovative, practical solutions that professionals can trust.


Product Strategy & Ownership


  • Own and prioritize the Quinn AI product backlog.
  • Transform client feedback, market insights, and emerging product opportunities into clear, actionable requirements.
  • Define and maintain the Quinn AI roadmap, release priorities, and measurable success criteria in alignment with the broader Quinn product strategy.
  • Create detailed user stories, requirements, and acceptance criteria that enable engineering teams to deliver high-quality solutions.
  • Balance customer needs, technical feasibility, business priorities, and regulatory requirements when making product decisions.

Customer & Partner Engagement

  • Lead product discovery with customers and design partners to understand workflows, identify unmet needs, validate concepts, and assess product-market fit.
  • Translate discovery insights into hypotheses, product decisions, experiments, and prioritized development opportunities.”
  • Distinguish problems that warrant AI solutions from those better addressed through conventional product capabilities or workflow changes.
  • Build trusted relationships with attorneys, corporate reporting leaders, and other detail-oriented professional users.

AI Product Delivery

  • Define the scope, success criteria, and acceptance standards for AI-powered features.
  • Establish quality thresholds for capabilities that attorneys and financial professionals will rely on in critical SEC reporting workflows.
  • Define evaluation frameworks and quality thresholds for AI capabilities, including accuracy, groundedness, completeness, consistency, and appropriate human oversight.”
  • Partner with Engineering to establish representative evaluation datasets, regression testing, and feedback loops that measure AI quality over time.
  • Define what AI features should and should not do within customer documents.
  • Partner with engineering leadership to establish realistic timelines and delivery commitments.
  • Review and approve product scope and release plans before commitments are shared externally.

Security, Compliance & Governance

  • Collaborate with Legal, Security, and Engineering teams to define appropriate handling of customer content and sensitive documents.
  • Ensure AI capabilities align with security, compliance, privacy, and governance requirements.
  • Help shape responsible AI practices within a highly regulated environment.

What Success Looks Like in Your First 90 Days

  • Establish a structured product discovery approach for Quinn AI and begin discovery with prospective and confirmed design partners.
  • Take ownership of the Quinn AI backlog and establish clear product priorities aligned with the broader Quinn roadmap.
  • Define and publish pilot scope, success metrics, and acceptance criteria.
  • Build strong partnerships with Engineering, Legal, Security, and executive stakeholders.

raw.excerpt: About UsAt Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet.
raw.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Location:

  • Preferred Locations: San Francisco, Austin, NYC OR Remote

About the Role

Cloudflare’s GTM organization is scaling rapidly, and its RevOps tech stack must scale with it. We are hiring a RevOps Technologist to shape future-state workflows and move our RevOps technology roadmap from strategy and prototype toward secure, scalable execution.

This senior individual contributor will combine deep Sales and Revenue Operations expertise with the hands-on technical fluency to identify strategic solutions and simplified workflows. You'll report directly to the Director of RevTech Strategy & Operations, and be the senior counterpart to our business partners, IT, Procurement, Engineering, Security & Privacy, to ensure our systems are optimized, and governed.

You will transform our rapidly scaling, today’s fragmented tech stack into a secure, orchestrated engine, across vendor platforms, internal tooling, and Cloudflare’s internal orchestration platform (Cloudflare OS). You will set the direction for Build/Buy/Blend opportunities, prototype AI- and automation-enabled capabilities, and partner with IT and Engineering to move validated solutions toward production.

You will bring an end-to-end view across workflows, systems, data and integrations, to reduce complexity and elevate the seller experience while balancing technical feasibility with business value.

We are looking for someone who doesn't just manage the existing RevOps stack, but actively reimagines a scalable, best-in-class stack with a stellar seller experience. If you thrive on challenging the status quo, hands-on building with cutting-edge technology, and turning bold GTM ideas into high-impact reality, we want to talk to you.

What You’ll Do:

Shape the Future of RevTech & GTM Systems

  • Drive the AI-first RevOps technology roadmap across internal systems, Cloudflare OS, vendor platforms, and new build opportunities, to improve seller efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Identify where the stack needs to scale, simplify, or modernize based on jobs-to-be-done, user needs, and workflow friction points.
  • Connect technology decisions across the broader GTM ecosystem (workflows, systems, data, integrations, and dependencies) rather than optimizing individual tools in isolation.
  • Apply AI, agents, automation, and emerging technologies to practical opportunities that reduce friction, and modernize GTM operations.
  • Document current state-workflows, systems, dependencies and pain points to identify exactly where the stack needs to scale or simplify, and translate findings into clear future-state designs and recommendations.

Design, Prototype & Automate

  • Translate sales capabilities “jobs-to-be-done", workflow context, and user needs into clear technology requirements and solution approaches balancing user experience, scalability, and technical feasibility.
  • Architect solutions across the RevTech landscape that work cohesively with existing CRM, sales engagement, forecasting, data, and other seller technologies.
  • Leverage Cloudflare OS, AI, agents, and automation to prototype and build secure solutions, validating where tech adds value vs. human judgement is required.
  • Partner with IT and Engineering to move validated solutions toward production, aligning on the APIs, MCPs, integrations, and security.

Drive Technology & Investment Strategy

  • Advise on build, buy, blend, or retire decisions based on time-to-value, scalability, security, cost, and flexibility.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce unnecessary SaaS dependency, utilizing Cloudflare OS or internal capabilities where appropriate.
  • Bring a technical and strategic lens to technology investments, partnering with Procurement, Software Asset Management, IT, and business stakeholders to evaluate vendors and inform a ROI-backed roadmap investments.

Own Governance & Systems Standards

  • Define governance, intake models, and decision guardrails for RevTech and AI use cases.
  • Participate in cross-functional AI initiatives to evaluate, prioritize, and scale AI-enabled seller workflows.
  • Establish auditable RevTech change controls with clear governance based on risk and impact.
  • Ensure vendors and internal builds comply with security, privacy, data, and AI standards.

Strategic Partnership & Communications

  • Build trusted relationships across GTM, tech teams, business partners and vendors as a trusted advisor on priorities, trade-offs, and future-state direction.
  • Translate complex tech concepts and ROI assessments into clear, decision-ready executive recommendations and business impact analyses.
  • Leverage external benchmarks (e.g., Gartner) and industry trends to inform tool strategy.
  • Support the RevTech budget planning and stewardship in partnership with business partners, Finance and procurement.

Skills, Knowledge & Experience

  • 8+ years in Revenue Operations, GTM Systems, Sales Ops, Business Systems, or related roles within B2B SaaS organizations.
  • Deep understanding of B2B seller workflows, sales processes, and the broader GTM technology ecosystem.
  • Deep, hands-on experience across GTM technology ecosystem, including CRM, sales engagement, forecasting, revenue orchestration, enablement, data, and automation (e.g; Salesforce, Clari, Gong, Outreach, ZoomInfo, Highspot, LinkedIn Navigator, Clay etc.)
  • Hands-on experience with AI, agents, and automation, with ability to rapidly prototype solutions, test assumptions, and solve business problems.
  • Solid conceptual and practical understanding of how modern tools connect via APIs, data flows, and “headless” architecture (separating the custom UI a seller uses from the backend).
  • 5+ years driving cross-functional technology initiatives, from discovery, vendor evaluation and solution design to secure implementation and adoption across the enterprise.
  • Proven track record of evaluating technology options, identifying build/buy/blend opportunities, developing ROI-backed recommendations, and influencing senior stakeholders to drive enterprise alignment.
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, IT, marketing, or a technical field is required (Master’s or advanced degree, or AI/data training, is a plus).

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on building with emerging AI agent frameworks, custom GPTs, or AI-driven workflow tools to enhance seller productivity.
  • Background in consulting or solution architecture, with exposure to advisory frameworks (e.g; Gartner, Forrester).
  • Certifications: Salesforce (Advanced Administrator, Sales Cloud, AI Associate) or any relevant AI, or business systems certifications.
  • Familiarity with Cloudflare products, commercial negotiations, and tech marketplace dynamics.
  • Experience standing up internal automation platforms or replacing SaaS tools with internal builds.

Compensation

Estimated compensation may be adjusted depending on work location and level of experience!

  • San Francisco Bay Area (San Francisco, San Jose): Estimated Annual Salary of $145,000 - $230,000

  • Major Metro Hubs & Select Remote (Boston, Kirkland, NYC Metro, DC Metro, plus Remote CA, CT, MA, NJ, WA): Estimated Annual Salary of $132,000 - $182,000

  • Other Remote States (CO, IL, MD, MN, NV, NY, RI, VT): Estimated Annual Salary of $120,000 - $165,000

    • CO ONLY Application Deadline: January 24, 2027

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

Benefits

Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.

Health & Welfare Benefits

  • Medical/Rx Insurance
  • Dental Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Commuter Spending Accounts
  • Fertility & Family Forming Benefits
  • On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program
  • Global Travel Medical Insurance

Financial Benefits

  • Short and Long Term Disability Insurance
  • Life & Accident Insurance
  • 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan
  • Employee Stock Participation Plan

Time Off

  • Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave
  • Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

: We released to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actualrace, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment. An experienced clinical research professional who brings strong quality focus, analytical thinking, clear communication, sound judgment, and the ability to work collaboratively across virtual teams. About Upstart

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

The Team:

Upstart’s Brand & Creative team shapes how people discover, understand, and experience Upstart. Our web team brings together design, SEO, content, and production to create useful, engaging experiences that support our brand and business goals.

As the Senior Web Producer at Upstart, you’ll manage web requests across products and stakeholders, turn priorities into production plans, and build and publish pages in WordPress and Instapage. You’ll partner with our Lead Web Designer, SEO / Web Lead, channel owners, and Engineering to keep work moving and balance business impact within the limitations of team capacity. You’ll also coordinate and execute a quarterly landing page testing roadmap in partnership with channel owners and Analytics, developing hypotheses, launching experiments, and sharing insights that improve web performance.

How you’ll make an impact

  • Manage web intake and prioritization. Clarify goals and requirements across products and stakeholders. Partner with Design, our SEO / Web Lead, and Engineering to assess impact, scope effort, and negotiate priorities, timelines, and tradeoffs.

  • Build quarterly web production roadmaps. Translate agreed priorities into actionable plans, coordinate dependencies and approvals, and communicate progress, risks, and changes to stakeholders.

  • Own day-to-day platform operations. Administer WordPress and Instapage and maintain documentation, naming conventions, and access permissions. Provide first-line issue triage, escalate bugs, surface feature requests to Engineering, and validate fixes.

  • Build and publish web experiences. Create and maintain pages using approved designs and reusable components. Partner with Design and Engineering to maintain page templates and perform QA across browsers and devices before and after publishing.

  • Own landing page testing execution. Partner with channel owners to develop and prioritize hypotheses, align on success metrics with Analytics, build in-platform variants, launch tests, monitor performance, and recommend improvements based on results.

  • Turn results into shared learnings. Analyze test results with relevant partners, communicate findings and recommended next steps, and publish winning experiences. Maintain a record of learnings to inform future tests across products and channels.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in web production, website management, or marketing web operations.

  • Hands-on experience building, updating, and publishing pages in WordPress, Instapage, or comparable CMS and self-serve landing page platforms.

  • Experience managing web projects from request intake through launch, including production schedules, cross-functional dependencies, and approvals.

  • Hands-on experience configuring and launching website or landing page A/B tests.

  • Experience using web analytics or experimentation tools to analyze page performance or test results and produce reports.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Ability to navigate competing stakeholder needs, explain tradeoffs, and negotiate scope and timing diplomatically.

  • Knowledge of conversion optimization and experience translating audience insights, channel goals, or performance data into testable hypotheses.

  • Working knowledge of responsive design, accessibility, SEO fundamentals, and web QA.

  • Familiarity with Figma, basic HTML/CSS, and headless CMS workflows.

  • Experience improving publishing processes, documenting workflows, and managing platform access and governance.

Position location Remote

Time zone requirements The team operates on the West coast time zones.

Travel requirements As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in-person sessions’ cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2-4 consecutive days at a time.

At Upstart, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package. The anticipated base salary for this position is expected to be within the below range. Your actual base pay will depend on your geographic location–with our “digital first” philosophy, Upstart uses compensation regions that vary depending on location. Individual pay is also determined by job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

In addition, Upstart provides employees with target bonuses, equity compensation, and generous benefits packages (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k).

United States | Remote - Anticipated Base Salary Range
$109,000—$160,000 USD

What you'll love

At Upstart, our benefits for full-time employees are designed to support your health, financial well-being, family, and personal growth. Here’s what you can expect:

  • Competitive compensation, including base pay, bonus opportunities, and annual equity grants that vest quarterly
  • Retirement benefits to help you plan for the future, including a 401(k) or Group Retirement Savings Plan with a company match of $2 for every $1 contributed, up to $15,000 annually (USD in the US, CAD in Canada)
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) with discounted stock purchase options for eligible employees (US only)
  • Comprehensive health coverage designed to support you and your family, including medical, dental, vision, and wellness resources for US and supplemental health coverage for Canada.
  • Health Savings Account contributions from Upstart for eligible plans (US only)
  • Income protection benefits, including life insurance and disability coverage for added financial security
  • Paid time off, sick leave, and company holidays, in line with local requirements
  • Paid family and parental leave to support caregiving and major life moments (duration varies by country)
  • Family-centered benefits to support fertility, parenthood, and caregiving needs
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) offering mental health support and life-centered resources
  • Financial wellness resources, including access to financial planning tools and a financial concierge service (US Only)
  • Annual wellness allowance to support your physical and emotional well-being and personal development, based on what matters most to you
  • Annual productivity allowance to invest in relevant tools and resources you need to do your best work, no matter where you work from
  • Connection and community through team events, all-company updates, and employee resource groups (ERGs)
  • Onsite perks, including catered lunches and fully stocked micro-kitchens when working from one of our offices in the Bay Area, Austin, Columbus, and New York City

For roles based in Canada, please note that we are not currently able to hire in Quebec.

Role Title: Military Operations Expert

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

About the Role

micro1 is seeking current or former military professionals with firsthand operational experience to contribute to an AI development project focused on military operations, tactical decision-making, and international humanitarian law. You'll evaluate AI-generated military scenarios, identify inaccuracies, and provide expert feedback to improve AI reasoning and reliability.

Scope of Work

  1. Evaluate AI-generated military scenarios for operational realism, tactical accuracy, and sound decision-making.
  2. Review military planning, combat operations, targeting, and weapons employment scenarios.
  3. Assess the application of Rules of Engagement (ROE), Law of Armed Conflict (LOAC), and operational constraints.
  4. Identify inaccuracies and provide clear, structured written feedback.

Qualifications

  1. Military operational experience in areas such as infantry, Special Operations Forces, combat aviation, artillery, targeting, air defense, naval operations, or military intelligence.
  2. Strong understanding of military operations, tactical planning, and operational decision-making.
  3. Ability to assess complex scenarios and communicate findings clearly in writing.
  4. Combat deployments, operational command, weapons specialization, or military instructional experience are highly desirable.
  5. Familiarity with ROE, LOAC, or international humanitarian law is a plus.

Role Title: Humanitarian Aid Representative

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Humanitarian Aid Representatives to contribute their field expertise in humanitarian and civilian protection for a unique project. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. The focus of this engagement is to design, review, and refine scenarios involving civilian harm, protected persons, and the boundaries of legitimate activity, ensuring responses are grounded in International Humanitarian Law (IHL) and best practices in humanitarian action. Strong written and verbal communication skills are highly valued, as your insights and documentation will directly influence AI performance and sensitivity to complex humanitarian concerns.

Scope of Work

  1. Develop nuanced cases and scenarios focused on civilian protection, proportionality, and humanitarian constraints for AI model evaluation.
  2. Assess and grade AI-generated responses for accuracy, depth of reasoning, and sensitivity to civilian-harm considerations.
  3. Identify and flag instances of excessive caution or insufficient restraint in model responses, highlighting humanitarian implications.
  4. Document challenging or ambiguous cases from a humanitarian perspective to inform future training and refinement.
  5. Collaborate with project stakeholders to clarify humanitarian concepts and contribute to guidance on IHL-related reasoning.
  6. Maintain precise, clear, and context-rich records of findings and recommendations.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Background in humanitarian operations, protection, or policy with organizations such as ICRC/Red Cross, UN agencies, or major NGOs.
  2. Strong grounding in International Humanitarian Law and civilian-protection principles.
  3. Experience in teaching, training, or field leadership related to humanitarian action or IHL dissemination.
  4. Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills, especially in crafting and reviewing complex case material.
  5. Proven ability to apply proportionality reasoning in conflict or protection scenarios.
  6. Experience documenting or reporting on edge cases or challenging humanitarian situations.
  7. Conflict-zone fieldwork, protection-cluster participation, or IHL-dissemination experience is highly valued.

The Manager, Customer Engagement serves as a central architect for product Go-To-Market (GTM) execution, bridging the gap between technical product development and clinical application to maximize time-to-value. Operating with minimal oversight under the general direction of their leaders, the Manager is responsible for quarterbacking the end-to-end launch lifecycle for assigned product and program portfolios (such as Quality, Affordability, or Care Programs). This role requires a consultative and solution-oriented professional with a deep sense of curiosity to navigate ambiguous environments and make the unknown known. The Manager will actively utilize proprietary AI-driven workflow tools to scale enablement content, resolve complex roadblocks with creativity, and coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure releases are completely field- and practice-ready.
Candidates should be comfortable working remotely from anywhere within the US, across all US time zones.

Primary Duties

    1. End-to-End Release Management & Coordination: Fully quarterback the product launch lifecycle for assigned portfolio. Coordinate cross-functionally across Product, Business, Legal, and Field teams to track technology releases, leading messaging development and aligning release importance to associated communication tiering.
    2. Multi-Channel Asset Development: Build, write, and finalize the complete suite of enablement materials (including live training slides, newsletters, email templates, Pendo guides, and Zendesk Knowledge Base articles, etc). Actively utilize the internal AI tools to scale draft content production, ensuring all messaging aligns with organizational communication strategy and compliance and legal review protocols.
    3. Operations & Practice Recruitment: Serve as the gatekeeper for early-phase product testing. Formulate practice selection criteria, manage recruitment and eligibility and launch of new features/programs, and coordinate qualitative feedback loops during beta testing to de-risk releases before General Availability.
    4. Project Tracking & Channel Socialization: Maintain and optimize project tracking structures and communication channels to ensure cross-functional accountability. Schedule, package, and socialize release communications across established field and practice channels (such as newsletters and webinars) to all customers understand and can leverage product and program releases to support VBC performance.

Minimum Qualifications:

    Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s Degree with 5 or more years of experience in customer success, client solutions, professional services, or product operations.
  • Prior experience at a healthcare services or healthcare technology company, with strong familiarity in primary care workflows and value-based care contracts.
  • Proven ability to independently scope, map, and navigate complex or ambiguous projects, applying broad expertise to make the unknown known and propose creative solutions

    • Requirements:

  • Highly consultative skillset with a strong sense of curiosity; possesses the initiative to take on ambiguous challenges and "make the unknown known".
  • Must be willing to learn and actively utilize AI tooling as a necessary element of daily work to automate and scale workflows, including content development.
  • Capable of leading existing or well-defined tasks with minimal guidance, applying extreme attention to detail across deliverables.

Preferred KSA's:

  • 5 years of relevant experience.
  • Familiarity with AI prompt engineering or workflow automation.
  • Experience with project and platform tools such as Monday.com, Pendo, Salesforce, or Zendesk.
  • Capable of leading by influence in a matrixed environment to drive project execution across disparate stakeholder groups.
  • Strong presentation skills with the ability to concisely explain complex technical and operational concepts to senior-level audiences.

Physical Requirements:

  • Sitting for prolonged periods of time.
  • Extensive use of computers and keyboard.
  • Willingness to travel 2-4 trips/year to headquarters or retreat locations.

Who We Are:

Aledade PBC, a public benefit corporation, exists to empower the most transformational part of our health care landscape - independent primary care. We were founded in 2014, and since then, we've become the largest network of independent primary care in the country - helping practices, health centers and clinics deliver better care to their patients and thrive in value-based care. Additionally, by creating value-based contracts across a wide variety of health plans, we aim to flip the script on the traditional fee-for-service model. Our work strengthens continuity of care, aligns incentives and ensures primary care physicians are paid for what they do best - keeping patients healthy. If you want to help create a health care system that is good for patients, good for practices and good for society - and if you're eager to join a collaborative, inclusive and remote-first culture - you've come to the right place.

What Does This Mean for You?

At Aledade PBC, you will be part of a creative culture that is driven by a passion for tackling complex issues with respect, open-mindedness and a desire to learn. You will collaborate with team members who bring a wide range of experiences, interests, backgrounds, beliefs and achievements to their work - and who are all united by a shared passion for public health and a commitment to the Aledade mission.
In addition to time off to support work-life balance and enjoyment, we offer the following comprehensive benefits package designed for the overall well-being of our team members:
Flexible work schedules and the ability to work remotely are available for many roles
Health, dental and vision insurance paid up to 80% for employees, dependents and domestic partners
Robust time-off plan (21 days of PTO in your first year)
Two paid volunteer days and 11 paid holidays
12 weeks paid parental leave for all new parents
Six weeks paid sabbatical after six years of service
Educational Assistant Program and Clinical Employee Reimbursement Program
401(k) with up to 4% match
Stock options
And much more!
At Aledade PBC, we don’t just accept differences, we celebrate them! We strive to attract, develop and retain highly qualified individuals representing the diverse communities where we live and work. Employment policies and decisions at Aledade are based on merit, qualifications, performance and business needs. We accompany our customers every step of the way, from the moment they partner with us, to the end of their journey. We work hard and like to have fun along the way.   • Self-motivated and able to master complex software

raw.description:
CaptivateIQ is the leading Sales Performance Management solution, recognized by Forrester and G2, and trusted by customers including Affirm, Gong, and Figma. With solutions for Sales Planning and Incentives, we help revenue teams automate processes, hit revenue targets, and adapt with business change, ultimately driving efficient growth. It's time to rethink ROI - your return on incentives - with CaptivateIQ.
With backing from Sequoia, Accel, ICONIQ, Sapphire Ventures, and other leading investors, CaptivateIQ is on a mission to enable every company to improve their return on incentives and sales planning.
Come and see why Glassdoor and Comparably have recognized CaptivateIQ as a best place to work!

About The Role:

CaptivateIQ is transforming the way companies plan, manage, and optimize the sales performance models that run their business. We started by revolutionizing incentive compensation management, expanded into sales planning, and are now building a unified platform for the most critical models an enterprise runs. As the portfolio grows, how we tell our story will be a defining advantage.

As a Senior Product Marketing Manager, you’ll own customer understanding, positioning, messaging, and launches for mid-market and enterprise customers. You’ll go deep on individual products, making each one’s unique value clear and compelling, while also shaping how they come together into a unified story.

At the heart of the role is a deep understanding of customers, competitors, and the market. You’ll turn that understanding into messaging & resources that win deals and drive adoption, support field enablement, and deliver insight that shapes our product strategy and roadmap. Your work will directly influence both what we build and how the market understands it.

You’ll report to the Director of Product Marketing and partner closely with Product, Sales, Customer Success, and RevOps. This role is built for someone equally comfortable at two altitudes: owning a product area end-to-end, and stepping back to drive strategy and storytelling across the portfolio.

Responsibilities:

  • Product positioning: Own the positioning, value propositions, and messaging for your products, and set the direction the rest of Marketing builds from.
  • Portfolio narrative: Shape how our products come together into one platform story, so customers see how CaptivateIQ is stronger as a whole.
  • Customer and market insight: Lead win/loss analysis, customer research (including interviews), competitive research, and personas. Turn what you learn into positioning as well as input on roadmap, pricing, and packaging. Show CaptivateIQ as a category expert with customers and prospects.
  • GTM activation: Make the story work in the field. Partner with Sales and Services leadership and Enablement on how we pitch, compete, and win, from battlecards to demo stories. Join deals to see what lands.
  • Launches: Drive go-to-market for launches, deciding tiering and investment, and measuring what they deliver.
  • Measurement & feedback loop: Define what success looks like, from influenced pipeline to competitive win rate and adoption, and use the data to sharpen positioning, launches, and priorities.
  • Team rigor: Help raise the bar for the PMM team by mentoring, sharing best practices, and contributing to frameworks and playbooks that make our work more consistent and effective.

Requirements:

  • 7+ years in B2B SaaS product marketing or product management, with demonstrated ability to conduct customer discovery and translate feedback into both product and go-to-market strategy
  • Experience with technical products and comfort sitting with technical teams and customers alike.
  • Track record of influencing product decisions. You can show work where customer feedback you gathered changed what shipped
  • Exceptional storytelling and communication skills. You can distill complex concepts into clear, compelling messaging
  • A structured, evidence-driven approach to research and measurement. You can conduct buyer research, read data honestly, and iterate on what you learn
  • Comfortable operating with significant autonomy in a dynamic environment; experience using AI tools
  • Deep understanding of competitive intelligence and how to use it to differentiate and win deals

Nice to Have

  • B2B enterprise fluency, particularly within the Office of the CFO, Finance, or RevOps; you understand these buyers, their specific pains, and their software evaluation criteria
  • Familiarity with SPM, ICM, or related revenue and compensation technology platforms
  • Hands-on experience developing custom AI tools or autonomous agents
  • History of driving product marketing for multi-product suites or unified platforms
  • Direct experience in the marketing of AI and agentic product solutions
  • Proven track record marketing across various industry verticals and segments, from Mid-Market to Enterprise

raw.title: Litigation Docket Specialist
raw.excerpt: Crowell & Moring LLP is an international law firm with offices in the United States, Europe, MENA, and Asia that represents clients in litigation and arbitration, regulatory and policy, intellectual property, and transactional and corporate matters.
raw.description:
Crowell & Moring LLP is an international law firm with offices in the United States, Europe, MENA, and Asia that represents clients in litigation and arbitration, regulatory and policy, intellectual property, and transactional and corporate matters. The firm is internationally recognized for representing Fortune 500 companies in high-stakes litigation and government-facing matters, as well as its ongoing commitment to pro bono service and diversity, equity, and inclusion. At Crowell & Moring, exceptional client service begins with exceptional people. We are committed to delivering responsive, high-quality, and professional service to our clients and to one another, while continuously elevating standards of excellence across every aspect of our work.

Job Summary

The Litigation Docket Specialist is responsible for managing and maintaining the legal docketing system, working with firm attorneys and staff and using the firm’s litigation docketing software. This role provides timely and detailed service to ensure all critical deadlines, court dates, and case-related events are accurately recorded, tracked, and communicated to attorneys and staff. The specialist works closely with legal teams to review court filings, monitor rules and procedures, and update the docket database with relevant information. The Specialist also provides comprehensive administrative and filing support, assists in departmental initiatives, special projects, and handles a variety of docketing and calendaring tasks.

Job Responsibilities

  • The Litigation Docket Specialist is responsible for calculating, recording and docketing litigation related deadlines for matters pending in state and federal courts, as well as arbitrations and mediations, and monitoring associated reminders, emails and reports.
  • Review court filings, orders and notices to identify important dates and requirements; enter case information, activity, and deadlines into firm docket system.
  • Ensure compliance with court rules, local procedures, and firm policies regarding docketing.
  • Communicate and coordinate with case teams to review and confirm court deadlines and instructions; communicate deadlines and changes to case teams promptly.
  • Research and/or monitor cases with the use of various online resources, and provide court filing and service information.
  • Respond promptly and professionally to information requests from attorneys and professional staff regarding docketed dates, agency and court rules and procedures.
  • Generate calendar reports and queries for case teams based upon standard procedures, and generate custom docket reports and queries as requested.
  • Assist with service and filing of court documents.
  • Perform Electronic Court Filings in Federal, State and Appellate Courts.
  • Assist with development of department policies and procedures and innovation related projects.
  • Occasional travel to local courts and agencies.
  • Other duties as assigned to fully meet the requirements of the position.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Minimum two (2) years docketing experience in a law firm docket department required.
  • Strong familiarity with litigation docketing and calendaring procedures.
  • Strong working knowledge of California Civil Practice Law and Rules, the Federal Rules of Civil and Appellate Procedure and ability to navigate other bodies of rules and procedures as needed.
  • Proficiency in utilizing docketing software (i.e. eDockets, CompuLaw, CourtAlert) for calendaring and reporting.
  • Knowledge of various court websites, docket searching and document retrieval databases (PACER, Lexis/Nexis, Westlaw, File & Serve Express etc.).
  • Strong knowledge of federal and state e-filing procedures and technologies.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office suite applications.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to prioritize tasks in a high-pressure environment.
  • Excellent communication, time management and organizational skills.
  • Strong collaborative skills and flexibility to adapt to changing department procedures when necessary.
  • Strong communication, problem-solving and service skills.
  • Available to work overtime and/or do limited business travel.

Education

The position requires a Bachelor’s Degree. Equivalent training and legal experience may substitute for education.

Experience

The position requires a minimum of two (2) years of docketing experience during which knowledge, skills and abilities relevant to the position were attained.

Pay Range

$70,000 - $110,000 - Boston, Chicago, Dallas, Denver, Los Angeles, Minneapolis, Orange County, Waltham, and Washington DC
$76,000 - $120,000 - New York & San Francisco
$68,000 - $100,000 - Other US locations

raw.description:
🚀 Be part of a movement to change the way Europe pays

In today’s digital Europe, payments still feel too complicated. Random delays, confusing rules, extra apps and accounts make it harder than it should be to pay and get paid.

The European Payments Initiative is changing that with Wero, a proudly European digital wallet to make payments easier, clearer and more secure. Online, in store, at home and across borders, with your money and data protected under European laws and regulations.

Wero is live in Belgium, France, Germany, the Netherlands and Luxembourg and launching very soon in Austria. Backed by 17 major banks and the two largest European acquirers, we’re building a brand new, proudly European payment system.

🔎 What's in it for you

  • Play a key role in strengthening the risk and internal control framework of a growing European payments company.

  • Get exposure to a broad range of risk, internal control and governance topics in a regulated environment.

  • Work closely with stakeholders across the three lines of defense and contribute directly to how risks are identified, monitored, mitigated and reported.

At EPI, we embrace a remote-first culture, enabling our teams to work remotely from the country they are based in, with in-person meetings at least once a quarter to foster collaboration and connection.

🐝 About the team

You’ll report directly to the EPI Group Risk & Internal Control Officer and work closely with key stakeholders across the three lines of defense.

💥 Your impact

  • Monitor level 1 controls, collect their results and support managers in their execution and follow-up.

  • Design, plan and perform level 2 controls using a risk-driven approach, while monitoring other level 2 controls performed by the Group DPO and Group CISO.

  • Contribute to the continuous identification, assessment and documentation of risks, maintaining the risk register, Key Risk Indicators and risk mitigation plans.

  • Monitor risk appetite thresholds and ensure appropriate mitigation actions are raised when required.

  • Contribute to risk reporting presented to EPI Committees and Supervisory Boards.

  • Monitor third-party service provider risk assessments and contribute to effective oversight of external risks.

  • Promote risk and internal control awareness across the organisation and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Collaborate with relevant stakeholders across the three lines of defense, including Compliance, Business Continuity and Risk & Compliance.

💻 Technology stack

Primary: Outlook, Slack, Teams, JIRA, Confluence

🕵🏻‍♀️ To succeed, you should meet at least 70% of these requirements

  • 2–5 years of professional experience in a similar Risk and/or Internal Control role

  • Proficient in English

  • Thrive in a remote-first, multicultural environment

Job specific requirements

  • Strong knowledge of EnterpriseRisk and Internal Control, including risk framework set-up and the Three Lines of Defense model

  • Hands-on experience with Level 1 / Level 2 control execution and testing

  • Strong understanding of risk reporting and governance, including knowledge of COSO and experience working in regulated environments

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, combined with analytical thinking, attention to detail and a proactive, continuous improvement mindset

  • Knowledge of ICT risk management, outsourcing risk management and DORA compliance would be great

  • Experience with GRC tools would be nice to have

🪜 If this looks like you, the recruitment steps are:

  • A first call with one of our recruiters

  • A technical interview focused on the role and your Risk & Internal Control expertise

  • A final interview with our Risk & Compliance team

  • Hopefully, an offer you can’t refuse

⛔ Turn back if …

  • You’re looking for an already highly structured environment with no ambiguity

  • You’re looking for a role focused only on control execution rather than a balance of controls, risk monitoring, stakeholder engagement and reporting

  • You’re not comfortable working proactively with multiple stakeholders across the three lines of defense

🎁 What we can offer

  • Remote-first culture with quarterly and annual all-staff in-person meetups to keep teams connected and collaborative

  • Possibility to work from another EU country for up to 3 months per year

  • Competitive compensation package, featuring salary, performance-based bonus, and a thoughtfully designed, high-quality benefits program

  • The opportunity to be part of a multicultural European company

  • Learning & development budget: €5,000 training budget per year

Otherwise apply!

🫶 Our commitment to equal employment opportunities

EPI offers the same job opportunities to all, without distinction of gender, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, social status, disability or age. EPI promotes the development of an inclusive work environment that mirrors the diversity of the clients our product is serving.
