raw.description:
About Lyra

Lyra Clinical Associates partners with Lyra Health, a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Lyra members have access to care in one day, and nine out of ten improve with the support of providers like you. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions. You will be employed by Lyra Clinical Associates.

About the Role

As a therapist within our Pediatric Outpatient Service Line, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact in the lives of children, teens, young adults, and their families while working as part of an integrated clinical team.

You'll provide evidence-based, developmentally appropriate therapy that helps members build resilience, strengthen relationships, develop effective coping skills, and make progress toward individualized treatment goals. Depending on the member's age and clinical needs, treatment may also involve partnering with parents or caregivers to reinforce skills, support treatment goals, and promote meaningful change outside of therapy sessions.

Therapists are an integral part of our collaborative care model. You'll work closely with behavioral case managers, psychiatric providers, nurses, coaches, and other clinical team members to ensure members receive coordinated care that reflects their individual, developmental, and family needs.

This role is a great fit for an independently NY licensed behavioral health clinician who is passionate about supporting children, teens, and young adults, values collaboration, and is comfortable adapting treatment across developmental stages. You'll have opportunities to expand your clinical expertise through consultation, ongoing training, evidence-based care practices, and collaboration with an interdisciplinary team.

We are looking for a part-time licensed therapist to join our Pediatric Care Services clinical team. This role sits within the Pediatric Outpatient Service Line and reports to a Clinical Supervisor.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide evidence-based individual and family therapy to children, adolescents, young adults, and caregivers.

  • Conduct comprehensive behavioral health assessments and develop individualized treatment plans.

  • Utilize evidence-based modalities, including CBT, DBT, ACT, MI, PMT, trauma-informed interventions, and other approaches appropriate to the member's clinical and developmental needs.

  • Collaborate with psychiatrists, behavioral case managers, coaches, nurses, and other interdisciplinary team members to provide coordinated care.

  • Engage caregivers as active partners in treatment when clinically and developmentally appropriate through psychoeducation, collaborative goal setting, and skills coaching.

  • Maintain timely, accurate, clinically meaningful, and compliant documentation.

  • Participate in clinical consultation, supervision, ongoing training, and professional development.

  • Support quality improvement initiatives and the continued delivery of high-quality, evidence-based care.

Requirements:

  • Ability to work part-time, 24 hours per week.

  • Availability to provide care during afternoon and evening hours to support member scheduling needs.

  • Potential opportunity to work Saturdays based on program needs.

  • Ability to maintain a private, professional workspace appropriate for providing confidential telehealth services.

  • Ability to maintain reliable internet connectivity necessary to provide consistent, high-quality virtual care.

  • Must reside in and be authorized to work in the United States

  • Ability to meet applicable state licensing, credentialing, payer enrollment requirements, and interstate practice requirements.

Qualifications:

  • Current, active New York license and registration in good standing that permits independent clinical practice and diagnosis, such as LCSW, Licensed Psychologist, LMHC, or LMFT. LMHCs and LMFTs must hold New York’s diagnostic privilege. License must have no current restrictions or pending disciplinary action.

  • Doctoral degree (Psy.D. or Ph.D.) in Clinical Psychology, Counseling Psychology, or a related psychology discipline.

  • Experience providing evidence-based behavioral health treatment to children, adolescents, young adults, and families.

  • Demonstrated ability to deliver culturally responsive, trauma-informed, and developmentally appropriate care that recognizes and respects members' identities, lived experiences, family structures, and backgrounds.

  • Experience utilizing evidence-based interventions such as CBT, DBT, ACT, MI, PMT, EMDR, and other clinically appropriate treatment approaches.

  • Experience engaging caregivers as collaborative partners in treatment while promoting developmentally appropriate member autonomy.

  • Experience working collaboratively within an interdisciplinary care team.

  • Strong clinical judgment with excellent communication, organization, and documentation skills.

  • Tech-savvy and comfortable utilizing telehealth platforms, electronic health records, and other digital tools to deliver high-quality virtual care.

  • Warm, engaging, and collaborative clinical style with the ability to build therapeutic rapport across developmental stages.

raw.title: Network Engineer
raw.excerpt: We are looking for a talented Network Engineer to join our growing global team at Sectigo.
raw.description:
We are looking for a talented Network Engineer to join our growing global team at Sectigo.

The Network Engineer is responsible for supporting, implementing, managing, and maintaining the organization's networking infrastructure. This individual is detail-oriented, thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, and possesses a proven track record in learning, implementing, and maintaining enterprise networks and new technologies. Must be a commutable distance to Manchester DC, should the need arise.

Here are the core functions, responsibilities, and expectations for this role:

  • Network: Designing, planning, and implementing network infrastructure move, add, or changes. Including maintenance and support.
  • Network Security: Implementing and maintaining network security protocols, including firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems (IDS/IPS), VPNs, access control lists (ACLs), and encryption technologies to safeguard the organization's data and systems.
  • Network Troubleshooting and Optimization: Diagnosing and resolving complex network issues, analyzing network performance, and optimizing network infrastructure to ensure high availability, reliability, and performance.
  • Documentation and Reporting: Creating and maintaining network documentation, diagrams, and standard operating procedures (SOPs). Generating reports on network performance, security incidents, and compliance status for management review.
  • Capacity Planning: Assessing current and future network capacity requirements based on business growth projections and technology trends. Planning and implementing scalability solutions to accommodate increasing demand.
  • Regulatory Compliance: Ensuring network infrastructure compliance with industry regulations, standards, and best practices (e.g., PCI DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, ISO, Webtrust). Conducting audits and implementing remediation measures as needed.
  • Mounting and Installation: Ability to mount and install network devices such as routers, switches, and servers in data centers and office locations. This includes rack mounting, cable management, and hardware configuration. Candidates must be able to lift network equipment weighing up to 50 lbs.
  • Travel & Operational Requirements:
    • Participate in on-call rotation.
    • Travel both internationally and nationally as needed (site support meetings, projects, etc.).
    • Frequent visits to Datacenter near Manchester.
  • Additional tasks associated with this position may be assigned in response to company initiatives and business needs.

More information about this role:

  • This is a full-time and remote position based in U.K., with the ideal candidate reside within 1-hour driving distance to the greater Manchester area.
  • The targeted compensation package for this role is between GBP 55,000 and 62,000 per annum, subject upon internal equity and years of experience. We may make further adjustments through an approval process if the targeted compensation range needs to be modified based on business needs and market trends.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, or related field is strongly preferred. Relevant certifications (e.g., CCNP, CCIE, CISSP) are a plus.

Experience:

  • Proven experience (typically 5+ years) in network engineering roles, with a focus on supporting, implementing, and managing enterprise-scale network infrastructures.
  • Automation and Infrastructure as Code (IAC):
    • Ability to create, implement, and maintain automation using Terraform and Ansible.
    • Proficiency with GIT.
    • Comfortable with JSON, YAML, and XML.
    • Knowledge of Python is a plus.
  • Cloud Environments:
    • AWS network experience is necessary (TGWs, Network ACLs, AWS Network Firewall, Security Groups, VPCs, Subnet,etc..), and general experience is required.
  • Must be proficient in installing, implementing, supporting, and maintaining Juniper, Palo Alto, and Arista hardware and software for Datacenter and Campus environments.
  • Knowledge of SD-WAN technologies such as Palo Alto, Aruba/Silverpeak, or Cisco/Viptela is a plus.
  • Site to Site VPN: Must be able to design, implement, and support Route based and Policy based VPN. Knowledge of specific technologies such as DMVPN, FlexVPN, and other vendor-specific VPNs is a plus.
  • RA VPN: Must be able to design, implement, and support enterprise VPNs such as Global Protect or AnyConnect.
  • VXLAN: Understanding of overlay vs underlay and how it interacts with EVPN
  • AAA: Must be able to support, implement, and maintain Radius and Tacacs+ for both device access management and NAC (e.g., 802.1x). SAML-based authentication is a plus.
  • Network Monitoring: Must be able to implement, support, and use: Netflow, SNMP, and related enterprise tools (e.g., Solarwinds, Nagios, LiveNX).
  • FW Technologies and Traffic Flow: Must understand stateful vs non-stateful rules, symmetric vs non-symmetric, NAT types, order of operation, etc.
  • L3 Routing Protocols: Must have knowledge of OSPFv2, OSPFv3 and BGP. Knowledge of others such as ISIS and mBGP is a plus.
  • L3: Must know IPv6. IPv4 and IPv6 dual stack is a plus.
  • Layer 2: Must understand rSTP, dot1q, vlan, L2 security
  • Wireless: Good understanding wireless, roaming, troubleshooting
  • HA: Must understand FHRP (VRRP, HSRP, etc.), LACP, BFD, switch stacks.etc.
  • TCP/IP: Must understand path MTU discovery (ICMP), basic TCP flags, etc.
  • DNS, DHCP, ARP, Neighbor Discovery: Must have a good understanding.
  • Segment Packet Frame troubleshooting: Must be comfortable packet captures and utilizing tools like Wireshark and tcpdump.

Ideal Candidate Profiles, Talents, and Desired Qualifications:

  • In-depth knowledge of networking protocols and technologies, including TCP/IP, VLANs, OSPF, BGP, MPLS, VPNs, DNS, DHCP, SNMP, etc.
  • Strong understanding of network security principles and best practices, including firewall configuration, intrusion detection/prevention, encryption, and secure remote access.
  • Proficiency in network hardware and software, such as Arista, Cisco, Juniper, Palo Alto, Fortinet, Aruba, etc. Experience with SDN, SD-WAN, and cloud networking is desirable.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex network issues.
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams, articulate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders, and mentor junior staff.
  • Attention to detail, organization, and documentation skills, with a commitment to maintaining accurate network documentation and following standard procedures.
  • Adaptability and willingness to learn new technologies, methodologies, and tools to keep pace with evolving business needs and industry trends.

Sectigo is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

At Sectigo, we are committed to providing equal opportunities throughout your career. We hire and promote the most qualified individuals based on their skills, experience, job requirements, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability, pregnancy, genetic information, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws in the countries where we operate.

Our “One Sectigo” culture fosters a strong sense of belonging and supports a respectful, inclusive workplace free from discrimination and harassment.

Use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Our Hiring Process at Sectigo:

To enhance your experience, Sectigo may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools during the recruitment process. We are committed to using AI responsibly and transparently, ensuring fairness, accuracy, and human oversight at every stage.

Global team. Global reach. Global impact.

raw.title: Media Performance Analyst
raw.excerpt: Data Wrangling & Analysis• Collect, clean, organize, and reconcile data from multiple sources, including media platforms, client performance reports, analytics tools, and third-party data providers.
raw.description:
Data Wrangling & Analysis

  • Collect, clean, organize, and reconcile data from multiple sources, including media platforms, client performance reports, analytics tools, and third-party data providers.

  • Work with complex datasets to establish consistent definitions, classifications, geographic mappings, and reporting structures, in collaboration with Strategy/Planning, Activation, and the Client.

  • Analyze media investment and performance across channels, campaigns, markets, audiences, and time periods.

  • Connect media performance data with available business outcomes, including leads, appointments, conversions, sales, and revenue.

  • Collaborate with media planning, investment, and measurement teams to address business questions and support performance assessments and optimization decisions.

  • Leverage AI and other analytical tools to accelerate data wrangling and analysis, applying appropriate judgment to validate findings, ensure accuracy, and protect data privacy.

  • Develop repeatable analytical processes that improve efficiency, consistency, and accuracy.

Performance Insights & Recommendations

  • Identify meaningful trends, performance drivers, anomalies, and opportunities within media and business data.

  • Investigate changes in performance to understand potential contributing factors, distinguishing between correlation and demonstrated causation.

  • Evaluate differences in performance across markets, channels, and campaigns to help inform media investment and optimization decisions.

  • Translate analytical findings into clear insights, business implications, and recommended actions.

  • Partner with Strategy and Activation teams to identify opportunities to improve investment effectiveness and overall business performance.

  • Proactively surface questions and areas for further investigation rather than relying solely on predefined reporting requirements.

Reporting, Visualization & Business Intelligence

  • Develop and maintain analytical reports, dashboards, and visualizations using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, and Excel.

  • Help establish consistent performance metrics and reporting methodologies across clients and campaigns.

  • Work with internal teams to improve data accessibility, reporting efficiency, and the usability of performance dashboards.

  • Create clear, concise presentations of analytical findings for internal teams and client stakeholders.

  • Support automation of recurring data preparation, analysis, and reporting processes.

  • Help develop automated workflows within dashboards to streamline the review, approval, and implementation of media optimization recommendations and investment shifts.

Required

We value demonstrable capabilities over specific years of experience. While 4–6 years of relevant experience is ideal, candidates with less experience who demonstrate strong technical expertise, analytical capabilities, and problem-solving skills will also be considered.

  • Strong technical proficiency, analytical capabilities, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work with complex, incomplete, or inconsistent datasets to produce reliable analyses and actionable insights.

  • Advanced Excel skills, including complex formulas, pivot tables, Power Query, and data manipulation. Experience with macros and VBA (Visual Basic for Applications) is a plus.

  • Strong data wrangling skills, including cleaning, transforming, combining, and analyzing large datasets using SQL or comparable tools. Python proficiency is a plus.

  • Proficiency in developing dashboards, reports, and data visualizations using Power BI, Tableau, or comparable platforms, including experience with data integration, workflow automation, and streamlining reporting and approval processes.

  • Ability to interpret analytical findings, identify business implications, and communicate recommendations clearly to nontechnical audiences.

  • Strong attention to detail, analytical curiosity, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

  • Familiarity with media or marketing performance metrics and their relationship to business outcomes is valuable, including experience with paid media platforms such as Google Ads and Meta.

  • Experience at a media agency, marketing agency, or in a performance-focused marketing organization is an advantage, as is exposure to Marketing Mix Modeling, attribution, incrementality testing, or other marketing measurement approaches.

  • Experience working with geographic and market-level data, including Designated Market Area (DMA) analysis, is a plus.

  • Experience using AI-assisted analytical tools and workflows for data preparation, wrangling, automation, and analysis, with appropriate attention to accuracy, validation, and data privacy.

What Success Looks Like

  • Media and client performance data can be analyzed more efficiently and consistently, even when sourced from disparate or imperfect reporting systems.

  • Planning and investment teams have greater visibility into the factors influencing performance across channels, markets, and campaigns.

  • Analytical findings go beyond reporting what happened to help explain potential performance drivers, implications for paid media strategy, and opportunities for optimizations to improve business outcomes.

  • Dashboards and recurring analyses provide reliable, accessible information that supports faster and better-informed decisions.

  • The agency develops more scalable analytical capabilities that strengthen its performance-first approach to media planning, investment, and optimization.

The Ideal Candidate

You are as interested in understanding why performance changed as you are in reporting what changed. You enjoy working with data, are resourceful in finding ways to organize and analyze it, and know how to turn complex findings into insights that others can act on.

You understand that the value of analytics is not simply producing reports or dashboards, but helping teams make better decisions and deliver stronger business outcomes.

Company Overview

At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents. We support their journey back to health and wellness through our industry-leading solutions and services. Whether you're supporting a Fortune 500 client or a local business, developing cutting-edge technology, or providing clinical services you'll work alongside dedicated professionals who share your commitment to excellence and make a meaningful impact. Join us in fueling our mission to protect dreams and restore lives, while building your career in an environment that values collaboration, innovation, and personal growth.

Be part of a team that makes a real difference.

Job Description

This is a full-time remote position that can be located anywhere in the U.S.
Candidates must be willing to work 8am to 5pm PST time zone.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Business Systems Analyst and NetSuite Administrator to lead our NetSuite ERP platform initiatives and provide strategic support across our finance organization. This is a hands-on role requiring someone who can balance competing priorities, communicate effectively across all organizational levels, and drive continuous improvement in our financial systems and processes. You will serve as a trusted advisor to functional leaders, acting as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and technical resources. Your ability to understand complex business challenges, coordinate project delivery, and translate between technical and non-technical audiences will be critical to success. Additionally, you'll provide support on an as-needed basis, stepping in to triage and troubleshoot issues and mentor team members.

Key Responsibilities -

Strategic & Leadership:

  • Serve as the go-to subject matter expert and product owner for the NetSuite platform
  • Lead project coordination and delivery by managing timelines, milestones, stakeholder communication, and cross-functional team activities
  • Drive the NetSuite roadmap by identifying optimization opportunities, recommending best practices, and challenging the status quo
  • Manage and prioritize competing business demands while maintaining focus on strategic initiatives

Functional Expertise & Support:

  • Provide deep expertise across NetSuite finance modules including: customized envormnet, fixed assets, ARM (Advanced Revenue Management), AR, AP, revenue recognition, general ledger, planning, audit, and reporting
  • Work closely with functional leaders to understand business challenges and recommend optimal solutions
  • Serve as the primary support resource for end-users, providing guidance, training, and troubleshooting across departments
  • Manage support requests through ticket systems with clear prioritization and follow-through
  • Provide ticket and triage support on as-needed basis
  • Mentor and guide support team members on technical and functional challenges

Technical Administration & Operations:

  • Oversee NetSuite configuration, customization, and ongoing system administration
  • Manage and support customizations including: custom objects, integrations, workflow rules, approval processes, page layouts, security, validation rules, custom buttons/links, and custom fields
  • Support data import processes, migrations, and bi-annual platform updates
  • Customize, maintain, and optimize reports, dashboards, workbooks, and saved searches
  • Coordinate testing, planning, and execution of system changes and updates
  • Perform day-to-day operations, maintenance, and troubleshooting activities

Communication & Stakeholder Management:

  • Communicate clearly and effectively with diverse audiences—tailoring technical complexity, tone, and content based on stakeholder needs
  • Provide executive-level summaries for leadership and detailed technical guidance for implementation teams
  • Document processes, decisions, and lessons learned to support organizational knowledge
  • Act as a bridge between business users and technical resources, translating requirements and solutions

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in CS or related field required, (or equivalent combination of NetSuite and ERP experience)
  • Minimum 5+ years as a NetSuite Administrator or Business Systems Analyst
  • Critical Requirement: Demonstrated experience working in large organizations (2,000+ employees) where you've successfully managed competing priorities, stakeholder expectations, and complex organizational dynamics
  • Support Experience: Proven background providing Tier 2/Tier 3 support in an organization—demonstrating ability to troubleshoot complex issues, manage escalations, and mentor others
  • Proven track record supporting NetSuite in highly customized environments with complex financial processes
  • Strong understanding of financial processes: billing, payments, AR, AP, revenue recognition, general ledger, planning, audit, and reporting

Technical & Analytical Skills:

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities in complex, multi-stakeholder environments
  • Hands-on knowledge of NetSuite modules and features: custom workflows, custom records, role management, integration setup, dashboards, searches/reports, SuiteAnalytics, SuiteFlow
  • Ability to learn and support customized billing, contracts, fixed assets, and customer portal implementations
  • Comfortable working with technical teams and understanding system architecture and data flows
  • Ability to work in a support managing criticality, triaging, and prioritizing incidents and tasks

Soft Skills & Attributes:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with ability to adapt messaging for different audiences
  • Strong organizational and time management skills—ability to juggle multiple priorities and maintain focus
  • Proactive, self-managed, and driven to seek continuous improvement and upskilling
  • Demonstrated curiosity and willingness to challenge the status quo
  • Ability to work collaboratively across departments and multiple business disciplines
  • Confident in providing support, training, and guidance to end-users at all levels

Preferred Qualifications:

  • NetSuite Administrator Certification or relevant NetSuite certifications
  • Technical development skills (JavaScript, TypeScript, SQL) or exposure to custom development
  • Experience with AI-assisted tools or emerging technologies in ERP environments
  • Background in financial operations, accounting, or finance systems
  • Experience leading or coordinating cross-functional projects
  • Degree in Information Technology, Business, Finance, or related field

Benefits

We’re committed to supporting your ultimate well-being through our total compensation package offerings that support your health, wealth and self. These offerings include Medical, Dental, Vision, Health Savings Accounts / Flexible Spending Accounts, Life and AD&D Insurance, 401(k), Tuition Reimbursement, and an array of resources that encourage a lifetime of healthier living. Benefits eligibility may differ depending on full-time or part-time status. Compensation depends on the applicable US geographic market. The expected base pay for this position ranges from $98,750 - $127,000 annually, and will be based on a number of additional factors including skills, experience, and education.

The Company is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability.

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and underrepresented minorities are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

raw.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a Core AE, you will be helping our largest and most strategic enterprise sized customers consolidate outdated technologies, digitize workflows, and unlock game-changing data insights that will transform their businesses. We are helping the companies that literally keep our lights on, put food on our tables, and build our communities to become safer, more efficient, and more sustainable. Typical sales will be $100k to $500k, and typically involve POCs, multiple stakeholders, managing trials, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to executives and CXOs.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US in the following states: Alabama, Arkansas, Florida, Georgia, Kentucky, Louisiana, Mississippi, North Carolina, South Carolina, Tennessee, Virginia, and West Virginia.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will:

  • Develop Executive-Level relationships within strategic, named accounts
  • Own customer engagements end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification to close
  • Demonstrate excellent solution-based sales process in complex sales campaigns
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years experience in a full-cycle, closing sales role
  • Proven track record of consistent quota over-achievement in complex accounts and $100k+ ARR transactions
  • Experience handling and owning enterprise deal sizes and C-Level relationships
  • Willing and comfortable with strategic outbound prospecting
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and demonstrated ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast paced environment
  • Willing and comfortable traveling to meet customers on a monthly basis

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience working with line of business stakeholders (Operations, Finance, IT)
  • Awards for top achievement (President’s club, Winner’s circle, Top 10%)
  • Passion for the world of operations!

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

Annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position is below and depends on your city of residence. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual OTE Salary
$222,400—$278,000 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

The Specialist, Clinical Engagement serves as a key member of the Clinical Engagement Center (CEC) team, responsible for delivering high-quality clinical engagement through telephonic medication consultations, health education, and care coordination. This position plays a critical role in advancing medication adherence and patient engagement strategies by execution of Medication Therapy Management (MTM), Stars Adherence, and ongoing clinical initiatives, within defined program guidelines. The Specialist will report to the Supervisor, CEC Operations, as well as interact with other CEC Operations leaders.

As part of the CEC, the Specialist, Clinical Engagement supports Navitus’ commitment to delivering high-quality, patient-centered care through proactive outreach, problem-solving, and coordination with internal and external stakeholders. This position helps ensure that patients receive timely access to medications and resources, ultimately contributing to improved clinical performance aligning with Navitus’ strategic goals for health and wellness.

Is this you? Find out more below!

Responsibilities

How do I make an impact on my team?

  • Independently conduct, within established protocols, Medication Therapy Management (MTM) and Stars Adherence initiatives to support organizational quality, performance, and patient outcomes.
  • Conduct proactive patient outreach using advanced communication techniques to improve engagement, adherence, and program participation.
  • Coordinate patient care activities to ensure timely access to medications and continuity of therapy, prioritizing work and resolving routine issues with minimal supervision.
  • Collaborate with CEC team members to support consistent, high quality clinical services and shared accountability for outcomes.
  • Educate patients on program benefits and medication adherence, applying professional judgment within program protocols to identify risks, address barriers, and determine appropriate interventions.
  • Facilitate prescription renewals and extended day supply requests, managing exceptions and coordinating with pharmacies or providers as needed.
  • Identify and address barriers to medication access by assessing patient specific challenges and connecting members with appropriate clinical or operational resources.
  • Ability to apply sound professional judgment in well-defined situations and appropriately escalate when additional guidance is needed.
  • Adhere to established protocols and regulatory requirements, escalating non-routine decisions involving complex, sensitive, or high-risk situations appropriately.
  • Support operational effectiveness by completing assigned workflows accurately and efficiently and taking ownership of tasks that contribute to overall department performance.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

What our team expects from you?

  • High School diploma or GED required.
  • Certified Pharmacy Technician certification required. State Pharmacy Technician license required where applicable.
  • 3 years of pharmacy support experience or clinical program execution required.
  • Strong pharmaceutical knowledge to accurately address inquiries, support medication-related processes, and ensure safe, informed outcomes required.
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver empathetic, patient-focused support by actively listening, addressing needs, and ensuring clear, respectful communication across diverse populations required.
  • Demostrated experience effectively managing inbound and outbound communications while consistently following established workflows, scripts, and escalation protocols to ensure quality and efficiency required.
  • Knowledge of healthcare regulations, including HIPAA, that protects patient information and ensures all interactions and documentation meet compliance standards required.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate within cross-functional teams to meet service level expectations, support shared goals, and contribute to overall operational success required.
  • Participate in, adhere to, and support compliance program objectives.
  • The ability to consistently interact cooperatively and respectfully with other employees.

What can you expect from Navitus?

  • 20 days paid time off

  • 9 paid holidays
  • 401K company match of up to 5% - No vesting requirement

  • Design and develop high-performance software solutions for semiconductor design, verification, and validation workflows.

  • Develop scalable automation frameworks and infrastructure for EDA tools, build systems, and compute environments.

  • Extensive experience with EDA tools, ASIC/SoC verification, silicon bring-up, or post-silicon validation.
  • Strong understanding of hardware-software integration, embedded systems, debugging techniques, and performance optimization.
  • Hands-on experience with scripting, automation frameworks, Linux development environments, and HPC or cloud-based compute infrastructure.

This role manages the full compensation lifecycle, including plan setup, eligibility validation, audits, approvals, payout reconciliation, issue resolution, and employee and leader support. Working closely with Admissions, Human Resources, Payroll, Information Technology, and business systems teams, the Analyst ensures compensation processes and data remain accurate and compliant. Job Overview

The Territory Manager is responsible for the sales and promotion of Hubbell Killark Harsh and Hazardous product portfolio to distributors, electrical contractors, end-users and specifying inﬂuences and for attaining assigned sales quotas within an assigned territory. Heavy focus on contractor relationships and end user sales. Territory consists of all of Oregon and Western Washington. The incumbent should reside in the Greater Seattle, WA or Portland, OR area.

A Day In The Life

  • Manage assigned territory to ensure eﬀective, eﬃcient and economical use of available time and Company assets to achieve sales objectives.
  • Conduct sales calls on Distributors and all potential users/consumers of Hubbell Killark products.
  • Train Distributor personnel to sell and promote Hubbell products; manage Distributor inventory/investments to ensure maintenance of proper inventories to service the trading area and maximize the “Return on Investment”.
  • Maintain accurate account records (TMS/Electronic TMS).
  • Conduct sales training, internal and external, within the District and Region as directed by Field Management.
  • Conduct formal sales presentations to various groups, distributors, and end-users. Communicate to diverse types of end-users in a variety of ways, either by letter, telephone, small group meetings, person to person meetings, Trade Shows and Business oriented social functions.
  • Communicate through District Manager on any issues, problems, opportunities, successes, and new products.
  • Service distributors and end-users while creating demand for the Company’s product oﬀering.
  • Build rapport and strong relationships with distribution, end-users and specifying inﬂuences.
  • Communicate through District Manager on new products, product modiﬁcations and sales tools.
  • Cover open territories with assignment made by the District Manager.

What will help you thrive in this role?

  • Bachelor’s degree in business or HS Diploma and 2-3 years relevant industry sales experience.
  • Prior sales and/or industry experience is preferred.
  • Serves as a customer information center for literature requests, catalog requests, technical detail, drawings, and cross-reference information.
  • Build rapport and strong relationships with distribution, end-users and specifying inﬂuences.
  • Communicate through District Manager on new products, product modiﬁcations and sales tools.
  • Cover open territories with assignment made by the District Manager.
  • Proﬁcient computer skills including MS Oﬃce 365: Excel; PowerPoint; Word; TEAMS; OneDrive. SAP Concur Solutions.
  • Experience w/ Salesforce.com preferred.
  • Excellent presentation skills.

#Remote

Hubbell Incorporated

Hubbell creates critical infrastructure solutions that power our customers, communities, people and the planet. Our company is strategically aligned around enabling grid modernization and electrification. As more products plug in to an aging grid, Hubbell solutions enable the transition to a more reliable, resilient and efficient energy infrastructure. Founded in 1888 our innovation has made us a leading global manufacturer of high quality electrical and utility solutions enabling customers to operate critical infrastructure reliably and efficiently.

The company operates in two segments. Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications and Hubbell Electrical Solutions (HES) are essential to managing power across a wide range of industries and applications. Our vertical market solutions can be applied to markets including Data Centers, Renewables, Commercial Buildings, Industrial, Telecom and Transportation. Supporting both of our business segments is our corporate and Hubbell Unified Business Solutions teams that provide consistent process, tools technologies across our businesses.

We are committed to operating sustainably and ethically while promoting an inclusive and supportive culture for our people to grow and develop in their careers. Our employees proudly work and serve our communities from our headquarters in Shelton, CT, across the United States and around the globe.

Hubbell Electrical Solutions

Hubbell Electrical Solutions (HES) are essential to managing power across a wide range of industries and applications. HES provides the critical components that allow operators of buildings, factories and other industrial infrastructure to connect, protect, wire and manage power.

Fluent German is required for this role. Our customers are property management companies in Germany.

We're seeking an experienced Software architect / Full-Stack Developer who thinks like a Systems Designer – someone who reaches for schema diagrams and load assumptions before reaching for code. You'll join our fully remote team. If you like complexity, enjoy reasoning about data, scale and reliability, want to implement AI-solutions and enjoy working with Claude, this could be the right role for you.

What you'll do

  • Own the system design – you decide how data is modeled, where state lives, how components talk to each other, and how the whole system behaves under load. You stay responsible for it once it's live.

  • Make the hard, hard-to-reverse design decisions early – and reason explicitly about the trade-offs behind them

  • Design and own our data layer from the ground up for new features – tables and relationships, indexing strategy, and query/load optimization that holds up as data and traffic grow

  • Design queues, background jobs and long-running workflows that stay correct and reliable under heavy load and partial failure

  • Talk to customers to understand how they actually use the product, and bring that into architecture decisions, the direction of our stack and the overall product vision

  • Work independently in an AI-first development setup with Claude

About Us

is an all-in-one platform for property management companies with features like an Inbox, CRM, Documents, Telephony, Video Calls, Team Chat and AI-Agents. We want to automate as much of a property manager's daily work as we can.

Our tech stack

Everything is TypeScript. From our database schema to the frontend.

Backend: Convex (Database & serverless functions)

Frontend: , React, Tailwind, shadcn/ui

Salary

  • $1500 - $3000 per month before taxes with room for growth and promotion in the months & years ahead

  • Permanent employment contract in your country of residence through our partner Deel (EOR)

Benefits

  • 100% remote work

  • Allianz Gold Health Insurance with great coverage

  • Flexible hours

  • As many AI-tokens as you need

  • We’re self-funded & profitable (and not burning VC money to survive)

  • Small team, real ownership — what you build actually goes live

  • Quick decisions, no pointless meetings and no layers of approval to get through

Our special Health Program

  • Private room in hospital, worldwide coverage

  • Free choice of doctors & specialists, no health check, pre-existing conditions don't matter

  • Partner and kids are covered as well

  • Surgery, cancer care, MRI/CT/PET scans and diagnostics fully covered

  • Dental treatment & surgery covered at 90%

  • $675/year for physio, osteopathy, chiropractic and acupuncture

  • $100 per night in-patient cash benefit, up to 20 nights

  • Prescription drugs, vaccinations, glasses/contacts, home nursing and ambulance covered

Our values

  • Get things done, every day matters

  • Transparency and honesty, especially when it’s hard

  • High standards for our own work and each other's

For a closer look at what we're building, check out our YouTube channel — heads up, it's in German.

Requirements

  • Fluent German, spoken and written

  • A genuine systems-design background – you can design a database from scratch (tables, relationships, indexes) and reason about database load, query performance and data growth, not just write CRUD against an existing schema

  • The instinct to think in terms of consistency, throughput, failure modes and bottlenecks – you know where the system will hurt before it does

  • Comfort designing queues, background jobs and long-running workflows, and the judgment to make the hard design trade-offs they involve

  • You treat reliability, scalability and maintainability as default concerns. If you've read "Designing Data-Intensive Applications" (Kleppmann) – or simply think that way – you'll feel right at home here

  • Solid English skills for smooth communication within the team

  • You work autonomously and take full ownership of your tasks

  • You're comfortable talking to customers to understand what they actually need

is not important to us, since AI will be writing 100% of your code.

This role is responsible for monitoring call volume, agent adherence, and staffing levels to ensure the daily scheduling plan is executed effectively and service level objectives are achieved.

The ideal candidate is analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where operational decisions must be made quickly. You will work closely with leaders, supervisors, and employees to support day-to-day contact center operations while providing reporting, performance monitoring, and operational insights.

Requirements

  • Experience monitoring service levels, call queues, and workforce adherence in a contact center environment
  • Familiarity with NICE IEX Workforce Management (WFM) systems preferred
  • Familiarity with Cisco ACD or similar contact center telephony platforms preferred
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Experience using Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, for reporting and data analysis

Job Description:

The Committee Coordinator is responsible for providing administrative and logistical support for the Safety and Compliance Committee(s), maintaining oversight that all committee activities, meetings, documentation, and processes are efficiently managed and compliant with OPTN governance and HRSA oversight requirements. This role requires a strong ability to maintain detailed records, facilitate secure and transparent communication, and support coordination efforts with internal teams, HRSA, contractors, and committee stakeholders.


Reporting to the Committee Operations Leads, the Committee Coordinator plays a pivotal role in ensuring timely management of committee administration, maintenance of rosters and records, and coordination of committee activities. The Coordinator focuses on implementing established processes while providing detailed documentation, logistical support for meetings, and adherence to organizational protocols for the execution of committee functions.

Key Responsibilities

1. Committee Administration

  • Assist in documenting and maintaining committee procedures, structures, operational manuals, and decision-making processes as outlined in the Safety and Compliance Committee(s) Management Draft Plan.

2. Meeting Coordination and Facilitation

  • Provide full administrative and technical support for virtual committee meetings, including scheduling, securing platforms, and distributing agendas and supporting materials.
  • Collaborate with Committee Operations Lead, committee leaders, members, and HRSA staff to draft detailed meeting documentation, including agendas and presentation slides.
  • Facilitate the accurate preparation and timely submission of meeting minutes, summaries, raw and clean transcriptions, and electronic recordings within required timeframes.
  • Prepare de-identified meeting summaries for public posting on the OPTN website, ensuring compliance with information security and transparency standards.

3. Process Management and Communication

  • Monitor and track committee activity milestones, timelines, and accountable parties to provide progress visibility for HRSA, OPTN leadership, and relevant stakeholders.
  • Respond to information requests from the Safety and Compliance Committee(s), HRSA, or other stakeholders by triaging, tracking, and providing prompt responses.
  • Provide regular updates and communication of committee activities and accomplishments to HRSA, the Committees, the OPTN Board, and other relevant stakeholders through secure channels.

4. Records and Reports Management

  • Maintain accurate recordkeeping and documentation for all Safety and Compliance Committee(s) activities, including records related to committee composition, training, and decision-making processes.
  • Assist in the preparation and submission of required deliverables in compliance with contractual timelines and organizational standards, including trackers, dashboards, manuals, and reports.
  • Provide ongoing access to critical documentation, operational data, and updated SOPs as required by HRSA and committee stakeholders.

Qualifications

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, healthcare management, public administration, or a related field.

Experience:

  • Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in roles involving administrative support, committee coordination, project management, or similar operations.
  • Experience in healthcare processes, compliance, or governance-related activities is preferred.

Skills and Competencies:

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage complex workflows, sensitive data, and competing deadlines.
  • Familiarity with tracking tools, databases, and collaboration platforms for record-keeping and data management.
  • Proficiency in systems such as Microsoft Office Suite and virtual meeting platforms.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills for preparing detailed documentation, meeting materials, and correspondence.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders, including HRSA, contractors, committee leaders, and government entities.
  • Must be able to obtain a Public Trust clearance

  • LOCATION: Remote
